records.name: Mobile App Tasks with Iterative Feedback (MoTIF): Addressing Task Feasibility in Interactive Visual Environments
records.summary: Introduces MoTIF, a dataset of natural-language requests for interactive mobile apps, including infeasible requests and follow-up questions for studying task feasibility.

records.name: Understanding Mobile GUI: from Pixel-Words to Screen-Sentences
records.summary: Models mobile screens as atomic text and graphic components whose relationships are learned by a Screen Transformer. The work introduces RICO-PW annotations and evaluates metadata-free screen understanding on relation, clickability, retrieval, and app-classification tasks.

records.name: AndroidEnv: A Reinforcement Learning Platform for Android
records.summary: Presents an Android environment for training and evaluating reinforcement-learning agents through touchscreen interaction.

records.name: AppBuddy: Learning to Accomplish Tasks in Mobile Apps via Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Introduces AppBuddy, an RL training platform and task suite for mobile apps where agents use on-screen element states and tap or type to complete multi-step tasks.

records.name: TableSense: Spreadsheet Table Detection with Convolutional Neural Networks
UIBert: Learning Generic Multimodal Representations for UI Understanding
records.summary: Learns shared image, text, and structural UI representations through self-supervised tasks based on relationships among interface components.

records.name: Screen2Words: Automatic Mobile UI Summarization with Multimodal Learning
records.summary: Studies mobile-screen summarization using visual, textual, and structural UI information, with a dataset of human-written descriptions.

records.name: Analyzing Dynamic Adversarial Training Data in the Limit
VUT: Versatile UI Transformer for Multi-Modal Multi-Task User Interface Modeling
records.summary: The Versatile UI Transformer jointly models interface screenshots, structure, and language for five UI tasks. Its encoder supports element detection when structural metadata is absent, while an autoregressive component handles UI question answering and command grounding.

records.name: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
records.summary: Trains a question-answering model to search and navigate a text-based web browser, collect references and improve long-form answers using demonstrations and human feedback.

records.name: Learning to Denoise Raw Mobile UI Layouts for Improving Datasets at Scale
records.summary: Introduces CLAY, a pipeline that repairs noisy mobile UI layouts by removing nodes without valid visual counterparts and assigning semantic element types, supported by human-annotated layouts for evaluation.

records.name: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility

records.name: Pix2Struct: Screenshot Parsing as Pretraining for Visual Language Understanding
records.summary: Pix2Struct pretrains an image-to-text model by reconstructing simplified HTML from masked webpage screenshots. Its variable-resolution visual representation is evaluated across several domains, including user-interface understanding.

records.name: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
records.summary: Introduces ReAct, a method that interleaves reasoning traces and actions for language-model agents; WebShop is one of its interactive decision-making evaluations.

records.name: Understanding HTML with Large Language Models
records.summary: Studies language models for HTML element classification, page description and autonomous web navigation. Fine-tuned models are evaluated on MiniWoB, and a distilled, automatically labeled CommonCrawl HTML corpus supports the training approach.

records.name: UGIF: UI Grounded Instruction Following
records.summary: Introduces multilingual smartphone instruction-following data and a pipeline that retrieves help instructions and maps them to UI actions.

records.summary: Studies unintended consequences of collaborative web browsing with GUI agents through social-media analysis and interviews. It organizes observed failures, user impacts, and mitigation practices around planning, interface interaction, feedback, privacy, and trust.

records.name: AI Agents vs. Agentic AI: A Conceptual Taxonomy, Applications and Challenges
LLM-Explorer: Towards Efficient and Affordable LLM-based Exploration for Mobile Apps
records.summary: LLM-Explorer uses language models to maintain compact knowledge for mobile app exploration, then generates actions without invoking the model at every step. The study compares exploration coverage and cost across twenty apps.

records.name: Creating General User Models from Computer Use
records.summary: Proposes general user models that turn computer-use observations into confidence-weighted propositions and revise them as new context arrives. Demonstrations use this memory to contextualize assistants, manage notifications, and support proactive actions across apps.

records.name: InfantAgent-Next: A Multimodal Generalist Agent for Automated Computer Interaction
records.summary: Introduces InfantAgent-Next, a modular multimodal computer agent that combines tool-based and vision agents for stepwise tasks, with evaluation on OSWorld and other benchmarks.

records.name: A Survey on the Safety and Security Threats of Computer-Using Agents: JARVIS or Ultron?
records.summary: Systematizes safety and security threats to computer-using agents, with taxonomies of threats and defensive strategies.

records.name: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
records.summary: Introduces Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), an RL method for assigning step-level credit in multi-turn agents, evaluated on WebShop among other tasks.

records.name: WebInject: Prompt Injection Attack to Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces WebInject, a prompt-injection attack that optimizes rendered webpage pixels to make screenshot-based web agents take attacker-chosen actions.

records.name: Mobile-Bench-v2: A More Realistic and Comprehensive Benchmark for VLM-based Mobile Agents
records.summary: Mobile-Bench-v2 evaluates mobile GUI agents using multiple acceptable offline action paths, noisy interfaces with ads or pop-ups, and ambiguous instructions with scripted clarification exchanges. These splits separate step-level execution, robustness, and proactive interaction.
records.publication_search_text: SMAN-Bench: A Cross-System Benchmark for Mobile Agents under Single- and Multi-path, Ambiguous, and Noisy Tasks International Conference on Learning Representations https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2026/hash/1b4279dc1ec8d0183c22528664d84459-Abstract-Conference.html https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2026/file/1b4279dc1ec8d0183c22528664d84459-Paper-Conference.pdf Weikai Xu Zhizheng Jiang Yuxuan Liu Pengzhi Gao Wei Liu Jian Luan Yuanchun Li Yunxin Liu Bin Wang Bo An

records.name: MobileIPL: Enhancing Mobile Agents Thinking Process via Iterative Preference Learning
records.summary: MobileIPL samples trees of action-planning thoughts, propagates rule-based leaf rewards backward, and forms preference pairs for reasoning-level optimization. It also expands screenshot-based instruction data through staged evolution before evaluation on mobile GUI-agent benchmarks.

records.name: Enhancing Visual Grounding for GUI Agents via Self-Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Proposes GUI grounding training that combines curated seed examples, continuous location-dependent policy feedback, and iterative refinement guided by attention maps. The study evaluates the resulting reinforcement-learning procedure on three grounding benchmarks, including ScreenSpot-Pro.

records.name: GUI-Shift: Enhancing VLM-Based GUI Agents through Self-supervised Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: GUI-Shift trains an inverse-dynamics task that predicts the initial action connecting two GUI states, using trajectories without natural-language instructions. It combines rule-based reinforcement learning with data filtering and evaluates transfer to Android automation and screenshot grounding.

records.name: CPGD: Toward Stable Rule-based Reinforcement Learning for Language Models
Scalable Video-to-Dataset Generation for Cross-Platform Mobile Agents
records.summary: Introduces MONDAY and an automated pipeline that extracts mobile-navigation training data from instructional videos across operating-system platforms.

records.name: GEM: Gaussian Embedding Modeling for Out-of-Distribution Detection in GUI Agents
records.summary: GEM detects instructions outside a GUI agent’s capabilities by modeling distances in its input-embedding space with a Gaussian mixture. Experiments across mobile, computer and browser data also examine selective escalation to a cloud model when an input is detected as unfamiliar.

records.name: From Assistants to Adversaries: Exploring the Security Risks of Mobile LLM Agents
records.summary: Analyzes security vulnerabilities across OEM system-level, third-party, and research mobile LLM agents, covering GUI and cross-application attack surfaces.

records.name: The Hidden Dangers of Browsing AI Agents
records.summary: Outlines an end-to-end threat model and empirical security evaluation across architectural layers of autonomous browser agents.

records.name: Scaling Computer-Use Grounding via User Interface Decomposition and Synthesis
records.summary: Introduces OSWorld-G grounding evaluation and the Jedi synthesis pipeline for examples spanning layout reasoning and fine-grained interaction.

records.name: MM-PRM: Enhancing Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning with Scalable Step-Level Supervision
Mobile-Agent-V: A Video-Guided Approach for Effortless and Efficient Operational Knowledge Injection in Mobile Automation
Efficient Agent Training for Computer Use
records.summary: PC Agent-E augments 312 human computer-use trajectories with alternative action decisions synthesized by Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It studies training with this combination and introduces WindowsAgentArena-V2 as an updated evaluation benchmark.

records.name: RLVR-World: Training World Models with Reinforcement Learning
Building a Stable Planner: An Extended Finite State Machine Based Planning Module for Mobile GUI Agent
records.summary: SPlanner models mobile-app functions and configurations with extended finite-state machines, traverses them to construct execution paths, and converts those paths into natural-language plans. A VLM follows these plans to perform GUI actions, with evaluation on AndroidWorld.

records.name: EVA: Evolving Semantic Adversaries for Red-Teaming GUI Agents Against Environmental Injection Attacks
records.summary: Introduces EVA, a red-teaming framework that evolves semantic payloads for GUI environmental-injection tests. It studies the contribution of semantic versus visual deception and distills discovered patterns into reusable evaluation rules.

records.name: Hidden Ghost Hand: Unveiling Backdoor Vulnerabilities in MLLM-Powered Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: Studies backdoor risks in mobile GUI agents through AgentGhost, which combines goal-level and interaction-history triggers during model training. The paper evaluates multiple mobile agents and a tailored defense.

records.name: MedBrowseComp: Benchmarking Medical Deep Research and Computer Use
records.summary: Introduces MedBrowseComp, a benchmark of human-curated, multi-hop medical questions for agents retrieving and synthesizing facts from live knowledge bases in a computer-use setting.

records.name: lmgame-Bench: How Good are LLMs at Playing Games?
ReGUIDE: Data Efficient GUI Grounding via Spatial Reasoning and Search
records.summary: Combines self-generated localization reasoning, spatial consistency checks, and inference-time search to improve data-efficient web grounding.

records.name: Web-Shepherd: Advancing PRMs for Reinforcing Web Agents
records.summary: Web-Shepherd is a process reward model for assessing individual steps of web-navigation trajectories. It introduces a collection of 40,000 step-level preference pairs with checklists and a separate benchmark for comparing reward models, then evaluates verification during WebArena-lite navigation.

records.name: GUI-G1: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training for Visual Grounding in GUI Agents
records.summary: Analyzes reasoning templates, reward design, and policy updates in GUI grounding, then proposes targeted adjustments to the training process.

records.name: AutoData: A Multi-Agent System for Open Web Data Collection
records.summary: Introduces AutoData, a multi-agent system that collects web datasets from a natural-language request, and Instruct2DS, a benchmark for live collection across three domains.

records.name: VideoGameQA-Bench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Video Game Quality Assurance
ARPO:End-to-End Policy Optimization for GUI Agents with Experience Replay
records.summary: ARPO extends group-relative policy optimization with a replay buffer that reuses successful GUI trajectories across training iterations. It filters tasks using baseline performance and compares end-to-end reinforcement learning with offline preference optimization on OSWorld.

records.name: WebAgent-R1: Training Web Agents via End-to-End Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Trains web agents through asynchronous multi-turn environment interaction, using task-success rewards to optimize complete trajectories.

records.name: Unlocking Smarter Device Control: Foresighted Planning with a World Model-Driven Code Execution Approach
records.summary: FPWC builds and refines a task-oriented world model before planning mobile-device actions. It executes plans as code and evaluates the approach in simulated environments and on real mobile devices.

records.name: GUI-explorer: Autonomous Exploration and Mining of Transition-aware Knowledge for GUI Agent
records.summary: GUI-explorer generates exploration goals from screenshots and interface structure, then mines observation-action-outcome triples for app-specific transition knowledge. The resulting training-free agent uses this knowledge during mobile task execution, evaluated on SPA-Bench and AndroidWorld.
records.publication_search_text: GUI-explorer: Autonomous Exploration and Mining of Transition-aware Knowledge for GUI Agent 10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.282 Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers) Association for Computational Linguistics https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.282/ https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.282.pdf https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.282 Bin Xie Rui Shao Gongwei Chen Kaiwen Zhou Yinchuan Li Jie Liu Min Zhang Liqiang Nie

records.name: P2P: Automated Paper-to-Poster Generation and Fine-Grained Benchmark
TransBench: Breaking Barriers for Transferable Graphical User Interface Agents in Dynamic Digital Environments
records.summary: Introduces TransBench to evaluate GUI grounding transfer across app versions, iOS, Android, Web, and functionally distinct applications.

records.name: Automated Testing of the GUI of a Real-Life Engineering Software using Large Language Models
records.summary: GERALLT uses LLMs to explore the GUI of engineering software and produce a list of confusing or inconsistent interface areas for developers to inspect.

records.name: ProgRM: Build Better GUI Agents with Progress Rewards
records.summary: ProgRM predicts per-step task completion progress to provide intermediate rewards during online GUI-agent training. It derives progress labels by using longest common subsequences to identify key trajectory steps, allowing useful partial progress to contribute even when a trajectory ultimately fails.

records.name: LiteCUA: Computer as MCP Server for Computer-Use Agent on AIOS
records.summary: AIOS 1.0 exposes computer states and actions through an MCP server to provide structured environmental context for agents. LiteCUA is a lightweight agent built on this interface, evaluated on OSWorld to study the effect of computer-environment contextualization.

records.name: CRMArena-Pro: Holistic Assessment of LLM Agents Across Diverse Business Scenarios and Interactions
ScreenExplorer: Training a Vision-Language Model for Diverse Exploration in Open GUI World
records.summary: Trains ScreenExplorer with reinforcement learning in dynamic GUI environments, using a world-model curiosity reward and experience-stream distillation to support sustained exploration.

records.name: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
ScienceBoard: Evaluating Multimodal Autonomous Agents in Realistic Scientific Workflows
records.summary: ScienceBoard combines an interactive environment with professional scientific software and 169 human-curated tasks in areas including biochemistry, astronomy, and geoinformatics. It evaluates computer-use agents on visually rich research workflows and analyzes their execution limitations.

records.name: WebCoT: Enhancing Web Agent Reasoning by Reconstructing Chain-of-Thought in Reflection, Branching, and Rollback
records.summary: WebCoT turns reflection, look-ahead, branching and rollback procedures into chain-of-thought training rationales. Fine-tuning on these reconstructed trajectories is evaluated for web-agent self-improvement and transfer across navigation tasks.

records.name: Training LLM-Based Agents with Synthetic Self-Reflected Trajectories and Partial Masking
records.summary: Introduces STeP, which trains agents on synthetic trajectories containing error reflections and corrections while masking poor steps; WebShop is one of three evaluated tasks.

records.name: MA-RAG: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Collaborative Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
FunReason: Enhancing Large Language Models' Function Calling via Self-Refinement Multiscale Loss and Automated Data Refinement
BacktrackAgent: Enhancing GUI Agent with Error Detection and Backtracking Mechanism
records.summary: BacktrackAgent adds verification, judgment, and reflection modules to detect erroneous GUI actions and guide recovery. It develops backtracking-oriented training data that includes post-action pages and evaluates task completion and step accuracy on Mobile3M and Auto-UI.

records.name: SPA-RL: Reinforcing LLM Agents via Stepwise Progress Attribution
records.summary: Introduces SPA, a reward redistribution method for multi-step LLM agents that estimates each action’s contribution to task completion; Webshop is among its evaluations.

records.name: Agent-Environment Alignment via Automated Interface Generation
XBOUND: Exploring Capability Boundaries of Device-Control Agents at the State Level
records.summary: XBOUND evaluates GUI agents at the level of a screen state, considering multiple instructions and possible target actions within it. The study separates action matching from instruction unification and compares effects of grounding and trajectory data.

records.name: UI-Genie: A Self-Improving Approach for Iteratively Boosting MLLM-based Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: UI-Genie jointly improves a mobile GUI agent and a reward model that processes screenshots with interaction history and supplies action- and task-level feedback. Its data pipeline uses rule-based verification, corrupted trajectories, and hard negatives to support reward-guided exploration and iterative training.

records.name: Paper2Poster: Towards Multimodal Poster Automation from Scientific Papers
AdInject: Real-World Black-Box Attacks on Web Agents via Advertising Delivery
records.summary: Studies advertising delivery as an indirect-injection channel for web agents under a black-box threat model. AdInject evaluates how static ad content shaped by website context can redirect browser actions.

records.name: PreGenie: An Agentic Framework for High-quality Visual Presentation Generation
RedTeamCUA: Realistic Adversarial Testing of Computer-Use Agents in Hybrid Web-OS Environments
records.summary: RedTeamCUA combines a virtual-machine OS environment with containerized websites for controlled prompt-injection tests spanning both interfaces. Its RTC-Bench contains 864 examples and can initialize agents at injection points to separate attack susceptibility from navigation failures.

records.name: UI-Evol: Automatic Knowledge Evolving for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces UI-Evol, which extracts action sequences from agent interactions and critiques external guidance against those traces. Evaluation on OSWorld examines how revised operational knowledge affects execution and behavioral consistency.

records.name: WebDancer: Towards Autonomous Information Seeking Agency
VScan: Rethinking Visual Token Reduction for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models
WorkForceAgent-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLM-based Web Agents via Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Uses rule-based rewards for output structure and action correctness to train reasoning for enterprise web navigation.

records.name: Agent-SAMA: State-Aware Mobile Assistant
records.summary: Models mobile application execution as a finite-state machine to support planning, verification, and recovery across interface transitions.

records.name: Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Visual Reasoning
records.summary: Introduces ViGoRL, a visual reasoning model trained to reference image coordinates and zoom during reasoning; its evaluations include GUI element localization.

records.name: ZeroGUI: Automating Online GUI Learning at Zero Human Cost
records.summary: Combines generated tasks, estimated success rewards, and online reinforcement learning to automate GUI-agent interaction training.

records.name: OWL: Optimized Workforce Learning for General Multi-Agent Assistance in Real-World Task Automation
VideoCAD: A Dataset and Model for Learning Long-Horizon 3D CAD UI Interactions from Video
records.summary: Introduces synthetic CAD interaction videos, a model for learning interface actions from video, and evaluation tasks for spatial and long-horizon reasoning.

records.name: Agent-X: Evaluating Deep Multimodal Reasoning in Vision-Centric Agentic Tasks
records.summary: Introduces Agent-X, a benchmark of multi-step visual reasoning and tool use with step-level grading across six settings, including web browsing.

records.name: Open CaptchaWorld: A Comprehensive Web-based Platform for Testing and Benchmarking Multimodal LLM Agents
records.summary: Open CaptchaWorld evaluates multimodal agents on interactive browser-based CAPTCHA puzzles. Its benchmark distinguishes task success from the depth of visual reasoning and interaction needed to complete a puzzle.

records.name: ResTest: Targeted Coverage of Residual Not-Covered Code Using Large Language Models for Web GUI Testing
records.summary: Introduces ResTest, which uses coverage reports and a state transition graph to infer untested web functions, then directs a GUI agent to execute them.

records.name: RiOSWorld: Benchmarking the Risk of Multimodal Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces RiOSWorld, a computer-use risk benchmark separating user-originated and environmental threats. It evaluates both risky-goal intent and goal completion across web and other computer applications.

records.name: AgentCPM-GUI: Building Mobile-Use Agents with Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
records.summary: Combines grounding pretraining, bilingual interaction trajectories, and reinforcement fine-tuning for mobile GUI actions.

records.name: FinRobot: Generative Business Process AI Agents for Enterprise Resource Planning in Finance
FormFactory: An Interactive Benchmarking Suite for Multimodal Form-Filling Agents
records.summary: Introduces FormFactory, an interactive web-based benchmark for agents filling online forms, with varied field formats and evaluation of instruction-to-field alignment.

records.name: MLA-Trust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness of Multimodal LLM Agents in GUI Environments
records.summary: Benchmarks truthfulness, controllability, safety, and privacy of multimodal LLM agents across interactive web and mobile GUI tasks.

records.name: WebChoreArena: Evaluating Web Browsing Agents on Realistic Tedious Web Tasks
records.summary: Introduces WebChoreArena, 532 web chores built on WebArena environments to evaluate agents’ retention of page information, calculation, and tracking across pages.

records.name: Small Language Models are the Future of Agentic AI
VPI-Bench: Visual Prompt Injection Attacks for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces VPI-Bench, interactive web-platform variants containing visually embedded malicious instructions. It evaluates computer-use and browser-use agents under these threats and examines system-prompt defenses.

records.name: VerificAgent: Domain-Specific Memory Verification for Scalable Oversight of Aligned Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces VerificAgent, which grows domain-specific memories from task trajectories and subjects them to human fact-checking before deployment. Its OSWorld evaluation treats persistent memory as an auditable constraint on later agent behavior.

records.name: DeepShop: A Benchmark for Deep Research Shopping Agents
records.summary: DeepShop evaluates shopping agents with evolving query complexity across product attributes, filters and sorting preferences. Its evaluation combines checks of these individual requirements with overall task success.

records.name: Surfer-H Meets Holo1: Cost-Efficient Web Agent Powered by Open Weights
records.summary: Describes Surfer-H, a web agent paired with the Holo1 vision-language model family trained on web content, synthetic examples, and agent-generated data. The work introduces WebClick for web-interface localization and evaluates browser task execution on WebVoyager.

records.name: DPO Learning with LLMs-Judge Signal for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Uses an LLM judge to evaluate and filter synthetic GUI interaction trajectories for training a compact vision-language agent. OSWorld experiments assess the policy designed for local execution.

records.name: GUI-Actor: Coordinate-Free Visual Grounding for GUI Agents
records.summary: Uses an attention-based action head and a verifier to select relevant screen regions without generating coordinates as text.

records.name: Go-Browse: Training Web Agents with Structured Exploration
records.summary: Go-Browse frames web-environment exploration as graph search so that information can be reused across data-collection episodes. It collects 10,000 successful trajectories and 40,000 interaction steps on WebArena and uses them to fine-tune a web agent.

records.name: MiMo-VL Technical Report
records.summary: Reports MiMo-VL-7B-SFT and MiMo-VL-7B-RL, general vision-language models trained with staged pre-training and mixed RL, with GUI grounding evaluated on OSWorld-G.

records.name: Orak: A Foundational Benchmark for Training and Evaluating LLM Agents on Diverse Video Games
macOSWorld: A Multilingual Interactive Benchmark for GUI Agents
records.summary: macOSWorld provides 202 interactive tasks across 30 applications, with instructions and operating-system interfaces in five languages. It evaluates GUI agents on macOS workflows and includes a separate subset for deception-attack testing.

records.name: The Cost of Dynamic Reasoning: Demystifying AI Agents and Test-Time Scaling from an AI Infrastructure Perspective
MedAgentGym: A Scalable Agentic Training Environment for Code-Centric Reasoning in Biomedical Data Science
Look Before You Leap: A GUI-Critic-R1 Model for Pre-Operative Error Diagnosis in GUI Automation
records.summary: Uses a pre-execution critic and reinforcement training to evaluate proposed GUI actions and provide corrective suggestions before execution.

records.name: Scenario-Guided LLM-based Mobile App GUI Testing
records.summary: ScenGen organizes mobile GUI testing around business scenarios. Five collaborating agents observe the interface, choose and execute actions, check scenario completion, and record operations and runtime bugs.

records.name: Deep Research Bench: Evaluating AI Web Research Agents
records.summary: Introduces Deep Research Bench, 89 multi-step web research tasks and a frozen collection of scraped pages for evaluating search agents and their traces over time.

records.name: BIMgent: Towards Autonomous Building Modeling via Computer-use Agents
records.summary: BIMgent plans software-specific workflows and executes GUI actions for building-information modeling. It evaluates multimodal building design and reconstruction tasks in professional authoring software.

records.name: GUIPilot: A Consistency-based Mobile GUI Testing Approach for Detecting Application-specific Bugs
records.summary: Introduces GUIPilot, which compares mobile design mock-ups with implemented screens through widget alignment and tests expected transitions by executing inferred UI actions. It evaluates both visual inconsistencies and workflow-specific bugs.

records.name: MCPWorld: A Unified Benchmarking Testbed for API, GUI, and Hybrid Computer Use Agents
records.summary: MCPWorld evaluates API, GUI, and hybrid computer-use agents with 201 tasks in applications whose source can be instrumented and extended with MCP support. It verifies completion from application behavior and packages the testbed in containers with GPU support.

records.name: Thinking vs. Doing: Agents that Reason by Scaling Test-Time Interaction
records.summary: Test-Time Interaction scales the interaction horizon so web agents can explore, backtrack and revise plans within a rollout. Its online reinforcement-learning curriculum adjusts rollout lengths and is evaluated on WebVoyager and WebArena.

records.name: GUI-Reflection: Empowering Multimodal GUI Models with Self-Reflection Behavior
records.summary: GUI-Reflection synthesizes reflection and error-correction examples from successful trajectories and adds dedicated learning stages for these behaviors. It introduces a reflection task suite, a mobile environment for online data collection, and iterative reflection tuning.

records.name: EconWebArena: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents on Economic Tasks in Realistic Web Environments
records.summary: Introduces EconWebArena, a curated benchmark of economic-data tasks requiring live website navigation, multimodal interpretation, and precise extraction. It evaluates visual grounding, planning, and interaction design within multistep workflows.

records.name: Atomic-to-Compositional Generalization for Mobile Agents with A New Benchmark and Scheduling System
records.summary: UI-NEXUS evaluates compositional mobile tasks in local utility apps and online Chinese and English service apps. AGENT-NEXUS decomposes those long tasks into self-contained atomic subtasks to study generalization beyond isolated screens or short action chains.

records.name: LPO: Towards Accurate GUI Agent Interaction via Location Preference Optimization
records.summary: Location Preference Optimization uses an information-entropy signal to select interaction regions and a distance-based reward to assess click locations. It trains GUI localization through preference optimization and evaluates both offline grounding and online interaction.

records.name: Mirage-1: Augmenting and Updating GUI Agent with Hierarchical Multimodal Skills
records.summary: Mirage-1 organizes interaction trajectories into execution, core, and meta-skills, then uses them to guide Monte Carlo tree search during online GUI tasks. It introduces AndroidLH for long-horizon evaluation and tests the approach on Android and web-navigation benchmarks.

records.name: Build the web for agents, not agents for the web
records.summary: Proposes Agentic Web Interface (AWI), a website interface intended for agent navigation, and sets out six design principles for web-agent use.

records.name: UITron-Speech: Towards Automated GUI Agents Based on Speech Instructions
records.summary: Introduces UITron-Speech, which predicts GUI actions from spoken instructions and screenshots. It combines synthetic speech data and mixed-modality training with a training-free grounding refinement step.

records.name: DeepResearch Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Deep Research Agents
Poison Once, Control Anywhere: Clean-Text Visual Backdoors in VLM-based Mobile Agents
records.summary: Demonstrates clean-text visual backdoor attacks (VIBMA) that compromise fine-tuned VLM mobile agents through visual triggers while keeping text instructions intact.

records.name: xbench: Tracking Agents Productivity Scaling with Profession-Aligned Real-World Evaluations
DesignCoder: Hierarchy-Aware and Self-Correcting UI Code Generation with Large Language Models
Comprehensive Verilog Design Problems: A Next-Generation Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating Large Language Models and Agents on RTL Design and Verification
FormGym: Doing Paperwork with Agents
records.summary: Introduces FormGym, a benchmark for filling image-only forms, and FieldFinder, a tool that helps LLMs locate where to place text on those forms.

records.name: AgentSynth: Scalable Task Generation for Generalist Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: AgentSynth composes easily generated subtasks into longer computer-use tasks and trajectories with adjustable difficulty. Its evaluation uses the number of subtasks to probe how agent success changes as task complexity grows.

records.name: GUI-Robust: A Comprehensive Dataset for Testing GUI Agent Robustness in Real-World Anomalies
records.summary: Builds GUI task data with real-world interaction anomalies and evaluates how agent behavior changes under those conditions.

records.name: Improved Iterative Refinement for Chart-to-Code Generation via Structured Instruction
OS-Harm: A Benchmark for Measuring Safety of Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Extends OSWorld with tasks covering user misuse, prompt injection, and model misbehavior, with assessment of both task success and safety.

records.name: Understanding GUI Agent Localization Biases through Logit Sharpness
records.summary: Introduces a finer-grained taxonomy of GUI localization errors and a logit-based Peak Sharpness Score for analyzing coordinate-prediction uncertainty. A context-aware cropping method refines the visual input without retraining the grounding model.

records.name: Embodied Web Agents: Bridging Physical-Digital Realms for Integrated Agent Intelligence
records.summary: Introduces environments that couple 3D physical-world simulations with functional web interfaces. The accompanying benchmark evaluates tasks requiring agents to coordinate online information and physical actions across cooking, navigation and shopping scenarios.

records.name: OSWorld-Human: Benchmarking the Efficiency of Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: OSWorld-Human adds human-determined trajectories to OSWorld to evaluate the efficiency of desktop computer-use agents. The study compares 16 agents and analyzes model-call latency, changes in step duration during task execution, and excess action steps.

records.name: Seeing is Fixing: Cross-Modal Reasoning with Multimodal LLMs for Visual Software Issue Fixing
Context manipulation attacks : Web agents are susceptible to corrupted memory
records.summary: Studies context manipulation in web agents by altering stored task representations. Evaluation on Browser-use and Agent-E examines memory-directed attacks and the implications for secure context handling.

records.name: JarvisArt: Liberating Human Artistic Creativity via an Intelligent Photo Retouching Agent
Learning, Reasoning, Refinement: A Framework for Kahneman's Dual-System Intelligence in GUI Agents
records.summary: CogniGUI combines hierarchical visual parsing of interface elements with a GRPO-based grounding agent that compares alternative interaction paths. Its ScreenSeek benchmark evaluates navigation across applications, changing interface states, and consistency between interfaces.

records.name: Deep Research Agents: A Systematic Examination And Roadmap
Chain-of-Memory: Enhancing GUI Agents for Cross-Application Navigation
records.summary: Chain-of-Memory explicitly records action descriptions and task-relevant screen information in short- and long-term memory for GUI navigation. GUI Odyssey-CoM provides 111,000 screen-action pairs with memory annotations for learning and evaluating information retention across applications.

records.name: From Web Search towards Agentic Deep Research: Incentivizing Search with Reasoning Agents
Doc2Agent: Scalable Generation of Tool-Using Agents from API Documentation
records.summary: Introduces Doc2Agent, a pipeline that generates and refines Python tools from API documentation for tool-using agents, with WebArena APIs among its evaluations.

records.name: Mobile-R1: Towards Interactive Capability for VLM-Based Mobile Agent via Systematic Training
records.summary: Uses a staged curriculum from response-format alignment through action feedback to interactive task-level training for mobile agents.

records.name: Agent-RewardBench: Towards a Unified Benchmark for Reward Modeling across Perception, Planning, and Safety in Real-World Multimodal Agents
records.summary: Introduces Agent-RewardBench to evaluate step-level reward models for multimodal agents across perception, planning, and safety; web navigation is among its scenarios.

records.name: Mind2Web 2: Evaluating Agentic Search with Agent-as-a-Judge
records.summary: Introduces Mind2Web 2, 130 long-horizon tasks requiring live web browsing and information synthesis, plus an Agent-as-a-Judge framework for grading answers and sources.

records.name: ZonUI-3B: A Lightweight Vision-Language Model for Cross-Resolution GUI Grounding
records.summary: ZonUI-3B trains GUI grounding with a curated 24,000-example collection of mobile, desktop, and web screenshots. Its two-stage procedure first learns across platforms and then specializes on high-resolution images, with ablations on data diversity and redundant examples.

records.name: DABstep: Data Agent Benchmark for Multi-step Reasoning
DiMo-GUI: Advancing Test-time Scaling in GUI Grounding via Modality-Aware Visual Reasoning
records.summary: Separates textual and iconic UI elements and iteratively focuses visual regions to refine grounding without additional model training.

records.name: LineRetriever: Planning-Aware Observation Reduction for Web Agents
records.summary: LineRetriever uses a language model to select observation lines that matter for upcoming web-navigation actions. It reduces DOM or accessibility-tree context by considering the planning horizon.

records.name: SafeMobile: Chain-level Jailbreak Detection and Automated Evaluation for Multimodal Mobile Agents
records.summary: Studies chain-level risk detection for mobile multimodal agents and a language-model-assisted evaluator, assessing safety interventions together with functional preservation.

records.name: WebArxiv: A Reproducible Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Web Agents on arXiv Tasks
records.summary: WebArxiv provides 510 static-snapshot tasks with deterministic answers for scholarly browsing, including constrained paper retrieval, content extraction, and cross-paper comparison. The study also tests dynamic retrieval of interaction history to address repetitive or incomplete agent reasoning.

records.name: GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-Thinking: Towards Versatile Multimodal Reasoning with Scalable Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Reports the GLM-4.1V-Thinking, GLM-4.5V, and GLM-4.6V vision-language model family and curriculum-based RL training, with GUI agents among its evaluated tasks.

records.name: WebSailor: Navigating Super-human Reasoning for Web Agent
Establishing Best Practices for Building Rigorous Agentic Benchmarks
RAG-R1: Incentivizing the Search and Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs through Multi-query Parallelism
Less is More: Empowering GUI Agent with Context-Aware Simplification
records.summary: SimpAgent prunes distracting interface elements with visual masks and compresses interaction history using consistency-based guidance. The study evaluates these two forms of context reduction during GUI navigation in web and mobile environments.

records.name: How to Train Your LLM Web Agent: A Statistical Diagnosis
records.summary: Studies compute allocation for web-agent post-training with teacher-generated supervised fine-tuning followed by on-policy reinforcement learning. It samples 1,370 training configurations and uses bootstrap analysis to examine hyperparameter sensitivity on WorkArena and MiniWoB++.

records.name: Mobile GUI Agents under Real-world Threats: Are We There Yet?
records.summary: Introduces an app-content instrumentation framework and complementary interactive and static test suites for mobile GUI agents. It studies how untrusted third-party content changes task execution and state understanding.

records.name: WebSynthesis: World-Model-Guided MCTS for Efficient WebUI-Trajectory Synthesis
records.summary: Introduces WebSynthesis, which uses a learned web world model and tree-based planning to synthesize interaction trajectories for training web agents.

records.name: ArtifactsBench: Bridging the Visual-Interactive Gap in LLM Code Generation Evaluation
A Systematization of Security Vulnerabilities in Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Analyzes security boundaries in computer-use agents through a risk taxonomy and concrete adversarial case studies. It links observed failures to input provenance, interface-action binding, memory, and delegation, and proposes CUA-specific evaluation principles.

records.name: R-VLM: Region-Aware Vision Language Model for Precise GUI Grounding
records.summary: R-VLM localizes GUI elements through zoomed-in region proposals and an intersection-over-union-aware training objective. It evaluates the grounding model on ScreenSpot and AgentStudio and studies its effect on navigation in AITW and Mind2Web.

records.name: MobileGUI-RL: Advancing Mobile GUI Agent through Reinforcement Learning in Online Environment
records.summary: MobileGUI-RL constructs an online training curriculum through agent exploration and task filtering. It adapts GRPO with trajectory-aware advantages and rewards for task completion and execution efficiency, evaluated on three online mobile-agent benchmarks.

records.name: GTA1: GUI Test-time Scaling Agent
records.summary: GTA1 samples multiple action proposals at each GUI step and uses a judge to select among them. A separate grounding model is trained with reinforcement learning to map selected proposals to visual targets, linking planning-time search with click localization.

records.name: OpenAgentSafety: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Real-World AI Agent Safety
records.summary: Evaluates agent safety across real browser, code, filesystem, shell, and messaging tools using rule-based and model-based assessments.

records.name: VisualTrap: A Stealthy Backdoor Attack on GUI Agents via Visual Grounding Manipulation
records.summary: Studies backdoors that redirect GUI visual grounding even when the task plan is correct. VisualTrap evaluates whether poisoned grounding training transfers to downstream tasks and across web, mobile, and desktop interface settings.

records.name: A Training-Free, Task-Agnostic Framework for Enhancing MLLM Performance on High-Resolution Images
records.summary: Introduces Extract Candidate then Predict (ECP), a training-free two-stage method for high-resolution images, evaluated partly on 4K GUI grounding.

records.name: LaSM: Layer-wise Scaling Mechanism for Defending Pop-up Attack on GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces LaSM, a training-free defense that selectively scales attention and MLP components to improve alignment with task-relevant screen regions. It evaluates the approach against pop-up-based GUI injection attacks.

records.name: From Multi-Agent Systems and the Semantic Web to Agentic AI: A Unified Narrative of the Web of Agents
DrafterBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Tasks Automation in Civil Engineering
Let's Think in Two Steps: Mitigating Agreement Bias in MLLMs with Self-Grounded Verification
records.summary: Studies agreement bias in multimodal agent verifiers across web navigation and computer use, and introduces SGV to assess trajectories using self-generated priors.

records.name: Machine-Readable Ads: Accessibility and Trust Patterns for AI Web Agents interacting with Online Advertisements
records.summary: Compares DOM-based and pixel-based web agents on a cloned news site containing advertisements, consent dialogs and paywalls. The study examines how interface presentation affects ad interaction and consequential subscription choices.

records.name: WebGuard: Building a Generalizable Guardrail for Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces WebGuard, a human-annotated dataset for predicting outcomes and risk levels of state-changing website actions. It provides generalization splits and evaluates specialized guardrail models.

records.name: Routine: A Structural Planning Framework for LLM Agent System in Enterprise
Manipulating LLM Web Agents with Indirect Prompt Injection Attack via HTML Accessibility Tree
records.summary: Studies indirect prompt injection through HTML content consumed as accessibility trees. The evaluation tests how manipulated page observations redirect browser-agent actions on real websites.

records.name: WebShaper: Agentically Data Synthesizing via Information-Seeking Formalization
GUI-G$^2$: Gaussian Reward Modeling for GUI Grounding
records.summary: GUI-G2 replaces binary grounding rewards with Gaussian point rewards and spatial-coverage rewards. An adaptive variance tied to element dimensions supplies continuous training feedback for targets of different sizes, evaluated on the ScreenSpot benchmark family.

records.name: AlgoTune: Can Language Models Speed Up General-Purpose Numerical Programs?
TaxCalcBench: Evaluating Frontier Models on the Tax Calculation Task
Screen2AX: Vision-Based Approach for Automatic macOS Accessibility Generation
records.summary: Introduces Screen2AX, which creates hierarchical accessibility metadata from macOS screenshots, plus datasets and Screen2AX-Task for desktop-agent evaluation.

records.name: MobileUse: A GUI Agent with Hierarchical Reflection for Autonomous Mobile Operation
records.summary: MobileUse reflects on errors at action and task timescales, invoking reflection when needed and using proactive exploration to learn unfamiliar apps. It evaluates this mobile execution framework on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab and describes a toolkit for physical-device operation.

records.name: ProactiveVA: Proactive Visual Analytics with LLM-Based UI Agent
records.summary: Studies proactive assistance in visual-analytics interfaces, using interaction logs to detect support needs and provide context-aware suggestions and guidance.

records.name: OS-MAP: How Far Can Computer-Using Agents Go in Breadth and Depth?
records.summary: OS-MAP organizes 416 computer-use tasks across 15 applications by a five-level automation taxonomy and a hierarchy of user demands. The benchmark separates required autonomy from generalization scope to diagnose where agents struggle as task demands increase.

records.name: MMBench-GUI: Hierarchical Multi-Platform Evaluation Framework for GUI Agents
records.summary: MMBench-GUI evaluates interface understanding, element grounding, task automation, and collaboration across six named desktop, mobile, and web platforms. It introduces the Efficiency-Quality Area metric for examining execution efficiency alongside task quality in online GUI automation.

records.name: Learning Only with Images: Visual Reinforcement Learning with Reasoning, Rendering, and Visual Feedback
FingerTip 20K: A Benchmark for Proactive and Personalized Mobile LLM Agents
records.summary: FingerTip 20K gathers 20K human Android demonstrations from users' long-term everyday app use, with user context, to evaluate proactive task suggestion and preference-aware task execution.

records.name: MapAgent: Trajectory-Constructed Memory-Augmented Planning for Mobile Task Automation
records.summary: Builds reusable page memories from past mobile trajectories and retrieves them to support task planning and execution.

records.name: UI-AGILE: Advancing GUI Agents with Effective Reinforcement Learning and Precise Inference-Time Grounding
records.summary: Combines grounding-oriented reward and sampling improvements with inference-time image decomposition and target selection.

records.name: Magentic-UI: Towards Human-in-the-loop Agentic Systems
records.summary: Magentic-UI combines browser interaction, code execution, file operations, and MCP tools in an interface for human-agent collaboration. It studies collaborative planning and task execution, action guards, and persistent memory through benchmark tasks, simulated users, user studies, and safety assessments.

records.name: General Agentic Planning Through Simulative Reasoning with World Models
records.summary: Introduces SiRA, an agent architecture that uses a language-based world model to simulate action outcomes for planning in web-browser tasks.

records.name: Phi-Ground Tech Report: Advancing Perception in GUI Grounding
records.summary: Reports a GUI-grounding model family and empirical design choices covering source data, perception training, and coordinate prediction.

records.name: Measuring Harmfulness of Computer-Using Agents
records.summary: Introduces CUAHarm, 104 computer-use misuse tasks in a sandbox with verifiable rewards, and studies whether language models can monitor unsafe agent actions.

records.name: CADDesigner: Conceptual CAD Model Generation with a General-Purpose Agent
NaturalGAIA: A Verifiable Benchmark and Hierarchical Framework for Long-Horizon GUI Tasks
records.summary: NaturalGAIA builds verifiable long-horizon GUI tasks from human interaction intents while separating causal task structure from its verbal description. Its LightManus-Jarvis framework divides dynamic planning and context management from execution based on visual and structural interface information.

records.name: Web-CogReasoner: Towards Multimodal Knowledge-Induced Cognitive Reasoning for Web Agents
records.summary: Web-CogReasoner separates factual and conceptual web knowledge from procedural reasoning, using a structured curriculum to train a multimodal agent. Web-CogDataset and Web-CogBench support study of these capabilities alongside web-navigation evaluation.

records.name: NaviMaster: Learning a Unified Policy for GUI and Embodied Navigation Tasks
records.summary: NaviMaster trains a shared policy for GUI and embodied navigation using a common visual-trajectory formulation. It combines trajectory collection, reinforcement learning and distance-aware rewards, with evaluation across both task families.

records.name: HyCodePolicy: Hybrid Language Controllers for Multimodal Monitoring and Decision in Embodied Agents
Web3 x AI Agents: Landscape, Integrations, and Foundational Challenges
Evolution of AI Agent Registry Solutions: Centralized, Enterprise, and Distributed Approaches
Using the NANDA Index Architecture in Practice: An Enterprise Perspective
Agent Lightning: Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning
MagicGUI: A Foundational Mobile GUI Agent with Scalable Data Pipeline and Reinforcement Fine-tuning
records.summary: Combines a mobile GUI data pipeline, perception and planning capabilities, and reinforcement fine-tuning for interactive task execution.

records.name: CoAct-1: Computer-using Multi-Agent System with Coding Actions
records.summary: CoAct-1 delegates subtasks between a GUI operator and a programmer that executes Python or Bash. Its OSWorld evaluation studies a hybrid action space in which scripts handle suitable file and data operations while visual interaction handles other steps.

records.name: HarmonyGuard: Toward Safety and Utility in Web Agents via Adaptive Policy Enhancement and Dual-Objective Optimization
records.summary: Introduces HarmonyGuard, a multi-agent framework that updates security policies and weighs safety against task completion for agents operating on the open web.

records.name: Uncertainty-Aware GUI Agent: Adaptive Perception through Component Recommendation and Human-in-the-Loop Refinement
records.summary: RecAgent narrows attention to recommended UI components and requests user feedback when task intent or decisions remain uncertain. It introduces ComplexAction to evaluate specified single-step GUI actions in difficult interface scenarios.

records.name: VeriWeb: Verifiable Long-Chain Web Benchmark for Agentic Information-Seeking
records.summary: Introduces VeriWeb, a benchmark of long-chain web information-seeking tasks with verifiable subtasks and a complete human-annotated trajectory for each task.

records.name: Evolving in Tasks: Empowering the Multi-modality Large Language Model as the Computer Use Agent
records.summary: The Self-Evolution Agent combines automatic generation of verifiable computer-use trajectories with step-wise reinforcement learning for long-horizon training. It also describes a model-enhancement procedure that integrates grounding and planning capabilities without an additional training stage.

records.name: GuirlVG: Incentivize GUI Visual Grounding via Empirical Exploration on Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Introduces GuirlVG, an empirical study of reinforcement fine-tuning for GUI visual grounding. It analyzes training components and adds an adaptive KL-based mechanism to limit reward over-optimization.

records.name: Beyond Pixels: Exploring DOM Downsampling for LLM-Based Web Agents
records.summary: D2Snap reduces serialized DOM observations while preserving actionable elements and features that distinguish their uses. The study compares reduced DOM inputs with screenshot-based observations for a web agent on tasks sampled from Online-Mind2Web.

records.name: OS Agents: A Survey on MLLM-based Agents for General Computing Devices Use
records.summary: Surveys agents that operate computers and phones through operating-system interfaces, covering components, capabilities, foundation models, frameworks, and benchmarks.

records.name: SEAgent: Self-Evolving Computer Use Agent with Autonomous Learning from Experience
records.summary: SEAgent explores unfamiliar software using a world-state assessor and an automatically generated task curriculum. It learns from failed and successful interactions through adversarial imitation and GRPO, then combines specialist experience into a generalist agent evaluated on five OSWorld software environments.

records.name: Cognitive Duality for Adaptive Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces CogniWeb, which switches between fast reactive processing and slower deliberative reasoning according to task complexity. WebArena experiments examine this combination of learned behaviors and online planning.

records.name: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for GUI Grounding via Region Consistency
records.summary: GUI-RC aggregates multiple grounding predictions into spatial voting grids to choose a consensus region. GUI-RCPO then turns agreement with that region into a reward for test-time policy updates on unlabeled GUI screenshots.

records.name: InfiGUI-G1: Advancing GUI Grounding with Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization
records.summary: Uses multiple candidate answers and adaptive exploration rewards to improve spatial and semantic alignment in GUI grounding.

records.name: WebWatcher: Breaking New Frontier of Vision-Language Deep Research Agent
BrowseComp-Plus: A More Fair and Transparent Evaluation Benchmark of Deep-Research Agent
DatasetResearch: Benchmarking Agent Systems for Demand-Driven Dataset Discovery
MVISU-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Agents for Real-World Tasks by Multi-App, Vague, Interactive, Single-App and Unethical Instructions
records.summary: MVISU-Bench evaluates bilingual mobile tasks involving cross-app work, vague requests, user interaction and unethical instructions alongside ordinary single-app tasks. Its Aider prompting module is designed to clarify intent and mitigate risky execution within agent workflows.

records.name: OpenCUA: Open Foundations for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Presents demonstration collection infrastructure, the AgentNet dataset, and a training pipeline for open computer-use models.

records.name: OdysseyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Complex Office Application Workflows
records.summary: Introduces OdysseyBench for evaluating long-horizon workflows across office applications, plus HomerAgents to generate tasks from environment exploration and dialogue synthesis.

records.name: FineState-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Fine-Grained State Control in GUI Agents
records.summary: FineState-Bench evaluates fine-grained GUI perception and control across desktop, web, and mobile interfaces. Its Visual Diagnostic Assistant separates perception and localization contributions in controlled interaction experiments.

records.name: SC2Arena and StarEvolve: Benchmark and Self-Improvement Framework for LLMs in Complex Decision-Making Tasks
UI-Venus Technical Report: Building High-performance UI Agents with RFT
records.summary: Studies screenshot-based GUI grounding and navigation using curated interaction data, reward design, and reinforcement fine-tuning.

records.name: CRAFT-GUI: Curriculum-Reinforced Agent For GUI Tasks
records.summary: CRAFT-GUI organizes GUI trajectories by difficulty for curriculum-based GRPO training. Its reward combines rule-based signals with model judgments, with evaluation on Android Control and an internal online benchmark.

records.name: WebMall -- A Multi-Shop Benchmark for Evaluating Web Agents
records.summary: WebMall provides four simulated online shops with heterogeneous product data for comparison shopping, related-product searches, and checkout tasks. It evaluates web agents with different observation formats and memory configurations in a fixed offline environment.

records.name: Chain-of-Agents: End-to-End Agent Foundation Models via Multi-Agent Distillation and Agentic RL
MM-BrowseComp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Browsing Agents
records.summary: Introduces MM-BrowseComp, a benchmark for browsing agents that must use evidence from web images and videos to answer multimodal search questions.

records.name: V2P: Visual Attention Calibration for GUI Grounding via Background Suppression and Center Peaking
records.summary: V2P trains GUI grounding by suppressing attention to background regions and emphasizing the center of the target element. It represents target importance with size-dependent Gaussian heatmaps and evaluates the contribution of each component on ScreenSpot-v2 and ScreenSpot-Pro.

records.name: BetaWeb: Towards a Blockchain-enabled Trustworthy Agentic Web
ComputerRL: Scaling End-to-End Online Reinforcement Learning for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Combines API and GUI actions with distributed desktop reinforcement learning and alternating supervised training to address training instability.

records.name: You Don't Know Until You Click:Automated GUI Testing for Production-Ready Software Evaluation
records.summary: RealDevWorld evaluates generated software repositories with 194 development tasks and AppEvalPilot, an agent judge that operates the resulting GUIs. The evaluation examines functional behavior, visual fidelity, and runtime responses to produce task-specific diagnostic feedback.

records.name: Mobile-Agent-v3: Fundamental Agents for GUI Automation
records.summary: Introduces GUI-Owl models and Mobile-Agent-v3 orchestration, using environment-generated trajectories to support GUI capabilities.

records.name: See it. Say it. Sorted: Agentic System for Compositional Diagram Generation
ReportBench: Evaluating Deep Research Agents via Academic Survey Tasks
A Functionality-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating Web Agents in E-commerce Domains
records.summary: Amazon-Bench generates functionality-specific web tasks from page content and interactive controls, covering operations beyond product search. Its evaluator checks task completion and unintended changes to account state, such as address or purchase settings.

records.name: Memento: Fine-tuning LLM Agents without Fine-tuning LLMs
Structuring GUI Elements through Vision Language Models: Towards Action Space Generation
records.summary: Introduces IAML training, which augments coordinate samples to help multimodal models locate GUI elements from screen content and user instructions.

records.name: WebMMU: A Benchmark for Multimodal Multilingual Website Understanding and Code Generation
records.summary: Introduces WebMMU, a multilingual benchmark for website visual question answering, element grounding, code editing, and mockup-to-code generation.

records.name: WebSight: A Vision-First Architecture for Robust Web Agents
records.summary: WebSight uses a vision-language model trained on web-interface examples within a modular agent with planning, action, verification, and episodic memory components. It evaluates element clicking on Showdown Clicks and full browsing tasks on WebVoyager using visual observations.

records.name: DashboardQA: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Question Answering on Interactive Dashboards
records.summary: Introduces DashboardQA to evaluate how vision-language GUI agents answer questions by interacting with dashboards, grounding elements, and planning actions.

Rizwan Parvez Enamul Hoque Shafiq Joty

records.name: PerPilot: Personalizing VLM-based Mobile Agents via Memory and Exploration
records.summary: Introduces PerPilot and the PerInstruct dataset for completing user-specific mobile instructions through memory retrieval, app exploration, and clarification when missing context remains unresolved.

records.name: InternVL3.5: Advancing Open-Source Multimodal Models in Versatility, Reasoning, and Efficiency
records.summary: Introduces InternVL3.5, a multimodal model family trained with Cascade RL and designed for more efficient inference; GUI interaction is among its stated capabilities.

records.name: Experiences with Model Context Protocol Servers for Science and High Performance Computing
AppAgent-Pro: A Proactive GUI Agent System for Multidomain Information Integration and User Assistance
records.summary: Proposes a proactive GUI assistant that gathers information across domains in response to user requests and anticipated information needs.

records.name: Reliable Weak-to-Strong Monitoring of LLM Agents
records.summary: Introduces CUA-SHADE-Arena and a red-teaming workflow for testing monitors that detect covert misbehavior in computer-use agent trajectories.

records.name: Mind the Third Eye! Benchmarking Privacy Awareness in MLLM-powered Smartphone Agents
records.summary: Introduces SAPA-Bench with 7,138 smartphone scenarios to evaluate whether MLLM-powered mobile agents detect and protect sensitive personal information on screen.

records.name: InquireMobile: Teaching VLM-based Mobile Agent to Request Human Assistance via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
records.summary: InquireMobile trains mobile agents to seek human confirmation at critical decisions using staged reinforcement fine-tuning and pre-action reasoning. InquireBench evaluates safe interaction and proactive inquiry, distinguishing asking for help from completing the underlying task.

records.name: SWIRL: A Staged Workflow for Interleaved Reinforcement Learning in Mobile GUI Control
records.summary: Introduces SWIRL, staged interleaved RL for mobile GUI control, pairing a Navigator that plans from screens and language with an Interactor that produces actions.

records.name: CODA: Coordinating the Cerebrum and Cerebellum for a Dual-Brain Computer Use Agent with Decoupled Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: CODA combines a generalist planner with a specialist GUI executor and trains application-specific planners through decoupled GRPO. Successful specialist trajectories then support supervised training of a consolidated planner, evaluated across four ScienceBoard applications.

records.name: UI-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Design Capabilities of AI Text-to-App Tools
Morae: Proactively Pausing UI Agents for User Choices
records.summary: Introduces Morae, a UI agent that detects decision points and pauses for user choices using interface code and screenshots. A study with blind and low-vision participants evaluates this mixed-initiative approach on real web tasks.

records.name: MMSearch-Plus: Benchmarking Provenance-Aware Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents
records.summary: Introduces MMSearch-Plus, a multimodal browsing benchmark with iterative image-text search, and an agent framework that marks and crops images for targeted retrieval.

records.name: UItron: Foundational GUI Agent with Advanced Perception and Planning
records.summary: UItron combines GUI perception and planning data engineering with supervised training and curriculum reinforcement learning in connected mobile and PC environments. It also collects more than one million operation steps across 100 Chinese apps and builds offline and online evaluation environments.

records.name: KG-RAG: Enhancing GUI Agent Decision-Making via Knowledge Graph-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation
records.summary: KG-RAG converts UI transition graphs into a searchable vector store and uses intent-guided retrieval to construct actionable navigation paths. It introduces KG-Android-Bench and KG-Harmony-Bench and evaluates transfer from mobile apps to web and desktop tasks.

records.name: MobiAgent: A Systematic Framework for Customizable Mobile Agents
records.summary: Presents MobiAgent, combining MobiMind agent models, the AgentRR acceleration framework, and MobiFlow evaluation. It also introduces an AI-assisted data-collection pipeline for mobile GUI tasks.

records.name: FlashAdventure: A Benchmark for GUI Agents Solving Full Story Arcs in Diverse Adventure Games
records.summary: FlashAdventure evaluates GUI agents on completing story arcs in 34 adventure games. It pairs an automated gameplay judge with COAST, a framework that keeps long-term clue memory to plan and complete sequential objectives.

records.name: Throttling Web Agents Using Reasoning Gates
records.summary: Introduces reasoning gates that require agents to solve generated, verifiable puzzles before receiving access to resources. The throttling approach is deployed on a custom website and MCP servers and evaluated with web agents.

records.name: Succeed or Learn Slowly: Sample Efficient Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Mobile App Control
records.summary: Succeed or Learn Slowly applies direct off-policy updates to successful interactions and more conservative regularized updates to negative examples. Successful Transition Replay prioritizes successful experience during policy learning, with evaluation on AndroidWorld.

records.name: OmniActor: A Generalist GUI and Embodied Agent for 2D&3D Worlds
records.summary: Introduces OmniActor, which shares shallow model layers while separating deeper parameters to train jointly on GUI and embodied interactions. A unified action representation and mixed training data support evaluation in both task families.

records.name: AppCopilot: Toward General, Accurate, Long-Horizon, and Efficient Mobile Agent
records.summary: Describes a mobile-agent stack combining region-based coordinate correction, hierarchical task planning, multi-agent voting, and reuse of successful interaction traces.

records.name: UI-TARS-2 Technical Report: Advancing GUI Agent with Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: UI-TARS-2 combines scalable trajectory generation, stabilized multi-turn reinforcement learning, and a sandbox that supports GUI, filesystem, and terminal actions. The report evaluates the resulting agent across web, desktop, Android, and game tasks and analyzes training stability.

records.name: The Landscape of Agentic Reinforcement Learning for LLMs: A Survey
PG-Agent: An Agent Powered by Page Graph
records.summary: Introduces PG-Agent, which turns GUI operation episodes into page graphs and retrieves guidance from them to support task decomposition in new scenarios.

records.name: MobileRAG: Enhancing Mobile Agent with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
records.summary: MobileRAG combines retrieval and memory components to support mobile tasks that need external knowledge or long action sequences. MobileRAG-Eval is introduced to study these requirements on complex real-world app tasks.

records.name: Are LLM Agents the New RPA? A Comparative Study with RPA Across Enterprise Workflows
records.summary: Compares an agent using computer interfaces with UiPath RPA on enterprise data entry, monitoring, and document extraction, measuring speed, reliability, and development effort.

records.name: Learning Active Perception via Self-Evolving Preference Optimization for GUI Grounding
records.summary: LASER builds preference data for multi-step GUI perception by combining Monte Carlo quality estimates with region-overlap evaluation. Its self-evolving training encourages relevant region selection and adapts the amount of reasoning before predicting screen coordinates.

records.name: SparkUI-Parser: Enhancing GUI Perception with Robust Grounding and Parsing
records.summary: Introduces SparkUI-Parser, which adds continuous coordinate decoding and a rejection mechanism for nonexistent targets to a multimodal model. It also presents ScreenParse for evaluating structural interface perception.

records.name: Multi-IaC-Eval: Benchmarking Cloud Infrastructure as Code Across Multiple Formats
Decoding Latent Attack Surfaces in LLMs: Prompt Injection via HTML in Web Summarization
GeoAnalystBench: A GeoAI benchmark for assessing large language models for spatial analysis workflow and code generation
PillagerBench: Benchmarking LLM-Based Agents in Competitive Minecraft Team Environments
MAS-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Shortcut-Augmented Hybrid Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: MAS-Bench evaluates mobile agents that combine GUI actions with APIs, deep links, and reusable scripts. Its 139 tasks across 11 apps test use of 88 predefined shortcuts as well as the ability to generate new reusable workflows.

records.name: WebExplorer: Explore and Evolve for Training Long-Horizon Web Agents
Instruction Agent: Enhancing Agent with Expert Demonstration
records.summary: Introduces Instruction Agent, a GUI agent that follows instructions extracted from one expert demonstration and uses verification and backtracking to handle interruptions.

records.name: VeriOS: Query-Driven Proactive Human-Agent-GUI Interaction for Trustworthy OS Agents
records.summary: Introduces VeriOS-Agent, which learns when to execute GUI actions autonomously and when to query a user under untrustworthy conditions. Its staged training combines supervised learning and group-relative policy optimization.

records.name: AgentSentinel: An End-to-End and Real-Time Security Defense Framework for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces AgentSentinel, which intercepts sensitive computer-agent operations and audits them using task context together with system traces. BadComputerUse evaluates this enforcement approach across attack scenarios involving tool and computer control.

records.name: AgentGym-RL: Training LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Decision Making through Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
Towards Adaptive ML Benchmarks: Web-Agent-Driven Construction, Domain Expansion, and Metric Optimization
Towards Understanding Visual Grounding in Visual Language Models
Dark Patterns Meet GUI Agents: LLM Agent Susceptibility to Manipulative Interfaces and the Role of Human Oversight
records.summary: Studies how GUI agents, people, and human-agent teams respond to manipulative interface designs. The two-phase evaluation examines failure modes and the benefits and costs of human oversight.

records.name: Agentic Lybic: Multi-Agent Execution System with Tiered Reasoning and Orchestration
records.summary: Introduces Agentic Lybic, a desktop automation system that routes tasks among GUI, code, and decision-support workers using a finite-state machine and evaluator.

records.name: Environmental Injection Attacks against GUI Agents in Realistic Dynamic Environments
records.summary: Introduces Chameleon, an environmental-injection evaluation framework that varies webpage content and trigger context. It combines simulated page variation with attention-based optimization and tests GUI agents across realistic websites.

records.name: UI-S1: Advancing GUI Automation via Semi-online Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: UI-S1 simulates multi-turn online learning over offline trajectories, using a patch module to recover divergences while retaining the model’s own outputs in context. It combines discounted future returns with step- and episode-level advantages and introduces a semi-online performance proxy.

records.name: How Auxiliary Reasoning Unleashes GUI Grounding in VLMs
records.summary: Studies the gap between latent visual grounding and explicit coordinate output in general vision-language models. Three zero-shot methods add axes, grids, or labeled intersections to GUI screenshots so models can express spatial locations without fine-tuning.

records.name: PrivWeb: Unobtrusive and Content-aware Privacy Protection For Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces PrivWeb, which uses a local language model to anonymize interface information according to user preferences. Adaptive notifications and selective pauses give users control over sensitive information access during web-agent tasks.

records.name: WebSailor-V2: Bridging the Chasm to Proprietary Agents via Synthetic Data and Scalable Reinforcement Learning
WebResearcher: Unleashing unbounded reasoning capability in Long-Horizon Agents
Towards General Agentic Intelligence via Environment Scaling
WebWeaver: Structuring Web-Scale Evidence with Dynamic Outlines for Open-Ended Deep Research
ReSum: Unlocking Long-Horizon Search Intelligence via Context Summarization
records.summary: Introduces ReSum, which compresses interaction histories during long web searches, and ReSum-GRPO, which trains agents to reason across the resulting segments.

records.name: See, Think, Act: Teaching Multimodal Agents to Effectively Interact with GUI by Identifying Toggles
records.summary: Introduces a benchmark for binary GUI-toggle instructions and State-aware Reasoning, which compares the observed control state with the requested state before choosing an action. It evaluates agents on toggle tasks and broader interactive benchmarks.

records.name: InfraMind: A Novel Exploration-based GUI Agentic Framework for Mission-critical Industrial Management
records.summary: InfraMind explores industrial management GUIs using virtual-machine snapshots and builds memory for planning and hierarchical state recognition. Its framework also studies knowledge distillation and safety checks on open-source and commercial data-center management platforms.

records.name: TGPO: Tree-Guided Preference Optimization for Robust Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: TGPO merges semantically equivalent web states into tree-structured trajectories for offline preference optimization. A process reward model scores subgoal progress, redundant behavior, and action validity, while dynamic weighting emphasizes consequential decisions.

records.name: Detecting Pipeline Failures through Fine-Grained Analysis of Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces a modular framework for identifying errors at intermediate stages of a web-agent pipeline. A SeeAct and Mind2Web case study examines weaknesses that are obscured by final task-success metrics.

records.name: OpenLens AI: Fully Autonomous Research Agent for Health Infomatics
ScaleCUA: Scaling Open-Source Computer Use Agents with Cross-Platform Data
records.summary: Introduces a cross-platform computer-use dataset and agents trained with a collection pipeline combining automated interaction and human input.

records.name: GUI-ARP: Enhancing Grounding with Adaptive Region Perception for GUI Agents
records.summary: GUI-ARP uses visual attention to crop relevant screenshot regions and decides whether a target needs single-stage or multi-stage analysis. Supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO trains this adaptive procedure for high-resolution GUI grounding.

records.name: BTL-UI: Blink-Think-Link Reasoning Model for GUI Agent
records.summary: BTL-UI separates GUI interaction into screen-region attention, planning and executable-command generation. It adds an automated annotation pipeline and rule-based process/outcome rewards for training, with evaluation on both static understanding and dynamic interaction.

records.name: GUI-ReWalk: Massive Data Generation for GUI Agent via Stochastic Exploration and Intent-Aware Reasoning
records.summary: GUI-ReWalk begins with stochastic interface exploration and then infers goals to generate coherent action trajectories. It supports long-horizon workflows across applications and studies training on the resulting data using grounding and navigation benchmarks.

records.name: Toward Engineering AGI: Benchmarking the Engineering Design Capabilities of LLMs
UIPro: Unleashing Superior Interaction Capability For GUI Agents
records.summary: UIPro pretrains GUI understanding on 20.6 million tasks and then harmonizes interaction datasets through a unified action space. Continued fine-tuning uses the merged multi-platform data to train action prediction for generalist GUI operation.

records.name: Mano Technical Report
records.summary: Introduces Mano, a GUI agent trained with simulated data, supervised fine-tuning, and offline and online RL, with a verification module for error recovery.

records.name: Orcust: Stepwise-Feedback Reinforcement Learning for GUI Agent
records.summary: Orcust combines principle-constrained reward modeling with GUI trajectory collection in instrumented virtual machines. Environment-checkable and model-derived principles guide stepwise feedback for grounding, basic operations, and complete task execution.

records.name: MobileRL: Online Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: MobileRL adapts GRPO to mobile GUI training with difficulty-dependent replay of successes and filtering of failure curricula. A shortest-path reward adjustment accounts for task length, with evaluations on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.

records.name: Robotic Ultra-Long-Horizon Manipulation Skills via Human-guided Lifelong Code Generation
Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Step Rewards
records.summary: Introduces iStar, a general agentic RL method that learns implicit step rewards; WebShop is one of several interactive benchmarks used to evaluate it.

records.name: Robust, Observable, and Evolvable Agentic Systems Engineering: A Principled Framework Validated via the Fairy GUI Agent
records.summary: Presents an agent-engineering framework combining runtime goal clarification, an observable component architecture and evolving execution memory. The Fairy mobile GUI agent evaluates these mechanisms on ambiguous tasks and through controlled and user studies.

records.name: Recon-Act: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Browser-Use System via Web Reconnaissance, Tool Generation, and Task Execution
records.summary: Introduces Recon-Act, a browser-use framework that compares failed and successful web trajectories to create reusable tools for planning and executing long-horizon website tasks.

records.name: Automotive-ENV: Benchmarking Multimodal Models in Automotive Cockpit Environments
