Learning GUI Grounding with Spatial Reasoning from Visual Feedback
records.summary: GUI-Cursor treats GUI grounding as a sequence of cursor movements guided by visible feedback and movement history. Online reinforcement learning with trajectory rewards trains the model to refine the target location across multiple steps.

records.name: UISim: An Interactive Image-Based UI Simulator for Dynamic Mobile Environments
records.summary: Introduces UISim, an image-based mobile UI simulator that predicts the next screen layout after an action and renders the resulting screen for testing and data generation.

records.name: Benchmarking MLLM-based Web Understanding: Reasoning, Robustness and Safety
records.summary: Evaluates multimodal LLMs on web interface reasoning, visual perturbation robustness, and safety-critical web understanding tasks.

records.name: D-Artemis: A Deliberative Cognitive Framework for Mobile GUI Multi-Agents
records.summary: Introduces D-Artemis, a mobile GUI agent framework that retrieves app-specific tips, checks actions before execution, and reflects on their outcomes without trajectory training.

records.name: ProRe: A Proactive Reward System for GUI Agents via Reasoner-Actor Collaboration
records.summary: ProRe evaluates GUI task outcomes by having a reasoner assign targeted environment-probing tasks to specialist actors. The additional observations support reward judgments, with separate evaluation of judge accuracy and downstream agent task success.

records.name: RISK: A Framework for GUI Agents in E-commerce Risk Management
records.summary: RISK combines browser-interaction training data, a benchmark, and reinforcement fine-tuning for e-commerce risk-management workflows. Its trajectories and rewards distinguish individual actions from multi-step stateful tasks involving deeply embedded web content.

records.name: Leveraging LLM Agents for Automated Video Game Testing
Secure and Efficient Access Control for Computer-Use Agents via Context Space
records.summary: Introduces CSAgent, which combines static access policies with user intent and context and enforces them through an operating-system service. A supporting toolchain constructs and refines policies for agents using API, CLI and GUI interfaces.

records.name: WebGen-Agent: Enhancing Interactive Website Generation with Multi-Level Feedback and Step-Level Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Introduces WebGen-Agent for website code generation, using screenshot critiques and GUI-agent tests to refine code and provide step-level training rewards.

records.name: GUI-PRA: Process Reward Agent for GUI Tasks
records.summary: GUI-PRA evaluates GUI progress by generating task-specific criteria and actively inspecting visual evidence with tools. It tests offline judgment on OS-Critic Bench and the effects of this feedback on online mobile policies in AndroidWorld.

records.name: SafeSearch: Automated Red-Teaming of LLM-Based Search Agents
GUI-Shepherd: Reliable Process Reward and Verification for Long-Sequence GUI Tasks
records.summary: Introduces GUI-Shepherd, a process reward model trained on annotated GUI interactions to give step-level feedback for agent training and verification on AndroidWorld and AndroidControl.

records.name: Efficient Multi-turn RL for GUI Agents via Decoupled Training and Adaptive Data Curation
records.summary: DART separates GUI reinforcement learning into asynchronous environment, rollout, data-management, and training services. It curates experience by task difficulty, successful trajectories, and step uncertainty while correcting rollout-policy mismatch, with evaluation on OSWorld.

records.name: Generalist Scanner Meets Specialist Locator: A Synergistic Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Robust GUI Grounding
records.summary: GMS pairs a general vision-language scanner that proposes interface regions with a specialist locator that predicts coordinates within them. Hierarchical coarse-to-fine search coordinates the two components for GUI grounding on ScreenSpot-Pro.

records.name: Retrieval-augmented GUI Agents with Generative Guidelines
records.summary: RAG-GUI trains a small guidance adapter to filter and summarize retrieved web tutorials while keeping the acting agent fixed. Supervised and rejection-sampling stages prepare the adapter for inference-time assistance, tested on offline web/mobile tasks and interactive Android tasks.

records.name: Scaling Synthetic Task Generation for Agents via Exploration
records.summary: AutoPlay explores application states and functions to generate tasks, then uses a model executor and verifier to construct demonstrations. It produces 20,000 tasks across 20 Android apps and 10,000 tasks across 13 Ubuntu apps for supervised and reinforcement learning of UI agents.

records.name: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory
records.summary: Distills generalizable reasoning strategies from both successful and failed agent trajectories into a persistent memory bank for test-time retrieval.

records.name: Flash-Searcher: Fast and Effective Web Agents via DAG-Based Parallel Execution
records.summary: Introduces Flash-Searcher, a parallel agent framework that organizes dependent subtasks as a graph and runs independent paths concurrently; it is evaluated on deep-search benchmarks.

records.name: SCUBA: Salesforce Computer Use Benchmark
records.summary: SCUBA evaluates enterprise UI navigation and CRM workflows with 300 task instances derived from Salesforce user interviews. Salesforce sandbox execution and milestone-based assessment support comparisons between zero-shot agents and agents given demonstrations.

records.name: Ferret-UI Lite: Lessons from Building Small On-Device GUI Agents
records.summary: Ferret-UI Lite develops a 3B GUI agent using mixed real and synthetic data, reasoning with visual tools at inference, and reinforcement learning. It evaluates grounding and navigation across mobile, web, and desktop settings, including AndroidWorld and OSWorld.

records.name: Adaptive and Resource-efficient Agentic AI Systems for Mobile and Embedded Devices: A Survey
DRBench: A Realistic Benchmark for Enterprise Deep Research
PAL-UI: Planning with Active Look-back for Vision-Based GUI Agents
records.summary: PAL-UI combines observation/action summaries with selective retrieval of historical screenshots during planning. It trains mobile navigation models from step-level supervision and evaluates transfer to web navigation without additional training.

records.name: Graph2Eval: Automatic Multimodal Task Generation for Agents via Knowledge Graphs
records.summary: Introduces Graph2Eval, which generates multimodal agent evaluation tasks from knowledge graphs, including multi-step web interactions in Graph2Eval-Bench.

records.name: GUI-KV: Efficient GUI Agents via KV Cache with Spatio-Temporal Awareness
records.summary: GUI-KV compresses vision-language agents’ attention caches using visual-token saliency and redundancy between screenshot frames. The method requires no retraining and evaluates how cache budgets affect GUI action accuracy and computational cost.

records.name: WAInjectBench: Benchmarking Prompt Injection Detections for Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces WAInjectBench with a threat-model taxonomy and malicious and benign text-image datasets for web-agent prompt-injection detection. It compares detector families across explicit and less visible forms of injected content.

records.name: WALT: Web Agents that Learn Tools
records.summary: WALT explores website functionality and converts demonstrated interactions into validated, reusable tools combining DOM actions, URL navigation, and agentic fallbacks. It evaluates this expanded browser action space on WebArena and VisualWebArena.

records.name: Just Do It!? Computer-Use Agents Exhibit Blind Goal-Directedness
records.summary: BLIND-ACT tests whether computer-use agents persist with ambiguous, contradictory, or infeasible goals without adequate contextual reasoning. Its OSWorld-based tasks and judged trajectories examine these behaviors and the effect of mitigation prompts.

records.name: Dr. Bench: A Multidimensional Evaluation for Deep Research Agents, from Answers to Reports
Say One Thing, Do Another? Diagnosing Reasoning-Execution Gaps in VLM-Powered Mobile-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces an evaluation framework for mobile GUI agents that compares actions implied by their reasoning with intended and executed actions to diagnose mismatches.

records.name: StockBench: Can LLM Agents Trade Stocks Profitably In Real-world Markets?
Scaling Agents for Computer Use
records.summary: Introduces Behavior Judge, which converts execution trajectories into behavior narratives and compares multiple candidate rollouts. Experiments examine this selection approach on OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena and AndroidWorld.

records.name: BrowserArena: Evaluating LLM Agents on Real-World Web Navigation Tasks
records.summary: Introduces BrowserArena, a live-web platform for head-to-head agent comparisons on user-submitted tasks. Step-level human annotations support targeted analysis of navigation, pop-up handling and CAPTCHA-related failures.

records.name: Mitigating Modal Imbalance in Multimodal Reasoning
FocusAgent: Simple Yet Effective Ways of Trimming the Large Context of Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces FocusAgent, which uses a lightweight LLM to select task-relevant lines from web agents' accessibility-tree observations, reducing context size and exposure to prompt injection.

records.name: Improving GUI Grounding with Explicit Position-to-Coordinate Mapping
records.summary: This work addresses GUI localization errors caused by mismatches between visual patch positions and output pixel coordinates. RULER tokens provide explicit coordinate references, while Interleaved MRoPE balances width and height encoding; evaluation uses the ScreenSpot benchmark family.

records.name: WAREX: Web Agent Reliability Evaluation on Existing Benchmarks
records.summary: WAREX augments existing web-agent benchmarks with reliability challenges arising from unstable systems and changing or disruptive website behavior. Evaluation on WebArena, WebVoyager and REAL examines how these disturbances affect task completion.

records.name: Learning Efficient Guardrails for Compliance
records.summary: Introduces PolicyGuardBench for detecting policy violations in full web-agent trajectories and their prefixes, and trains PolicyGuard as an efficient guardrail model.

records.name: Cross-Modal Content Optimization for Steering Web Agent Preferences
records.summary: Introduces Cross-Modal Preference Steering (CPS), a black-box attack that edits a listing's images and text to steer VLM-based web agents' selections.

records.name: \textsc{GUI-Spotlight}: Adaptive Iterative Focus Refinement for Enhanced GUI Visual Grounding
records.summary: GUI-Spotlight trains a grounding model to reason over images and call tools that iteratively narrow its visual focus. The paper evaluates this refinement method on ScreenSpot-Pro after training on 18,500 samples.

records.name: JEF-Hinter: Leveraging Offline Knowledge for Improving Web Agents Adaptation
records.summary: Introduces JEF-Hinter, which distills successful and failed trajectories into compact episodic hints and retrieves them for the current agent state. Web benchmark experiments examine guidance from decisive steps.

records.name: GDPval: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Real-World Economically Valuable Tasks
Understanding User Experiences of Computer Use Agents: Design Space and Opportunities for Building Agent UX Prototypes
records.summary: Maps design considerations for computer-use agent experiences and introduces AgentUXlab, a browser-based probe for prototyping and evaluating agent UX on a website.

records.name: Impatient Users Confuse AI Agents: High-fidelity Simulations of Human Traits for Testing Agents
3Dify: a Framework for Procedural 3D-CG Generation Assisted by LLMs Using MCP and RAG
records.summary: Introduces 3Dify, a natural-language 3D graphics framework that operates creation tools through MCP and uses a computer-using agent for GUI operations when MCP is unavailable.

records.name: From Imperative to Declarative: Towards LLM-friendly OS Interfaces for Boosted Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces a Declarative Model Interface that maps existing GUIs to access, state and observation primitives while handling low-level interactions. Evaluation uses Word, PowerPoint and Excel on Windows with a GUI-agent baseline.

records.name: Watch and Learn: Learning to Use Computers from Online Videos
records.summary: Introduces Watch & Learn (W&L), which converts human computer-use videos into UI action trajectories by predicting actions between consecutive screen states.

records.name: GUISpector: An MLLM Agent Framework for Automated Verification of Natural Language Requirements in GUI Prototypes
records.summary: Introduces GUISpector, an MLLM agent framework that operates GUI prototypes to check natural-language requirements and produces feedback for developers.

records.name: Paper2Video: Automatic Video Generation from Scientific Papers
Demystifying deep search: a holistic evaluation with hint-free multi-hop questions and factorised metrics
records.summary: Introduces WebDetective, a deep-search benchmark with a traceable Wikipedia sandbox, and EvidenceLoop, an evidence-tracking workflow for web-agent search and synthesis.

records.name: VeriGuard: Enhancing LLM Agent Safety via Verified Code Generation
Presenting a Paper is an Art: Self-Improvement Aesthetic Agents for Academic Presentations
Agent+P: Guiding UI Agents via Symbolic Planning
records.summary: Guides UI agents with symbolic planning over a UI transition graph initialized from app-code analysis and updated through online exploration, with evaluation on AndroidWorld.

records.name: A Multimodal GUI Architecture for Interfacing with LLM-Based Conversational Assistants
records.summary: Presents an MCP architecture that exposes an application's GUI navigation graph and view-specific tools to speech-enabled LLM assistants for voice interaction.

records.name: Your Harness is Not Secure: Benchmarking Real-world Threat of Command Line Interface Agent
records.summary: Introduces AdvCLI, a sandbox benchmark for evaluating whether command-line agents carry out security-relevant operating-system tasks across multiple hosts.

records.name: Invisible to Humans, Triggered by Agents: Stealthy Jailbreak Attacks on Mobile Vision-Language Agents
records.summary: Uses the near-zero contact-touch signals of automated mobile agents to expose malicious visual content selectively during agent interactions. The paper combines this agent-only perceptual injection with HG-IDA* prompt optimization to study unauthorized cross-app actions.

records.name: ReInAgent: A Context-Aware GUI Agent Enabling Human-in-the-Loop Mobile Task Navigation
records.summary: Introduces ReInAgent, coordinating information management, planning, and reflection around a shared memory for mobile tasks. It proactively asks users for information and checks consistency when instructions are ambiguous or change during execution.

records.name: Auto-scaling Continuous Memory for GUI Agent
records.summary: Encodes GUI trajectories into compact continuous embeddings that can be retrieved directly into an agent’s input. An automated environment-discovery and rollout pipeline expands this memory for long tasks and unfamiliar interfaces.

records.name: InteractScience: Programmatic and Visually-Grounded Evaluation of Interactive Scientific Demonstration Code Generation
WARC-Bench: Web Archive Based Benchmark for GUI Subtask Executions
records.summary: WARC-Bench packages dynamic web pages as replayable archives and evaluates short navigation subtasks involving components such as date pickers and scrollable containers. It also studies supervised training followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards on these browser interactions.

records.name: ALLOY: Generating Reusable Agent Workflows from User Demonstration
records.summary: Introduces ALLOY, which turns user demonstrations into editable, reusable workflows for LLM-based web agents carrying out preference-dependent tasks.

records.name: SecureWebArena: A Holistic Security Evaluation Benchmark for LVLM-based Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces SecureWebArena with simulated interactive websites, an attack-vector taxonomy and labeled agent trajectories. Its evaluation separates failures in reasoning, behavioral traces and task outcomes across vision-language agent families.

records.name: Don't Just Fine-tune the Agent, Tune the Environment
BrowserAgent: Building Web Agents with Human-Inspired Web Browsing Actions
records.summary: Trains BrowserAgent to use Playwright-based scrolling, clicking and typing directly on webpages for information-seeking tasks. Supervised and rejection fine-tuning are paired with explicit memory for conclusions carried across steps.

records.name: A Survey on Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models
SusBench: An Online Benchmark for Evaluating Dark Pattern Susceptibility of Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces SusBench, an online benchmark that inserts dark-pattern designs into consumer websites for agent evaluation. A human study checks the realism of the interventions, and agent trials compare susceptibility across pattern types.

records.name: WebRouter: Query-specific Router via Variational Information Bottleneck for Cost-sensitive Web Agent
records.summary: Introduces WebRouter, a cost-aware router that compresses web-agent prompts to choose among LLMs, with cost and accuracy measured on WebVoyager websites.

records.name: ReLook: Vision-Grounded RL with a Multimodal LLM Critic for Agentic Web Coding
R-WoM: Retrieval-augmented World Model For Computer-use Agents
records.summary: R-WoM evaluates how well world models predict nearby GUI states, align complete procedures, and recognize milestone transitions. It retrieves external tutorials to guide simulated future interactions, with experiments on subsets of OSWorld and WebArena.

records.name: HackWorld: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents on Exploiting Web Application Vulnerabilities
records.summary: Introduces HackWorld for evaluating visual computer-use agents in a capture-the-flag collection of web applications. The benchmark examines interface navigation and multistep planning during vulnerability discovery and exploitation tasks.

records.name: Detect Anything via Next Point Prediction
records.summary: Introduces Rex-Omni, a general visual perception model trained for coordinate prediction; GUI grounding is one capability evaluated alongside detection and OCR.

records.name: In-Browser LLM-Guided Fuzzing for Real-Time Prompt Injection Testing in Agentic AI Browsers
records.summary: Proposes an in-browser fuzzing framework that uses language-model guidance to test indirect prompt-injection vulnerabilities in agentic browsers. The work focuses on unwanted actions triggered by webpage instructions under the browser agent's user privileges.

records.name: Synthesizing Agentic Data for Web Agents with Progressive Difficulty Enhancement Mechanisms
ReUseIt: Synthesizing Reusable AI Agent Workflows for Web Automation
records.summary: Introduces ReUseIt, which synthesizes reusable web-agent workflows from successful and failed attempts and adds guards to detect and fix execution errors.

records.name: Hi-Agent: Hierarchical Vision-Language Agents for Mobile Device Control
records.summary: Introduces Hi-Agent, jointly training a high-level reasoning model and a low-level mobile action model. Execution feedback supplies a foresight advantage for optimizing subgoal decisions, with evaluations on Android control benchmarks.

records.name: WebAggregator: Enhancing Compositional Reasoning Capabilities of Deep Research Agent Foundation Models
records.summary: Introduces WebAggregator, a pipeline for synthesizing compositional questions from websites to train deep-research agents, plus the WebAggregatorQA testbed.

records.name: State Your Intention to Steer Your Attention: An AI Assistant for Intentional Digital Living
records.summary: Introduces an assistant that reads screenshots, application titles, and URLs to compare computer activity with a user's stated intention and send notifications when it diverges.

records.name: Agentic Entropy-Balanced Policy Optimization
records.summary: Introduces Agentic Entropy-Balanced Policy Optimization (AEPO), an RL method that adjusts rollout sampling and policy updates for tool-using web agents.

records.name: ColorBench: Benchmarking Mobile Agents with Graph-Structured Framework for Complex Long-Horizon Tasks
records.summary: ColorBench represents mobile tasks as graphs of states collected from real devices, providing a quasi-dynamic environment with multiple valid paths and error paths. It evaluates single-app and cross-app tasks using completion, subtask progress, and atomic diagnostics.

records.name: LLMs as Scalable, General-Purpose Simulators For Evolving Digital Agent Training
records.summary: Introduces UI-Simulator, which generates UI states and transitions for agent-training trajectories, and UI-Simulator-Grow, which prioritizes tasks and trajectory variants.

records.name: CORE: Reducing UI Exposure in Mobile Agents via Collaboration Between Cloud and Local LLMs
records.summary: Introduces CORE, which divides mobile UI hierarchies into semantic blocks and shares planning between local and cloud language models. Local ranking limits the screen information sent for cloud-side element selection, with a multi-round mechanism for correcting inadequate context.

records.name: PolySkill: Learning Generalizable Skills Through Polymorphic Abstraction
records.summary: Introduces PolySkill, which separates a web-agent skill's goal from its execution so agents can learn and reuse skills across websites.

records.name: GUIrilla: A Scalable Framework for Automated Desktop UI Exploration
records.summary: GUIrilla systematically explores macOS interfaces to collect interaction traces and accessibility metadata for downstream GUI research. It organizes these observations into hierarchical MacApp Trees and describes an accessibility-driven collection library.

records.name: WEBSERV: A Full-Stack and RL-Ready Web Environment for Training Web Agents at Scale
records.summary: WebServ combines copy-on-write container environments with a compact DOM-derived browser interface for training web agents. Network-aware waiting supports action execution in single-page applications, with evaluations and reinforcement-learning experiments on WebArena-Lite.

records.name: Beyond Pipelines: A Survey of the Paradigm Shift toward Model-Native Agentic AI
records.summary: Surveys model-native agentic AI and the role of RL in learned planning, tool use and memory, covering GUI agents as one application alongside deep-research agents.

records.name: UltraCUA: A Foundation Model for Computer Use Agents with Hybrid Action
records.summary: UltraCUA trains a shared policy for primitive GUI actions and high-level tool calls using synthesized tasks and hybrid trajectories. Supervised fine-tuning followed by online reinforcement learning is evaluated on OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena.

records.name: Investigating the Impact of Dark Patterns on LLM-Based Web Agents
records.summary: Presents LiteAgent for recording web-agent interactions and TrickyArena for enabling or disabling dark patterns in controlled websites. Experiments compare how individual patterns, combined patterns and visual or HTML changes affect agent decisions.

records.name: Genesis: Evolving Attack Strategies for LLM Web Agent Red-Teaming
records.summary: Introduces Genesis, a red-teaming framework that generates adversarial injections for web agents and revises attack strategies using responses and interaction logs.

records.name: AndroidControl-Curated: Revealing the True Potential of GUI Agents through Benchmark Purification
records.summary: AndroidControl-Curated audits ambiguities and factual errors in AndroidControl and produces a refined evaluation dataset. The paper also studies post-training a small Magma-R1 model on a curated subset to examine the effect of data quality on GUI action assessment.

records.name: CUARewardBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Reward Models on Computer-using Agent
records.summary: Introduces CUARewardBench for evaluating outcome and process reward models on annotated computer-use trajectories, plus Unanimous Prompt Ensemble (UPE) for reward judgments.

records.name: ProfBench: Multi-Domain Rubrics requiring Professional Knowledge to Answer and Judge
WebGraphEval: Multi-Turn Trajectory Evaluation for Web Agents using Graph Representation
records.summary: Introduces WebGraphEval, which merges multiple agents' trajectories into a weighted graph of canonical actions. Structural analyses examine recurring behavior, inefficient paths and important decision points beyond a final success score.

records.name: See, Think, Act: Online Shopper Behavior Simulation with VLM Agents
records.summary: Studies online shopper action prediction with VLM agents using webpage screenshots, HTML, and action history from OPeRA, trained with SFT and hierarchical RL rewards.

records.name: SheetBrain: A Neuro-Symbolic Agent for Accurate Reasoning over Complex and Large Spreadsheets
records.summary: Introduces SheetBrain, a spreadsheet question-answering and manipulation agent that uses a Python sandbox and Excel tools, plus the SheetBench benchmark.

records.name: ColorAgent: Building A Robust, Personalized, and Interactive OS Agent
records.summary: Presents ColorAgent, an operating system agent for long-horizon user instructions, trained with step-wise RL and self-evolving training and evaluated on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.

records.name: VideoAgentTrek: Computer Use Pretraining from Unlabeled Videos
records.summary: Extracts structured GUI actions from screen-recorded tutorials using inverse dynamics, then uses the inferred trajectories for computer-use training.

records.name: Branch-and-Browse: Efficient and Controllable Web Exploration with Tree-Structured Reasoning and Action Memory
records.summary: Branch-and-Browse is a web agent framework that uses tree-structured subtasks, web state replay, and page action memory to explore and complete tasks.

records.name: SODBench: A Large Language Model Approach to Documenting Spreadsheet Operations
Surfer 2: The Next Generation of Cross-Platform Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Surfer2 combines hierarchical context management with separate planning and execution, self-verification, and recovery for visual computer use. It evaluates the framework across web, desktop, and Android tasks without task-specific fine-tuning.

records.name: UI-Ins: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Multi-Perspective Instruction-as-Reasoning
records.summary: Treats alternative instruction formulations as reasoning paths and trains GUI-grounding models to select and combine useful perspectives.

records.name: GhostEI-Bench: Do Mobile Agents Resilience to Environmental Injection in Dynamic On-Device Environments?
records.summary: Introduces GhostEI-Bench, a benchmark that injects deceptive UI events into Android emulator workflows to assess mobile agents and analyze failures from actions and screenshots.

records.name: Mixing Importance with Diversity: Joint Optimization for KV Cache Compression in Large Vision-Language Models
records.summary: MixKV compresses vision-language model KV caches by balancing importance and diversity; its evaluations include GUI grounding alongside broader multimodal tasks.

records.name: DeepAgent: A General Reasoning Agent with Scalable Toolsets
AstaBench: Rigorous Benchmarking of AI Agents with a Scientific Research Suite
OpenPhone: Mobile Agentic Foundation Models
records.summary: OpenPhone trains a compact mobile policy with supervised learning followed by GRPO on synthetic GUI data, incorporating reasoning and memory management. Its device-cloud design handles routine work locally and delegates complex subtasks, with online evaluation on AndroidLab.

records.name: Mitigating Coordinate Prediction Bias from Positional Encoding Failures
records.summary: Introduces Vision-PE Shuffle Guidance (VPSG), a training-free correction for coordinate drift in visual models, evaluated for localization on ScreenSpot-Pro.

records.name: WebATLAS: An LLM Agent with Experience-Driven Memory and Action Simulation
records.summary: WebATLAS is a web agent that stores interaction outcomes and simulates candidate actions before acting, using past experience to plan navigation on unseen websites.

records.name: BrowseConf: Confidence-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Web Agents
VisCoder2: Building Multi-Language Visualization Coding Agents
Game-TARS: Pretrained Foundation Models for Scalable Generalist Multimodal Game Agents
From Benchmarks to Business Impact: Deploying IBM Generalist Agent in Enterprise Production
Agentic AI Security: Threats, Defenses, Evaluation, and Open Challenges
MGA: Memory-Driven GUI Agent for Observation-Centric Interaction
records.summary: Introduces MGA, which separates task-agnostic screen-state reading from decision making and connects steps through structured state memory. Validated state deltas replace full trajectory replay, evaluated on OSWorld and application tasks.

records.name: MCP-Flow: Facilitating LLM Agents to Master Real-World, Diverse and Scaling MCP Tools
OS-Sentinel: Towards Safety-Enhanced Mobile GUI Agents via Hybrid Validation in Realistic Workflows
records.summary: Introduces MobileRisk-Live and OS-Sentinel, combining a formal verifier for system-level violations with a multimodal judge for contextual risks in mobile GUI workflows.

records.name: OSWorld-MCP: Benchmarking MCP Tool Invocation In Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: OSWorld-MCP evaluates how agents choose between GUI operations and MCP tool calls in computer tasks. It combines generated and curated tools, with 158 manually validated tools across seven applications, to examine tool use alongside task completion.

records.name: FunReason-MT Technical Report: Advanced Data Synthesis Solution for Real-world Multi-Turn Tool-use
Repurposing Synthetic Data for Fine-grained Search Agent Supervision
AgentFrontier: Expanding the Capability Frontier of LLM Agents with ZPD-Guided Data Synthesis
WebLeaper: Empowering Efficiency and Efficacy in WebAgent via Enabling Info-Rich Seeking
ParallelMuse: Agentic Parallel Thinking for Deep Information Seeking
AgentFold: Long-Horizon Web Agents with Proactive Context Management
Agent Data Protocol: Unifying Datasets for Diverse, Effective Fine-tuning of LLM Agents
records.summary: The agent data protocol (ADP) provides a shared format for agent training data across browsing, tool use, coding, and other tasks, including web agent workflows.

records.name: The Tool Decathlon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Diverse, Realistic, and Long-Horizon Task Execution
GUI Knowledge Bench: Revealing the Knowledge Gap of VLMs in GUI Tasks
records.summary: GUI Knowledge Bench tests knowledge of widgets, interactions, and procedures across six named platforms and 292 applications to assess VLMs used for GUI tasks.

records.name: Agent Skills Enable a New Class of Realistic and Trivially Simple Prompt Injections
Remote Labor Index: Measuring AI Automation of Remote Work
Measuring the Security of Mobile LLM Agents under Adversarial Prompts from Untrusted Third-Party Channels
records.summary: Measures how untrusted third-party notifications, messages, and app content can hijack mobile LLM agents into executing unauthorized cross-app actions.

records.name: GUI-Rise: Structured Reasoning and History Summarization for GUI Navigation
records.summary: Combines structured progress-and-decision reasoning with history summarization to improve cross-domain generalization in GUI navigation agents.

records.name: Enhancing Trustworthy GUI Grounding via Self-Critiqued Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: HyperClick trains GUI grounders to produce a click and an accompanying confidence estimate using rewards for correctness and confidence alignment. Its evaluation examines localization, calibration, and abstention behavior.

records.name: Can LLMs Help You at Work? A Sandbox for Evaluating LLM Agents in Enterprise Environments
GUI-AIMA: Aligning Intrinsic Multimodal Attention with a Context Anchor for GUI Grounding
records.summary: Introduces GUI-AIMA, which supervises instruction-relevant attention over visual patches. Patch-level grounding can be combined with an optional zoom stage and is evaluated across GUI localization benchmarks.

records.name: VCode: a Multimodal Coding Benchmark with SVG as Symbolic Visual Representation
The OpenHands Software Agent SDK: A Composable and Extensible Foundation for Production Agents
Scaling Agent Learning via Experience Synthesis
records.summary: DreamGym synthesizes agent experiences with a reasoning-based environment model for online RL; its evaluations include the web task setting WebArena.

records.name: Learning from Online Videos at Inference Time for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: This work retrieves online video tutorials and converts them into structured GUI action demonstrations with short objectives. A two-stage selection process supplies a relevant local trajectory as in-context guidance at each execution step.

records.name: Opus: A Quantitative Framework for Workflow Evaluation
GUI-360$^\circ$: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Computer-Using Agents
records.summary: Collects Windows application trajectories with screenshots and action traces for grounding, screen parsing, and action prediction.

records.name: Promoting Sustainable Web Agents: Benchmarking and Estimating Energy Consumption through Empirical and Theoretical Analysis
When AI Meets the Web: Prompt Injection Risks in Third-Party AI Chatbot Plugins
SynthAgent: Adapting Web Agents with Synthetic Supervision
records.summary: Introduces SynthAgent, which generates tasks by exploring website elements and refines them when observations reveal conflicts. A later trajectory-refinement stage removes misaligned behavior before fine-tuning agents for the target websites.

records.name: WebVIA: A Web-based Vision-Language Agentic Framework for Interactive and Verifiable UI-to-Code Generation
records.summary: WebVIA combines a web UI exploration agent, interactive UI-to-Code generation, and validation of generated code's interactivity.

records.name: AUTO-Explorer: Automated Data Collection for GUI Agent
records.summary: Introduces Auto-Explorer, an automated GUI exploration method that records software states for training-data collection. UIXplore evaluates exploration coverage, and collected data is used to fine-tune and test GUI element grounding.

records.name: Grounding Computer Use Agents on Human Demonstrations
records.summary: GroundCUA turns expert desktop demonstrations into densely annotated screenshots and grounding instructions. The GroundNext model family uses this supervision and subsequent reinforcement learning, with both grounding benchmarks and an OSWorld agent configuration used for evaluation.

records.name: An Efficient Training Pipeline for Reasoning Graphical User Interface Agents
records.summary: A GUI grounding pipeline filters 4.8M synthetic examples to 12K training instances and adapts a 3B vision-language model, evaluated on ScreenSpot, Multimodal-Mind2Web, and AndroidControl.

records.name: UI2Code^N: UI-to-Code Generation as Interactive Visual Optimization
AgentPRM: Process Reward Models for LLM Agents via Step-Wise Promise and Progress
records.summary: AgentPRM scores sequential agent decisions by their promise and progress toward a goal, with web shopping and browser navigation among the motivating tasks.

records.name: Lumine: An Open Recipe for Building Generalist Agents in 3D Open Worlds
History-Aware Reasoning for GUI Agents
records.summary: HAR-GUI combines episodic reasoning and short-term memory to use earlier interactions when selecting GUI actions. Its training constructs reflective scenarios and correction guidance and applies a hybrid reinforcement-learning reward to the 3B policy.

records.name: ProBench: Benchmarking GUI Agents with Accurate Process Information
records.summary: ProBench extends mobile GUI evaluation with tasks whose correctness depends on the interaction process as well as the final state. Its ProcessProvider supplies process information for assessing agent behavior and analyzing failure modes.

records.name: TaskSense: Cognitive Chain Modeling and Difficulty Estimation for GUI Tasks
records.summary: Cognitive Chain estimates GUI task difficulty by extracting sequences of cognitive steps from execution traces, then uses those estimates to assess GUI agents.

records.name: Co-EPG: A Framework for Co-Evolution of Planning and Grounding in Autonomous GUI Agents
records.summary: Co-EPG alternates reinforcement learning for a planner with updates to a grounding model using generated training examples. The evolving grounder provides feedback to the planner, and evaluation uses Multimodal Mind2Web and AndroidControl.

records.name: Building the Web for Agents: A Declarative Framework for Agent-Web Interaction
UFO3: Weaving the Digital Agent Galaxy
OSGym: Scalable OS Infra for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: OSGym supplies full operating-system sandboxes with GUIs for parallel computer-use data collection and training. It combines per-replica state management, hardware-aware orchestration, copy-on-write virtual-machine disks, and layered failure recovery.

records.name: Mobile-Agent-RAG: Driving Smart Multi-Agent Coordination with Contextual Knowledge Empowerment for Long-Horizon Mobile Automation
records.summary: Uses separate retrieval systems for high-level mobile-task planning and precise interface operations, with a benchmark for extended cross-app tasks.

records.name: WebCoach: Self-Evolving Web Agents with Cross-Session Memory Guidance
records.summary: Introduces WebCoach, which condenses navigation logs into persistent episodic memory and retrieves experiences by similarity and recency. Runtime hooks selectively supply advice to browser agents, evaluated on WebVoyager without retraining the underlying models.

records.name: MEGA-GUI: Multi-stage Enhanced Grounding Agents for GUI Elements
records.summary: Introduces MEGA-GUI, which separates coarse region selection from fine-grained interface-element grounding. Bidirectional zooming and context-aware instruction rewriting coordinate specialized vision-language agents across visual scales.

records.name: STEP: Success-Rate-Aware Trajectory-Efficient Policy Optimization
records.summary: STEP allocates RL sampling by task success rate and trains on individual steps from interaction trajectories, with evaluations on OSWorld and AndroidWorld.

records.name: DualTAP: A Dual-Task Adversarial Protector for Mobile MLLM Agents
records.summary: Applies dual-task adversarial perturbations to mobile screenshots to conceal personally identifiable information from untrusted MLLM routers while preserving agent task utility.

records.name: Can We Stop Malicious AI? KILLBENCH: A Benchmark for External AI Kill Switch Feasibility
records.summary: KillBench evaluates external prompt-style signals intended to halt maliciously operating web agents, across harmful scenarios and agent configurations.

records.name: Computer-Use Agents as Judges for Generative User Interface
records.summary: AUI-Gym evaluates generated websites by having computer-use agents attempt tasks whose executability is checked programmatically. A feedback dashboard condenses navigation histories into visual summaries that a coding agent can use to revise an interface.

records.name: D-GARA: A Dynamic Benchmarking Framework for GUI Agent Robustness in Real-World Anomalies
records.summary: D-GARA evaluates Android GUI agents under runtime anomalies such as permission dialogs, battery warnings, and update prompts. Its modular environment embeds these interruptions in Android applications to study recovery and robustness.

records.name: UI-CUBE: Enterprise-Grade Computer Use Agent Benchmarking Beyond Task Accuracy to Operational Reliability
records.summary: UI-CUBE evaluates 226 tasks ranging from individual controls to copy-paste and enterprise workflows. Interface variations, multiple resolutions, and application-state validation support diagnosis of operational reliability beyond task accuracy alone.

records.name: SWITCH: Benchmarking Modeling and Handling of Tangible Interfaces in Long-horizon Embodied Scenarios
Building Browser Agents: Architecture, Security, and Practical Solutions
records.summary: Reports architectural and security lessons from building a browser agent, including hybrid accessibility-tree and visual context, browser tooling and programmatic constraints. A WebGames evaluation accompanies the discussion of reliability and specialization.

records.name: Fara-7B: An Efficient Agentic Model for Computer Use
records.summary: Introduces FaraGen synthetic web trajectories, a compact screenshot-based action model, and WebTailBench for underrepresented browser tasks.

records.name: CropVLM: Learning to Zoom for Fine-Grained Vision-Language Perception
AppSelectBench: Application-Level Tool Selection Benchmark
records.summary: AppSelectBench evaluates whether computer-using agents choose the right desktop application for a task, using generated user intents and multiple evaluation protocols.

records.name: "Are We Done Yet?": A Vision-Based Judge for Autonomous Task Completion of Computer Use Agents
records.summary: This study tests vision-language models as task-completion judges using screenshots and instructions from 42 built-in macOS applications. It evaluates judgment accuracy on human-labeled tasks and separately studies how judge feedback affects agent task success.

records.name: BrowseSafe: Understanding and Preventing Prompt Injection Within AI Browser Agents
records.summary: BrowseSafe builds a benchmark of prompt injections in realistic HTML for browser agents and evaluates defenses against attacks that can affect agent actions.

records.name: CANVAS: A Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Tool-Based User Interface Design
OpenApps: Simulating Environment Variations to Measure UI-Agent Reliability
records.summary: Introduces OpenApps, a configurable app ecosystem for measuring UI-agent reliability under changes in appearance and content. Its evaluation compares task success and failure behavior across many versions of the same apps.

records.name: Prune4Web: DOM Tree Pruning Programming for Web Agent
records.summary: Introduces Prune4Web, where generated scoring programs filter DOM elements according to decomposed subtasks before grounding. An annotation pipeline and two-turn training procedure coordinate the planner, programmatic filter and grounder.

records.name: Qwen3-VL Technical Report
records.summary: Describes the Qwen3-VL dense and MoE vision-language models, with 256K-token interleaved context, interleaved-MRoPE, DeepStack and textual video timestamps; a general foundation model aimed partly at agentic use.

records.name: Real-Time Procedural Learning From Experience for AI Agents
records.summary: PRAXIS stores action outcomes and retrieves past state-action-result examples to guide agent decisions, with evaluation on the REAL web browsing benchmark.

records.name: Training High-Level Schedulers with Execution-Feedback Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon GUI Automation
records.summary: This work trains high-level schedulers with staged reinforcement learning driven by execution feedback. Its CES framework separates a Coordinator for planning and decomposition, a StateTracker for compressed context, and a low-level Executor.

records.name: MCP vs RAG vs NLWeb vs HTML: A Comparison of the Effectiveness and Efficiency of Different Agent Interfaces to the Web (Technical Report)
records.summary: Compares HTML browsing, RAG, MCP, and NLWeb interfaces for web agents performing product search, comparison, and checkout tasks in four simulated e-shops.

records.name: MPR-GUI: Benchmarking and Enhancing Multilingual Perception and Reasoning in GUI Agents
records.summary: MPR-GUI evaluates GUI perception and reasoning through strictly aligned tasks in six languages. GUI-XLI adjusts non-English hidden representations toward English representations at language-sensitive layers during inference to address the measured cross-language gaps.

records.name: AFRAgent : An Adaptive Feature Renormalization Based High Resolution Aware GUI agent
records.summary: Introduces AFRAgent, which uses adaptive feature renormalization to combine low-resolution visual embeddings with high-resolution details. The architecture is evaluated for smartphone GUI automation on Meta-GUI and AITW.

records.name: DrawingBench: Evaluating Spatial Reasoning and UI Interaction Capabilities of Large Language Models through Mouse-Based Drawing Tasks
records.summary: DrawingBench evaluates sequences of low-level mouse-based GUI actions through 250 drawing prompts and rule-based criteria. Action inspection and multi-turn external feedback support analysis of spatial reasoning, tool-state management, and refinement.

records.name: MDiff4STR: Mask Diffusion Model for Scene Text Recognition
HiconAgent: History Context-aware Policy Optimization for GUI Agents
records.summary: HiconAgent trains GUI policies to use history through variable-length context sampling and paired policy updates with compressed and complete histories. Its compression retains past actions while removing historical observations, and an alignment loss couples the two branches.

records.name: Chain-of-Ground: Improving GUI Grounding via Iterative Reasoning and Reference Feedback
records.summary: Chain-of-Ground uses iterative visual reasoning and reference feedback to refine GUI localization without additional training. It evaluates on ScreenSpot-Pro and introduces TPanel-UI to probe grounding on industrial control panels with visual distortions.

records.name: GUI Exploration Lab: Enhancing Screen Navigation in Agents via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Introduces GUI Exploration Lab, a simulation engine for composing screens, interface elements, and navigation graphs. It studies how supervised learning, single-turn RL, and multiturn RL affect GUI navigation and exploration.

records.name: PPTArena: A Benchmark for PowerPoint Editing
LegalWebAgent: Empowering Access to Justice via LLM-Based Web Agents
records.summary: LegalWebAgent separates user-needs clarification, webpage browsing, and actions such as form completion or scheduling. A 15-task evaluation studies legal-service workflows relevant to Québec civil-law users, using HTML and screenshot observations.

records.name: SlideGen: Collaborative Multimodal Agents for Scientific Slide Generation
Zoom in, Click out: Unlocking and Evaluating the Potential of Zooming for GUI Grounding
records.summary: ZoomClick uses repeated zooming and context adjustment to improve GUI grounding without training. The paper studies zoom depth, crop sizes, and related choices and introduces GUIZoom-Bench to evaluate how grounding models respond to zoomed views.

records.name: An Index-based Approach for Efficient and Effective Web Content Extraction
Privacy Practices of Browser Agents
records.summary: Presents a privacy evaluation framework for browser agents covering component weaknesses, website defenses, tracking, privacy-related prompts and personal-data leakage. The framework is applied to deployed browser-agent tools.

records.name: Attention is All You Need to Defend Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks in LLMs
MVP: Multiple View Prediction Improves GUI Grounding
records.summary: MVP addresses unstable GUI coordinates by predicting across several attention-guided cropped views. It clusters the resulting coordinates and selects the densest cluster centroid, evaluating this training-free inference method across grounding models.

records.name: GAIR: GUI Automation via Information-Joint Reasoning and Group Reflection
records.summary: Introduces GAIR, which combines information from specialized GUI models through a general-purpose coordinating model. When the available information is insufficient, group reflection sends targeted requests back to the specialists before selecting an operation.

records.name: AgentProg: Empowering Long-Horizon GUI Agents with Program-Guided Context Management
records.summary: Introduces AgentProg, organizing mobile-agent interaction history as a program with variables and control flow to decide what context to retain. A global belief state handles partial observability, with evaluation on AndroidWorld and extended long-horizon tasks.

records.name: WebSTAR: Scalable Data Synthesis for Computer Use Agents with Step-Level Filtering
records.summary: Introduces a pipeline that filters individual steps from noisy computer-agent rollouts and augments them with reasoning for training. WebSTAR and WebSCORE support GUI-policy supervision and a distilled process reward model, StepRM.

records.name: Using GUI Agent for Electronic Design Automation
records.summary: GUI-EDA collects more than 2,000 screenshot-answer-action pairs from engineers working across five CAD tools and five physical domains. The accompanying benchmark evaluates more than 30 GUI agents on specialized electronic-design workflows.

records.name: ceLLMate: Sandboxing Browser AI Agents
records.summary: ceLLMate constrains browser-agent authority through an extension that applies policies at the HTTP layer. It evaluates this sandbox against prompt-injection attacks in WASP, avoiding dependence on brittle low-level click and keystroke policies.

records.name: MobiBench: Multi-Branch, Modular Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: MobiBench evaluates mobile GUI agents offline while allowing multiple valid action paths. It decomposes agent pipelines into modules to study component contributions, configurations, and performance bottlenecks.

records.name: WebOperator: Action-Aware Tree Search for Autonomous Agents in Web Environment
records.summary: WebOperator uses tree search, action filtering, and path checks before replay to explore web tasks and backtrack while accounting for irreversible actions.

records.name: Memory in the Age of AI Agents
Complex Mathematical Expression Recognition: Benchmark, Large-Scale Dataset and Strong Baseline
MobileWorldBench: Towards Semantic World Modeling For Mobile Agents
records.summary: Evaluates semantic world models for mobile interfaces and studies natural-language state transitions as a tool for agent planning.

records.name: Step-GUI Technical Report
records.summary: Step-GUI uses calibrated trajectory rewards to turn generated GUI interaction data into training signals for compact agent models. The report also introduces GUI-MCP for hierarchical GUI operations and local task delegation, and AndroidDaily for static-action and end-to-end mobile evaluation.

records.name: OS-Oracle: A Comprehensive Framework for Cross-Platform GUI Critic Models
records.summary: OS-Oracle synthesizes GUI critic examples and trains a pre-action critic with supervised learning followed by consistency-preserving GRPO. It introduces OS-Critic Bench across mobile, web, and desktop settings and tests critic-assisted agents in OSWorld and AndroidWorld.

records.name: VenusBench-GD: A Comprehensive Multi-Platform GUI Benchmark for Diverse Grounding Tasks
records.summary: VenusBench-GD is a bilingual, cross-platform GUI grounding benchmark organized into basic and advanced tasks. Its annotation pipeline and six-subtask taxonomy support comparisons of general multimodal models and GUI-specialized models across different grounding demands.

records.name: DAVE: A VLM Vision Encoder for Document Understanding and Web Agents
records.summary: DAVE trains a vision encoder for document images and web agents using self-supervised pretraining followed by supervised parsing and localization. It combines decoder-specific encoder merging with feature fusion and evaluates web localization and agent benchmarks alongside document tasks.

records.name: EchoTrail-GUI: Building Actionable Memory for GUI Agents via Critic-Guided Self-Exploration
records.summary: EchoTrail-GUI builds a memory of successful GUI trajectories through autonomous exploration filtered by a reward model. It retrieves relevant trajectories as in-context guidance for new tasks and evaluates the approach on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.

records.name: MobileWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Mobile Agents in Agent-User Interactive and MCP-Augmented Environments
records.summary: Introduces long mobile workflows that combine agent-user interaction, cross-application tasks, and MCP-based tool access.

records.name: UniRec-0.1B: Unified Text and Formula Recognition with 0.1B Parameters
AndroidLens: Long-latency Evaluation with Nested Sub-targets for Android GUI Agents
records.summary: AndroidLens provides 571 extended mobile tasks in Chinese and English, with multiple valid paths and preserved environmental anomalies. Its dynamic evaluation uses nested milestones and Average Task Progress to measure partial completion of long workflows.

records.name: The AI Committee: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Validation and Remediation of Web-Sourced Data
An Information Theoretic Perspective on Agentic System Design
iSHIFT: Lightweight Slow-Fast GUI Agent with Adaptive Perception
records.summary: Introduces iSHIFT, which combines latent reasoning with perception-control tokens to adapt GUI inference. The agent switches between detailed regional grounding and faster use of global visual cues.

records.name: MAI-UI Technical Report: Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
records.summary: MAI-UI combines GUI navigation, native user interaction, and MCP tool calls in a family of policies trained through generated data and online reinforcement learning. The report also studies device-cloud routing and scaling of parallel environments and interaction budgets, with grounding and Android navigation evaluation.

records.name: SmartSnap: Proactive Evidence Seeking for Self-Verifying Agents
records.summary: SmartSnap trains GUI agents to collect concise screenshot evidence of task completion for an LLM judge, with experiments on mobile tasks.

records.name: DECEPTICON: How Dark Patterns Manipulate Web Agents
records.summary: DECEPTICON is an environment of 700 web navigation tasks that isolates dark patterns to measure how deceptive interface designs steer agent actions.
records.publication_search_text: How Dark Patterns Manipulate Web Agents International Conference on Learning Representations https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2026/hash/9afca5107064eb89546fabb4abc379a7-Abstract-Conference.html https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2026/file/9afca5107064eb89546fabb4abc379a7-Paper-Conference.pdf Phil Cuvin Hao Zhu Diyi Yang

records.name: Video-Browser: Towards Open-web Agentic Video Browsing
It's a TRAP! Task-Redirecting Agent Persuasion Benchmark for Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces TRAP, which evaluates task-redirection attacks embedded in realistic web interfaces. Controlled website clones and a modular injection framework support comparisons of persuasion techniques and contextual changes across agents.

records.name: Nested Browser-Use Learning for Agentic Information Seeking
records.summary: NestBrowse organizes browser actions in a nested framework that separates interaction control from page exploration. It evaluates this design for deep information seeking beyond snippet retrieval and direct URL fetching.

records.name: Enforcing Temporal Constraints for LLM Agents
ShowUI-$π$: Flow-based Generative Models as GUI Dexterous Hands
records.summary: Models discrete clicks and continuous drags with flow-based action generation, and introduces drag trajectories and the ScreenDrag benchmark.

records.name: KGCE: Knowledge-Augmented Dual-Graph Evaluator for Cross-Platform Educational Agent Benchmarking with Multimodal Language Models
From Failure to Mastery: Generating Hard Samples for Tool-use Agents
AI Agent Systems: Architectures, Applications, and Evaluation
Permission Manifests for Web Agents
records.summary: Proposes agent-permissions.json, a website manifest for declaring which interactions web agents may perform, with optional references to APIs.

records.name: ProSoftArena: Benchmarking Hierarchical Capabilities of Multimodal Agents in Professional Software Environments
records.summary: ProSoftArena evaluates 436 professional-software tasks across six disciplines and 13 applications in a Windows 11 virtual-machine environment. Its capability hierarchy, execution-based checks, and human-in-the-loop evaluation cover precise GUI operations and multi-software workflows.

records.name: WebGym: Scaling Training Environments for Visual Web Agents with Realistic Tasks
records.summary: WebGym supplies realistic web tasks with rubric-based evaluation and an asynchronous rollout system for reinforcement learning. It studies how training on an agent’s own interaction traces scales with task coverage and transfers to unseen websites.

records.name: SimpleMem: Efficient Lifelong Memory for LLM Agents
Agent-Dice: Disentangling Knowledge Updates via Geometric Consensus for Agent Continual Learning
records.summary: Agent-Dice fuses parameter updates to support continual learning in LLM agents, with GUI agent tasks evaluated alongside tool-use domains.

records.name: FocusUI: Efficient UI Grounding via Position-Preserving Visual Token Selection
records.summary: FocusUI selects instruction-relevant screenshot patches while preserving their positional structure for GUI grounding. Its PosPad scheme replaces runs of dropped tokens with positional markers and is evaluated under reduced token budgets.

records.name: MobileDreamer: Generative Sketch World Model for GUI Agent
records.summary: MobileDreamer predicts post-action GUI states as task-relevant textual sketches with an order-invariant learning objective. Agents use these predictions for lookahead action selection, evaluated on AndroidWorld.

records.name: InfiniteWeb: Scalable Web Environment Synthesis for GUI Agent Training
records.summary: InfiniteWeb generates functional, interconnected websites and task evaluators using shared specifications and task-driven development. It evaluates website construction and the transfer of GUI policies trained in these synthetic web environments to OSWorld and Online-Mind2Web.

records.name: FronTalk: Benchmarking Front-End Development as Conversational Code Generation with Multi-Modal Feedback
records.summary: FronTalk benchmarks multi-turn front-end code generation from text and visual feedback; a web agent explores generated sites for evaluation and in AceCoder.

records.name: GUITester: Enabling GUI Agents for Exploratory Defect Discovery
records.summary: Introduces GUITestBench for interactive defect discovery and GUITester, which separates task navigation from anomaly verification. Testing-oriented plans and history-based reflection help distinguish software defects from agent execution mistakes.

records.name: Qwen3-VL-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Reranker: A Unified Framework for State-of-the-Art Multimodal Retrieval and Ranking
SimuAgent: An LLM-Based Simulink Modeling Assistant Enhanced with Reinforcement Learning
From Off-Policy to On-Policy: Enhancing GUI Agents via Bi-level Expert-to-Policy Assimilation
records.summary: BEPA adapts a small set of expert GUI traces into policy-aligned guidance through trajectories reachable by the learner and a dynamically updated task cache. It evaluates this two-level approach to reinforcement learning on desktop and web benchmarks.

records.name: Beyond Clicking:A Step Towards Generalist GUI Grounding via Text Dragging
records.summary: GUI-Drag provides synthesized text-dragging examples, while ScreenDrag benchmarks selecting text by dragging across varied GUI contexts.

records.name: C-World: A Computer Use Agent Environment Creator
ArenaRL: Scaling RL for Open-Ended Agents via Tournament-based Relative Ranking
V2P: Visual Attention Calibration for GUI Grounding via Background Suppression and Center Peaking
EZBlender: Efficient 3D Editing with Plan-and-ReAct Agent
ShowUI-Aloha: Human-Taught GUI Agent
records.summary: Transforms human screen recordings and input events into annotated demonstrations used by planning and execution components for GUI tasks.

records.name: ColorBrowserAgent: Complex Long-Horizon Browser Agent with Adaptive Knowledge Evolution
records.summary: ColorBrowserAgent converts human feedback into reusable website knowledge and uses that knowledge to guide progressive context summaries. It evaluates the resulting memory and adaptation mechanisms on long browser workflows.

records.name: When Bots Take the Bait: Exposing and Mitigating the Emerging Social Engineering Attack in Web Automation Agent
records.summary: Studies deceptive social-engineering web patterns targeting browser automation agents and proposes defenses against bait-based manipulation.

records.name: OS-Symphony: A Holistic Framework for Robust and Generalist Computer-Using Agent
records.summary: OS-Symphony coordinates milestone-based reflection and memory with tools that build visually aligned tutorials through browser interaction. The framework evaluates trajectory correction and adaptation on online computer-use benchmarks including OSWorld.

records.name: MemoBrain: Executive Memory as an Agentic Brain for Reasoning
WebTrap Park: An Automated Platform for Systematic Security Evaluation of Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces WebTrap Park, a platform that turns web-agent security risks into executable tasks and assesses concrete interactions with live pages. It compares agent frameworks without requiring modifications to their implementations.

records.name: ExpSeek: Self-Triggered Experience Seeking for Web Agents
records.summary: ExpSeek uses step-level entropy signals to decide when a web agent should request experience-based guidance. It supplies guidance tailored to the current step and evaluates the intervention across web-agent benchmarks.

records.name: PersonalAlign: Hierarchical Implicit Intent Alignment for Personalized GUI Agent with Long-Term User-Centric Records
records.summary: Introduces AndroidIntent to evaluate how GUI agents infer omitted preferences and recurring routines from long-term user records. Its HIM-Agent maintains hierarchical memory of preferences and routines for personalized execution and proactive suggestions.

records.name: R-LAM: Reproducibility-Constrained Large Action Models for Scientific Workflow Automation
GUI-Eyes: Tool-Augmented Perception for Visual Grounding in GUI Agents
records.summary: GUI-Eyes trains GUI grounders to decide when and how to use visual tools such as crops and zooms. Its coarse-to-fine policy uses dense spatial rewards based on location proximity and region overlap, with evaluation on ScreenSpot-Pro.

records.name: Beyond Rule-Based Workflows: An Information-Flow-Orchestrated Multi-Agents Paradigm via Agent-to-Agent Communication from CORAL
CaMeLs Can Use Computers Too: System-level Security for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: NOVA separates trusted task planning from screen-derived observations by producing a branching plan before execution and resolving runtime values through perception. Its OSWorld study examines security and utility while identifying remaining risks from perception-driven branch steering.

records.name: When External Threats Become User Context: Tricking Agents into Accepting Malicious Information
AgencyBench: Benchmarking the Frontiers of Autonomous Agents in 1M-Token Real-World Contexts
Vision-as-Inverse-Graphics Agent via Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning
Compress to Focus: Efficient Coordinate Compression for Policy Optimization in Multi-Turn GUI Agents
records.summary: CCPO couples GUI policy optimization with coordinate-guided compression of past visual observations. It aggregates targets across rollouts to focus retained context and uses distance-based advantages to train grounding and compression together.

records.name: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces
records.summary: Terminal-Bench 2.0 benchmarks agents on 89 workflow-inspired tasks in computer terminal environments, with a distinct environment, human solution and verification tests for each task.

records.name: Mind the Gap: Action Rebinding Attacks against Android GUI Agents
records.summary: Studies action-rebinding attacks in which an Android GUI agent’s planned input is redirected to a different application during the observation–action delay. The evaluation examines cross-application execution and the consequences of treating an earlier screen as the current action target.

records.name: Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI): Architectures, Taxonomies, and Evaluation of Large Language Model Agents
records.summary: Surveys LLM agent architectures, operating environments and evaluation, covering web navigation and native computer use alongside other agent domains.

records.name: MirrorGuard: Toward Secure Computer-Use Agents via Simulation-to-Real Reasoning Correction
records.summary: MirrorGuard trains a reasoning-correction defense using GUI risk trajectories generated in a text-based neural-symbolic simulator. It evaluates whether corrections transfer to computer-use agents operating real interfaces, keeping simulated training separate from deployment tests.

records.name: MagicGUI-RMS: A Multi-Agent Reward Model System for Self-Evolving GUI Agents via Automated Feedback Reflux
records.summary: MagicGUI-RMS combines domain-specific and general reward models to assess GUI actions and propose corrections. A structured data pipeline and feedback-recycling process support repeated reward-model and agent improvement.

records.name: TVWorld: Foundations for Remote-Control TV Agents
Toward Efficient Agents: Memory, Tool learning, and Planning
EvoCUA: Evolving Computer Use Agents via Learning from Scalable Synthetic Experience
records.summary: EvoCUA combines task synthesis with executable validators, asynchronous sandbox rollouts and iterative policy updates. It turns successful routines and analyzed failures into supervision and evaluates the evolving agent on OSWorld.

records.name: Computer Environments Elicit General Agentic Intelligence in LLMs
records.summary: LLM-in-Sandbox gives agents a minimal computer environment for resource access, file management and code execution; LLM-in-Sandbox-RL trains models to use it.

records.name: The Behavioral Fabric of LLM-Powered GUI Agents: Human Values and Interaction Outcomes
records.summary: Introduces a controlled web-task testbed for studying how stated preferences and human values influence GUI-agent decisions. It analyzes how personas alter navigation and how prominent interface cues can override the intended preference guidance.

records.name: GraphPilot: GUI Task Automation with One-Step LLM Reasoning Powered by Knowledge Graph
records.summary: GraphPilot builds app-specific knowledge graphs from explored pages, elements and transitions, then uses them to plan action sequences. It requests additional interface observations when uncertain and checks plans against graph transition rules before correction and execution.

records.name: Prompt Injection Attacks on Agentic Coding Assistants: A Systematic Analysis of Vulnerabilities in Skills, Tools, and Protocol Ecosystems
EntWorld: A Holistic Environment and Benchmark for Verifiable Enterprise GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces EntWorld, an enterprise GUI benchmark built by deriving task logic from database schemas. Long workflows across enterprise domains are assessed with deterministic SQL-based state checks.

records.name: From Struggle to Success: Context-Aware Guidance for Screen Reader Users in Computer Use
records.summary: Introduces AskEase, an on-demand assistant that combines contextual information to provide screen-reader-friendly computer-use guidance. A study with screen-reader users evaluates task completion and perceived workload while preserving human control of the interaction.

records.name: MalURLBench: A Benchmark Evaluating Agents' Vulnerabilities When Processing Web URLs
records.summary: MalURLBench evaluates how LLM-based web agents handle disguised malicious URLs across attack scenarios; the paper also analyzes attack factors and proposes URLGuard.

records.name: GAIA: A Data Flywheel System for Training GUI Test-Time Scaling Critic Models
records.summary: GAIA trains a GUI action critic on positive and negative examples, then uses that critic to collect improved examples for another training round. It studies how recycling these data affects the test-time action choices of different GUI agents.

records.name: SwipeGen: Bridging the Execution Gap in GUI Agents via Human-like Swipe Synthesis
records.summary: Introduces SwipeGen for synthesizing varied swipe trajectories and SwipeBench for assessing their execution quality. The study examines how richer control of trajectory, speed, and timing changes GUI agents’ interaction performance.

records.name: GUIGuard-Bench: Toward a General Evaluation for Privacy-Preserving GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces GUIGuard-Bench, which annotates private regions in GUI trajectories with categories, risk levels, and relevance to the user’s task. It evaluates privacy recognition and the effect of screenshot protection on offline planning and task utility.

records.name: MAGNET: Towards Adaptive GUI Agents with Memory-Driven Knowledge Evolution
records.summary: MAGNET maintains separate memories for stable interface functions and task procedures across changing layouts and workflows. It updates frequently used knowledge and evaluates adaptation in AndroidWorld and offline distribution-shift settings.

records.name: Curiosity Driven Knowledge Retrieval for Mobile Agents
records.summary: Uses execution uncertainty to trigger retrieval from application documentation, code, and past trajectories, organizing the results into structured AppCards for Android agent planning.

records.name: Me-Agent: A Personalized Mobile Agent with Two-Level User Habit Learning for Enhanced Interaction
records.summary: Me-Agent personalizes mobile agent behavior through a preference reward model and hierarchical memory for long-term and app-specific habits, and introduces User FingerTip.

records.name: MobileBench-OL: A Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for Evaluating Mobile GUI Agents in Real-World Environment
records.summary: Introduces MobileBench-OL, an online benchmark of Chinese-app tasks spanning execution, reasoning, exploration, and noisy conditions. Its automatic evaluation and reset framework supports repeated testing of mobile GUI agents in real environments.

records.name: OmegaUse: Building a General-Purpose GUI Agent for Autonomous Task Execution
records.summary: OmegaUse combines exploratory and taxonomy-guided data synthesis with supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO for GUI control. The report introduces OS-Nav for offline Android and Ubuntu evaluation alongside established grounding and action-prediction benchmarks.

records.name: AgentIF-OneDay: A Task-level Instruction-Following Benchmark for General AI Agents in Daily Scenarios
OS-Marathon: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents on Vast-Horizon, Repetitive Tasks
records.summary: Introduces OS-Marathon to evaluate long repetitive computer-use workflows whose execution grows with the amount of input data. It studies failure accumulation under task decomposition and GraphDemo, which adapts agents using a demonstration of the recurring workflow.

records.name: Continual GUI Agents
records.summary: Continual GUI Agents defines grounding under changing application domains and screen resolutions. Its GUI-AiF training framework uses separate point- and region-alignment rewards to adapt grounding as these distributions shift.

records.name: DevOps-Gym: Benchmarking AI Agents in Software DevOps Cycle
CUA-Skill: Develop Skills for Computer Using Agent
records.summary: CUA-Skill encodes Windows application knowledge in parameterized skills and execution/composition graphs. Its agent retrieves and instantiates these skills and uses memory for failure recovery, with end-to-end evaluation on WindowsAgentArena.

records.name: CovAgent: Overcoming the 30% Curse of Mobile Application Coverage with Agentic AI and Dynamic Instrumentation
records.summary: CovAgent augments Android GUI fuzzers by analyzing decompiled app code and component transitions to identify unsatisfied activation conditions. A second agent generates instrumentation that enables otherwise difficult-to-reach activities, with coverage-based evaluation.

records.name: BEAP-Agent: Backtrackable Execution and Adaptive Planning for GUI Agents
records.summary: BEAP-Agent treats GUI execution as depth-first search with coordinated planning, execution and task-state tracking. It supports backtracking across multiple levels of earlier states and evaluates recovery on OSWorld.

records.name: WebArbiter: A Principle-Guided Reasoning Process Reward Model for Web Agents
records.summary: WebArbiter generates reasoned action-preference verdicts for web navigation, using reasoning distillation followed by reinforcement learning. It introduces WebPRMBench and evaluates both preference judgments and reward-guided trajectory search.
records.publication_search_text: WebArbiter: A Generative Reasoning Process Reward Model for Web Agents International Conference on Learning Representations https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2026/hash/c8bd227b32b458970d3ab01a2c372055-Abstract-Conference.html https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2026/file/c8bd227b32b458970d3ab01a2c372055-Paper-Conference.pdf Yao Zhang Shijie Tang Zeyu Li Zhen Han Volker Tresp

records.name: How do Visual Attributes Influence Web Agents? A Comprehensive Evaluation of User Interface Design Factors
records.summary: Introduces VAF, a controlled pipeline that varies webpage appearance while retaining item semantics. It measures both agent clicks and reasoning references to study which visual design factors change browsing decisions.

records.name: DynaWeb: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning of Web Agents
records.summary: DynaWeb learns a world model that predicts web-page representations after actions and uses it to generate policy-training rollouts. It interleaves these rollouts with expert trajectories and evaluates the trained web agents on WebArena and WebVoyager.

records.name: Exploring Reasoning Reward Model for Agents
SSL: Sweet Spot Learning for Differentiated Guidance in Agentic Optimization
records.summary: SSL uses progressively tiered rewards for agent training, including distance-based guidance on GUI perception tasks alongside planning and reasoning tasks.

records.name: Darwinian Memory: A Training-Free Self-Regulating Memory System for GUI Agent Evolution
records.summary: Darwinian Memory splits GUI trajectories into reusable units and updates the memory by retaining useful paths and pruning poor ones. It evaluates this training-free memory mechanism on long multi-application tasks.

records.name: Okara: Detection and Attribution of TLS Man-in-the-Middle Vulnerabilities in Android Apps with Foundation Models
records.summary: Okara uses foundation-model-driven GUI agents to explore Android apps for TLS vulnerability detection, then applies instrumentation and classification to attribute vulnerable code.

records.name: Learning with Challenges: Adaptive Difficulty-Aware Data Generation for Mobile GUI Agent Training
records.summary: MobileGen estimates a mobile agent’s strengths across structural and semantic task difficulty, then samples new training targets around that profile. A controllable multi-agent generator creates the corresponding instructions and GUI trajectories.

records.name: HIDAgent: A Toolkit Enabling "Personal Agents" on HID-Compatible Devices
Agentic Reward Modeling: Verifying GUI Agent via Progressive Trajectory-Grounded Interaction
records.summary: VAGEN verifies GUI trajectories by first extracting readily available evidence and escalating to tool-based environment probes when needed. Evaluation on OSWorld-Verified and AndroidWorld studies verification accuracy and its cost.

records.name: SimGym: Traffic-Grounded Browser Agents for Offline A/B Testing in E-Commerce
records.summary: SimGym runs traffic-grounded synthetic buyers as browser agents to compare e-commerce storefront variants offline, using buyer profiles derived from production interactions.

records.name: Generative Visual Code Mobile World Models
records.summary: gWorld predicts future mobile GUI states as renderable web code and supplies an automated pipeline for code-based training data. The study evaluates visual state prediction and how stronger world models affect downstream mobile policies.

records.name: SafePred: A Predictive Guardrail for Computer-Using Agents via World Models
records.summary: SafePred uses world-model risk forecasts to guide action filtering and task replanning. Its desktop and web safety evaluations distinguish policy compliance, task success and success under the specified policy.

records.name: SafeGround: Know When to Trust GUI Grounding Models via Uncertainty Calibration
records.summary: Introduces SafeGround, which estimates GUI-grounding uncertainty from the spatial dispersion of sampled predictions and calibrates a decision threshold before testing. It studies risk-aware selection on ScreenSpot-Pro, with statistical control scoped to the threshold’s false-discovery rate.

records.name: Avenir-Web: Human-Experience-Imitating Multimodal Web Agents with Mixture of Grounding Experts
records.summary: Avenir-Web combines multiple grounding specialists with procedural experience, a task checklist and adaptive memory. It evaluates this planning and execution framework on live Online-Mind2Web tasks.

records.name: ToolTok: Tool Tokenization for Efficient and Generalizable GUI Agents
records.summary: ToolTok represents GUI operations with learned tool tokens and frames interaction as progressive tool selection. Semantic anchoring and an easy-to-hard curriculum teach tool meanings before visual pathfinding, with evaluation across grounding scenarios.

records.name: Agent Alpha: Tree Search Unifying Generation, Exploration and Evaluation for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Agent Alpha uses step-level Monte Carlo tree search to reuse successful prefixes and recover from early GUI mistakes. Comparison-based evaluation and diversity-constrained expansion guide the search, with experiments on OSWorld.

records.name: AgentDyn: Are Your Agent Security Defenses Deployable in Real-World Dynamic Environments?
LPS-Bench: Benchmarking Safety Awareness of Computer-Use Agents in Long-Horizon Planning under Benign and Adversarial Scenarios
WebSentinel: Detecting and Localizing Prompt Injection Attacks for Web Agents
records.summary: WebSentinel identifies suspicious webpage segments and checks each against its surrounding page context to detect and locate prompt injections. Its evaluation uses both contaminated and clean webpage datasets.

records.name: FullStack-Agent: Enhancing Agentic Full-Stack Web Coding via Development-Oriented Testing and Repository Back-Translation
