PLATO Hand: Shaping Contact Behavior with Fingernails for Precise Manipulation
Do Web Agents Investigate Before They Decide?
records.summary: Introduces MIRAGE, a web decision benchmark where agents must actively uncover evidence that can contradict the visible context. Separate investigation, reasoning, decision, and hallucination measures diagnose failures beyond reaching the right page.

records.name: M$^2$-Miner: Multi-Agent Enhanced MCTS for Mobile GUI Agent Data Mining
records.summary: M2-Miner uses multi-agent-guided Monte Carlo tree search to collect mobile GUI intent–trajectory pairs. Intent recycling and progressive collector training aim to increase the diversity and usefulness of the mined interaction data.

records.name: UI-Mem: Self-Evolving Experience Memory for Online Reinforcement Learning in Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: UI-Mem stores workflows, skills and failure patterns as reusable templates to guide online GUI reinforcement learning. It varies guidance within rollout groups and continually updates the memory so an unguided policy can learn from guided experiences.

records.name: VisRefiner: Learning from Visual Differences for Screenshot-to-Code Generation
A Survey of Agent Memory in the Second Half: Towards Self-Evolving and Long-Horizon Agents
MemGUI-Bench: Benchmarking Memory of Mobile GUI Agents in Dynamic Environments
records.summary: MemGUI-Bench evaluates short-term retention and cross-session experience reuse in mobile GUI agents using paired tasks and repeated-attempt protocols. Its staged evaluator measures memory fidelity, learning and execution efficiency.

records.name: SVRepair: Structured Visual Reasoning for Automated Program Repair
Trifuse: Enhancing Attention-Based GUI Grounding via Multimodal Fusion
records.summary: Trifuse combines attention-based localization with OCR text cues and icon captions to ground GUI instructions. Its fusion procedure favors cross-modal agreement and sharp location peaks, and is evaluated without task-specific fine-tuning.

records.name: POINTS-GUI-G: GUI-Grounding Journey
records.summary: Studies GUI-grounding development from a weakly grounded base model through data preparation, visual training, and verifiable rewards.

records.name: AgentCPM-Explore: Realizing Long-Horizon Deep Exploration for Edge-Scale Agents
PlanViz: Evaluating Planning-Oriented Image Generation and Editing for Computer-Use Tasks
Where Not to Learn: Prior-Aligned Training with Subset-based Attribution Constraints
records.summary: Proposes training with subset-based attribution constraints so models attend to intended evidence, evaluated on image classification and GUI-agent click decisions.

records.name: ANCHOR: Branch-Point Data Generation for GUI Agents
records.summary: ANCHOR expands verified desktop demonstrations by generating new tasks at meaningful branch points and executing their instructions. State-aware verification and action filtering refine the resulting trajectories, which are evaluated through fine-tuned agents on OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena.

records.name: Mapping the Design Space of User Experience for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Develops a taxonomy of computer-use-agent interaction design through system review and practitioner interviews. A Wizard-of-Oz study then examines how users respond to normal, erroneous, and risky web-based execution, focusing on control, explanation, prompts, and mental models.

records.name: Do Multi-Agents Dream of Electric Screens? Achieving Perfect Accuracy on AndroidWorld Through Task Decomposition
records.summary: Minitap coordinates six specialized agents for AndroidWorld tasks, checking text input against device state and detecting action loops to revise its strategy.

records.name: CausalArmor: Efficient Indirect Prompt Injection Guardrails via Causal Attribution
When Benign Inputs Lead to Severe Harms: Eliciting Unsafe Unintended Behaviors of Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: AutoElicit iteratively revises benign instructions using execution feedback to surface harmful unintended actions by computer-use agents in OS workflows.

records.name: When Actions Go Off-Task: Detecting and Correcting Misaligned Actions in Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: MisActBench provides action-level labels for task alignment, while DeAction checks proposed computer-use actions and requests revisions through structured feedback. The paper separately evaluates offline detection and interactive operation in OSWorld and RedTeamCUA.

records.name: GUI-GenBench: Evaluating Image Generation Models as Interactive GUI Environments
records.summary: GUI-GenBench tests image-generation models as action-conditioned GUI environments across five suites, including transitions, trajectories and grounding. Its VLM-based GUI-Score separates goal completion, interaction logic, consistency and visual properties.

records.name: Next-Gen CAPTCHAs: Leveraging the Cognitive Gap for Scalable and Diverse GUI-Agent Defense
records.summary: Next-Gen CAPTCHAs introduces generated interactive challenges intended to distinguish human users from GUI agents. The benchmark targets perception, memory, decisions and actions, with backend-supported challenge types designed for scalable instance generation.

records.name: UI-Venus-1.5 Technical Report
records.summary: Describes a GUI-agent family combining broad intermediate training, full-trajectory online reinforcement learning, and merging of specialized models.

records.name: Agent Banana: High-Fidelity Image Editing with Agentic Thinking and Tooling
MUZZLE: Adaptive Agentic Red-Teaming of Web Agents Against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks
records.summary: MUZZLE evaluates web-agent exposure to indirect prompt injection by finding attack surfaces in agent trajectories and refining injected instructions from execution feedback.

records.name: A11y-CUA Dataset: Characterizing the Accessibility Gap in Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces A11y-CUA, a dataset comparing how blind or low-vision users and sighted users perform everyday computer tasks. It contrasts those traces with agent behavior under default, keyboard-only, and magnifier conditions to identify barriers to shared control.

records.name: TreeCUA: Efficiently Scaling GUI Automation with Tree-Structured Verifiable Evolution
records.summary: TreeCUA organizes GUI exploration trajectories as reusable trees and balances deeper tasks against broader coverage. Its data pipeline combines action verification, memory-backed recovery and a DPO variant that uses information from adjacent branches.

records.name: Code2World: A GUI World Model via Renderable Code Generation
records.summary: Code2World predicts future GUI screens through renderable code, trained on AndroidCode trajectories with supervised learning and render-aware reinforcement learning. It evaluates visual prediction and downstream AndroidWorld navigation with the learned world model.

records.name: Anonymization-Enhanced Privacy Protection for Mobile GUI Agents: Available but Invisible
records.summary: An anonymization framework replaces sensitive screen content and instructions with consistent, type-preserving placeholders while mediating actions through a local interaction proxy. Experiments on AndroidLab and PrivScreen examine the privacy–utility trade-off when mobile GUI agents operate over these transformed interfaces.

records.name: Autonomous Continual Learning for Environment Adaptation of Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: ACuRL uses autonomous interface exploration and an adaptive task curriculum to continually train computer-use policies with reinforcement learning. CUAJudge supplies outcome feedback, and experiments study adaptation across desktop applications and environment changes.

records.name: Control Reinforcement Learning: Interpretable Token-Level Steering of LLMs via Sparse Autoencoder Features
LHAW: Controllable Underspecification for Long-Horizon Tasks
records.summary: LHAW generates underspecified variants of long-horizon workflow tasks and uses agent trials to evaluate when missing information requires clarification.

records.name: See, Plan, Snap: Evaluating Multimodal GUI Agents in Scratch
records.summary: ScratchWorld evaluates program construction through the Scratch interface using fine-grained drag-and-drop actions and a complementary semantic-API mode. Runtime tests assess the resulting programs, allowing analysis of the gap between program reasoning and GUI manipulation.

records.name: ICA: Information-Aware Credit Assignment for Visually Grounded Long-Horizon Information-Seeking Agents
records.summary: Information-Aware Credit Assignment scores intermediate information gathered by web agents, using rendered webpage snapshots to compare evidence across trajectories.

records.name: Blind Gods and Broken Screens: Architecting a Secure, Intent-Centric Mobile Agent Operating System
records.summary: Analyzes security risks in screen-based mobile agents and proposes Aura, an agent runtime with structured interactions, app-agent isolation and mediated communication.

records.name: GameDevBench: Evaluating Agentic Capabilities Through Game Development
Agent-Diff: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise API Tasks via Code Execution with State-Diff-Based Evaluation
How Smart Is Your GUI Agent? A Framework for the Future of Software Interaction
records.summary: Proposes GUI Agent Autonomy Levels (GAL), a six-level framework for describing autonomy and benchmarking GUI agents that navigate web, desktop, and mobile software.

records.name: Adaptive Milestone Reward for GUI Agents
records.summary: ADMIRE extracts milestones from successful GUI explorations to provide adaptive intermediate rewards. It assigns credit differently to successful and failed trajectories and evaluates training on AndroidWorld, with additional transfer studies in web and embodied settings.

records.name: DRACO: a Cross-Domain Benchmark for Deep Research Accuracy, Completeness, and Objectivity
WebTestPilot: Agentic End-to-End Web Testing against Natural Language Specification by Inferring Oracles with Symbolized GUI Elements
records.summary: WebTestPilot turns natural-language requirements into web test steps with inferred preconditions and postconditions over symbolized GUI elements. A benchmark of bug-injected web applications tests whether these context-aware oracles distinguish application defects from agent mistakes.

records.name: AmbiBench: Benchmarking Mobile GUI Agents Beyond One-Shot Instructions in the Wild
records.summary: AmbiBench evaluates mobile GUI agents under four levels of instruction clarity, including tasks requiring active clarification. Its MUSE evaluator separately audits outcomes, execution quality and interaction quality to study alignment with user intent.

records.name: Zooming without Zooming: Region-to-Image Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
Agentic Test-Time Scaling for WebAgents
records.summary: CATTS allocates additional inference computation when an agent’s action votes show uncertainty. The paper compares voting and arbiter strategies and evaluates this selective scaling on WebArena-Lite, Online-Mind2Web and GoBrowse.

records.name: Perceptual Self-Reflection in Agentic Physics Simulation Code Generation
Agent Skills for Large Language Models: Architecture, Acquisition, Security, and the Path Forward
records.summary: This survey organizes agent skills by architecture, acquisition, deployment and security, including their role in computer-use systems and GUI grounding. It also proposes a permission and lifecycle governance framework for skill deployment.

records.name: Scaling Web Agent Training through Automatic Data Generation and Fine-grained Evaluation
records.summary: This work uses constraint-based progress evaluation to retain partially successful web trajectories for training. It introduces BookingArena for structured booking tasks and studies a distilled agent trained with the resulting data.

records.name: WebClipper: Efficient Evolution of Web Agents with Graph-based Trajectory Pruning
DECKBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Frameworks for Academic Slide Generation and Editing
SPILLage: Agentic Oversharing on the Web
records.summary: Formalizes and measures natural agentic oversharing when browser agents handle private user emails and calendars across live websites.

records.name: LiveNewsBench: Evaluating LLM Web Search Capabilities with Freshly Curated News
OpAgent: Operator Agent for Web Navigation
records.summary: OpAgent combines multi-task GUI fine-tuning with online web reinforcement learning using outcome judgments and rule-based progress rewards. A modular planner, grounder, reflector and summarizer support navigation and recovery, evaluated separately from the underlying trained policy.

records.name: Building Autonomous GUI Navigation via Agentic-Q Estimation and Step-Wise Policy Optimization
records.summary: This framework learns an agentic-Q model to estimate individual actions’ contributions to GUI task completion. It then optimizes a policy with step-level samples from its own trajectories, decoupling policy updates from environment interaction.

records.name: GUI-GENESIS: Automated Synthesis of Efficient Environments with Verifiable Rewards for GUI Agent Post-Training
records.summary: GUI-GENESIS reconstructs applications as lightweight web environments with executable assertions for reward computation. It evaluates the cost of these training environments and transfer from synthetic interaction training to held-out real tasks.

records.name: ScreenParse: Moving Beyond Sparse Grounding with Complete Screen Parsing Supervision
records.summary: ScreenParse supplies dense annotations of UI elements, types and text in web screenshots through an automated rendering and filtering pipeline. ScreenVLM learns to output structured screen markup, and the study evaluates dense parsing and transfer to GUI grounding.

records.name: AutoWebWorld: Synthesizing Infinite Verifiable Web Environments via Finite State Machines
records.summary: AutoWebWorld turns finite-state task models into interactive websites whose actions and goal states can be checked programmatically. It generates verified trajectories for training and evaluates transfer to WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web.

records.name: LongCLI-Bench: A Preliminary Benchmark and Study for Long-horizon Agentic Programming in Command-Line Interfaces
A Trajectory-Based Safety Audit of Clawdbot (OpenClaw)
records.summary: Audits Clawdbot safety through logged action and tool-call trajectories across local execution and web-mediated workflows, using automated and human review.

records.name: WebWorld: A Large-Scale World Model for Web Agent Training
records.summary: Introduces WebWorld, an open-web simulator trained on interaction trajectories for generating agent training data and testing candidate actions. WebWorld-Bench evaluates simulated transitions, alongside downstream web-agent training experiments.

records.name: EmbeWebAgent: Embedding Web Agents into Any Customized UI
records.summary: EmbeWebAgent embeds agent access into existing web applications through frontend observations and a page-specific function registry. Its workflow combines GUI primitives, composite actions and MCP tools, demonstrated in a live interface.

records.name: Mnemis: Dual-Route Retrieval on Hierarchical Graphs for Long-Term LLM Memory
World-Model-Augmented Web Agents with Action Correction
records.summary: WAC has a web-agent action model consult a world model, simulate action outcomes and use judge feedback to correct actions before execution.

records.name: ChartEditBench: Evaluating Grounded Multi-Turn Chart Editing in Multimodal Language Models
HiPER: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Explicit Credit Assignment for Large Language Model Agents
records.summary: HiPER trains interactive LLM agents with separate subgoal planning and multi-step execution, assigning reinforcement-learning credit at both levels.

records.name: MemoryArena: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Interdependent Multi-Session Agentic Tasks
records.summary: MemoryArena links tasks across sessions so that agents must distill earlier interaction experience and use it in later decisions. Its evaluation includes web navigation alongside planning, search and formal reasoning, testing memory through subsequent actions.

records.name: Towards a Science of AI Agent Reliability
Mobile-Agent-v3.5: Multi-platform Fundamental GUI Agents
records.summary: Presents GUI-Owl-1.5 variants and a hybrid data pipeline for multimodal GUI interaction, tool use, memory, and multi-platform tasks.

records.name: Persona2Web: Benchmarking Personalized Web Agents for Contextual Reasoning with User History
records.summary: Persona2Web tests whether web agents can resolve ambiguous requests using preferences implicit in a user’s history. Its reasoning-aware evaluation compares agent architectures and history-access strategies on personalized tasks on the open web.

records.name: IntentCUA: Learning Intent-level Representations for Skill Abstraction and Multi-Agent Planning in Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: IntentCUA coordinates planner and critic agents through shared intent-aligned memory, retrieving reusable skills for long-horizon automation across desktop applications.

records.name: Web Agents Should Use Typed Actions Instead of Click-Based Browsing
records.summary: Proposes web verbs as typed actions for web agents, exposing operations with structured inputs, outputs and conditions so agents can compose auditable workflows.

records.name: Computer-Using World Model
records.summary: Presents a desktop world model that predicts textual UI changes before synthesizing the next screenshot. It learns from Microsoft Office transitions and is evaluated by letting a frozen agent compare simulated actions before execution.

records.name: Modeling Distinct Human Interaction in Web Agents
records.summary: CowCorpus records interleaved human and agent actions during web navigation and identifies distinct patterns of user intervention. Models trained to anticipate these interventions are integrated into live web agents and assessed in a user study.

records.name: DesignAsCode: Bridging Structural Editability and Visual Fidelity in Graphic Design Generation
1D-Bench: A Benchmark for Iterative UI Code Generation with Visual Feedback in Real-World
ActionEngine: From Reactive to Programmatic Web Agents via State Machine Memory
records.summary: ActionEngine explores web applications to build an updateable state-machine memory of GUI states, operations and transitions. It generates complete task programs from that memory, using reactive repair to handle changed interfaces or missing knowledge.

records.name: ProactiveMobile: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Boosting Proactive Intelligence on Mobile Devices
records.summary: ProactiveMobile benchmarks mobile agents on inferring latent user intent from device context and generating executable sequences from a pool of 63 APIs.

records.name: GUI-Libra: Training Native GUI Agents to Reason and Act with Action-aware Supervision and Partially Verifiable RL
records.summary: GUI-Libra trains GUI agents with action-aware supervision, a curated reasoning dataset and reinforcement learning adapted to partially verifiable actions across web and mobile tasks.

records.name: DeepPresenter: Environment-Grounded Reflection for Agentic Presentation Generation
OmniGAIA: Towards Native Omni-Modal AI Agents
AgentVista: Evaluating Multimodal Agents in Ultra-Challenging Realistic Visual Scenarios
Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning for Efficient High-Resolution GUI Agents
records.summary: GUIPruner compresses high-resolution screenshots and interaction history for GUI navigation through training-free resizing and layout-aware token pruning.

records.name: CoME: Empowering Channel-of-Mobile-Experts with Informative Hybrid-Capabilities Reasoning
records.summary: Introduces Channel-of-Mobile-Experts (CoME), a mobile agent with experts for screen summary, subtask planning, action decisions and action functions, trained in stages with InfoGain-Driven DPO (Info-DPO).

records.name: ST-Lite: Training-Free KV Cache Compression with Spatio-Trajectory Guidance for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces ST-Lite, a training-free KV cache compression scheme for vision-language GUI agents that filters redundant frames and preserves small UI elements in interaction traces.

records.name: Atomicity for Agents: Exposing, Exploiting, and Mitigating TOCTOU Vulnerabilities in Browser-Use Agents
records.summary: Identifies time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race vulnerabilities when web pages mutate between agent planning and action execution.

records.name: M$^2$: Dual-Memory Augmentation for Long-Horizon Web Agents via Trajectory Summarization and Insight Retrieval
records.summary: Introduces M², a training-free memory framework for long-horizon web agents that summarizes interaction history and retrieves task guidance from an offline insight bank.

records.name: K^2-Agent: Co-Evolving Know-What and Know-How for Hierarchical Mobile Device Control
records.summary: Introduces K2-Agent, a hierarchical mobile-control framework that refines task knowledge through a reasoning loop and trains an executor with curriculum-guided reinforcement learning.

records.name: NERFIFY: A Multi-Agent Framework for Turning NeRF Papers into Code
MM-DeepResearch: A Simple and Effective Multimodal Agentic Search Baseline
Egocentric Co-Pilot: Web-Native Smart-Glasses Agents for Assistive Egocentric AI
DeepResearch-9K: A Challenging Benchmark Dataset of Deep-Research Agent
VSearcher: Long-Horizon Multimodal Search Agent via Reinforcement Learning
CGL: Advancing Continual GUI Learning via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
records.summary: Combines supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning for continual GUI learning, using policy entropy to adjust their proportions and gradient projection to limit conflicting updates. AndroidControl-CL groups applications into sequential tasks to evaluate adaptation and retention.

records.name: PlugMem: A Task-Agnostic Plugin Memory Module for LLM Agents
records.summary: Introduces PlugMem, a knowledge-graph memory module for general LLM agents, evaluated on web-agent tasks alongside conversational question answering and knowledge retrieval.

records.name: Dual-Modality Multi-Stage Adversarial Safety Training: Robustifying Multimodal Web Agents Against Cross-Modal Attacks
records.summary: Studies webpage injections that affect both screenshots and accessibility trees, then trains web agents through teacher imitation, supervised adversarial examples, and adversarial reinforcement learning. The evaluation tests defenses on MiniWoB++ and held-out tasks.

records.name: Act-Observe-Rewrite: Multimodal Coding Agents as In-Context Policy Learners for Robot Manipulation
TimeWarp: Evaluating Web Agents by Revisiting the Past
records.summary: TimeWarp tests web agents across multiple versions of the same sites, varying visual design, frontend code and workflows. TimeTraj transfers plans across versions to collect training trajectories and study robustness to interface change.

records.name: WebFactory: Automated Compression of Foundational Language Intelligence into Grounded Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces WebFactory, a GUI-agent training pipeline that synthesizes websites, generates tasks and trajectories, and trains with decomposed rewards. Offline and online transfer evaluations examine agents trained on the generated environments.

records.name: STRUCTUREDAGENT: Planning with AND/OR Trees for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
records.summary: Introduces STRUCTUREDAGENT, a web-agent planning framework that interleaves execution with dynamic AND/OR trees, supporting node repair and exploration of alternative plans.

records.name: WebChain: A Large-Scale Human-Annotated Dataset of Real-World Web Interaction Traces
records.summary: WebChain aligns human web-interaction trajectories with visual, structural and action data for agent training. It also introduces WebChainBench and a mid-training approach that separates spatial grounding from planning.

records.name: ResearchEnvBench: Benchmarking Agents on Environment Synthesis for Research Code Execution
Enhancing Web Agents with a Hierarchical Memory Tree
records.summary: Introduces Hierarchical Memory Tree (HMT), which organizes web-agent trajectories by intent, stage and action, then uses the hierarchy to plan and act on websites.

records.name: AutoUE: Automated Generation of 3D Games in Unreal Engine via Multi-Agent Systems
Generalization in Online Reinforcement Learning for Mobile Agents
records.summary: Introduces AndroidWorld-Generalization with separate tests for unseen task instances, templates, and applications. A GRPO training system combines containerized environments with asynchronous trajectory collection to study these generalization regimes.

records.name: SynPlanResearch-R1: Encouraging Tool Exploration for Deep Research with Synthetic Plans
Ares: Adaptive Reasoning Effort Selection for Efficient LLM Agents
records.summary: Introduces Ares, a router that selects a reasoning level for each step of a general LLM agent from its interaction history, with web agents among the evaluation settings.

records.name: OSExpert: Computer-Use Agents Learning Professional Skills via Exploration
records.summary: Uses GUI-based depth-first exploration to verify elementary software functions, assemble action primitives, and construct curricula of composed skills. OSExpert-Eval examines how the resulting procedural knowledge supports complex computer-use tasks.

records.name: PIRA-Bench: A Transition from Reactive GUI Agents to GUI-based Proactive Intent Recommendation Agents
records.summary: PIRA-Bench evaluates proactive intent recommendations from noisy GUI screenshot sequences containing interleaved tasks and user context. Its PIRF baseline combines memory and state tracking to maintain multiple task threads and identify opportunities to assist.

records.name: SlowBA: An efficiency backdoor attack towards VLM-based GUI agents
records.summary: Introduces SlowBA, a backdoor attack on vision-language GUI agents that uses pop-up triggers to induce longer reasoning chains and increase response latency.

records.name: SecAgent: Efficient Mobile GUI Agent with Semantic Context
records.summary: Presents a Chinese mobile GUI dataset and navigation benchmark together with SecAgent, which compresses previous screenshots and actions into semantic summaries. The agent is trained with supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning to use this compact interaction context.

records.name: Agentic Critical Training
records.summary: Introduces Agentic Critical Training (ACT), a reinforcement-learning warm-up that teaches general agents to choose expert actions over alternatives, with WebShop among its evaluations.

records.name: AgentOS: From Application Silos to a Natural Language-Driven Data Ecosystem
records.summary: Proposes Personal Agent Operating System (AgentOS), with a natural language or voice portal and an Agent Kernel that coordinates agents and tasks in place of a GUI desktop.

records.name: IntroSVG: Learning from Rendering Feedback for Text-to-SVG Generation via an Introspective Generator-Critic Framework
SpreadsheetArena: Decomposing Preference in LLM Generation of Spreadsheet Workbooks
Video-Based Reward Modeling for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Builds ExeVR-53k from execution-video, instruction and reward triplets, including negative instructions with step annotations. A reward model uses spatiotemporal token pruning to judge task completion from the instruction and execution keyframes.

records.name: SpecOps: A Fully Automated AI Agent Testing Framework in Real-World GUI Environments
records.summary: SpecOps divides testing of GUI-based agents into test generation, environment setup, execution and validation handled by specialist agents. Its evaluation spans five real-world agents, including web applications and browser extensions, and measures execution reliability and bug discovery.

records.name: Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory for GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces HyMEM, a graph-based memory for GUI agents that links symbolic task knowledge with trajectory embeddings and refreshes working memory during computer-use tasks.

records.name: Safe and Scalable Web Agent Learning via Recreated Websites
records.summary: Introduces VeriEnv, which recreates websites as executable training environments and exposes internal state through a Python SDK for task generation and deterministic reward checks. Experiments examine web-agent learning across new and expanded site environments.

records.name: CUAAudit: Meta-Evaluation of Vision-Language Models as Auditors of Autonomous Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: CUAAudit examines vision-language models that judge computer-use task completion from an instruction and final environment state. Across macOS, Windows and Linux benchmarks, it measures accuracy, confidence calibration and disagreement between auditors.

records.name: Terminal Is All You Need: Design Properties for Human-AI Agent Collaboration
records.summary: This position paper derives interface design principles from terminal-based human-agent collaboration: representational compatibility, transparent actions and low participation barriers. It argues that graphical and other agent-facing modalities should provide these properties explicitly.

records.name: You Told Me to Do It: Measuring Instructional Text-induced Private Data Leakage in LLM Agents
records.summary: Introduces ReadSecBench, a README-based benchmark for measuring whether high-privilege agents follow injected instructions that leak private data; a computer-use agent is evaluated.

records.name: HATS: Hardness-Aware Trajectory Synthesis for GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces HATS, which directs GUI trajectory exploration toward semantically ambiguous actions and iteratively checks instruction-execution alignment. Feedback from trajectory refinement updates the exploration signal used to collect subsequent training examples.

records.name: SceneAssistant: A Visual Feedback Agent for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Generation
Feynman: Knowledge-Infused Diagramming Agent for Scalable Visual Designs
AI Planning Framework for LLM-Based Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces a planning taxonomy and trajectory-quality metrics for web agents, supported by 794 human-labeled WebArena trajectories and a comparison of two planning styles.

records.name: Adaptive Vision-Language Model Routing for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Adaptive VLM Routing estimates GUI-action difficulty and small-model confidence to select a model under a predicted reliability threshold. Grounding and agent-routing benchmarks assess the cost–accuracy trade-off, with prior interaction context used for warm agents.

records.name: Why Do LLM-based Web Agents Fail? A Hierarchical Planning Perspective
records.summary: Presents a hierarchical planning framework for evaluating web agents at planning, execution and replanning stages, and reports low-level execution as the main failure source.

records.name: Zoom to Essence: Trainless GUI Grounding by Inferring upon Interface Elements
records.summary: Presents ZoomUI, a training-free grounding method that expresses instructions as visual element descriptions and uses model attention to zoom progressively into relevant interface regions. Evaluation examines instruction-to-element localization on GUI benchmarks.

records.name: Visual Confused Deputy: Exploiting and Defending Perception Failures in Computer-Using Agents
records.summary: Formalizes a visual confused-deputy failure in which a computer agent acts on a misperceived UI object. A separate guardrail checks both the visual target and the agent's action reasoning against deployment-specific knowledge before permitting execution.

records.name: GUI-CEval: A Hierarchical and Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: GUI-CEval evaluates Chinese mobile GUI agents through a hierarchy of atomic abilities and application-level tasks collected on physical devices. Its diagnostics cover perception, planning, reflection, execution and post-action evaluation across a broad set of apps.

records.name: How Vulnerable Are AI Agents to Indirect Prompt Injections? Insights from a Large-Scale Public Competition
records.summary: This public red-teaming study evaluates indirect prompt injection that both changes agent behavior and hides the compromise from the final response. Its scenarios include computer use alongside tool calling and coding, with analyses of transfer and model-dependent vulnerability.

records.name: VisBrowse-Bench: Benchmarking Visual-Native Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents
VideoMatGen: PBR Materials through Joint Generative Modeling
Learning to Present: Inverse Specification Rewards for Agentic Slide Generation
WebPII: Benchmarking Visual PII Detection for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: WebPII provides synthetic e-commerce screenshots with fine-grained annotations for sensitive information, including partially filled forms and transaction identifiers. It also trains WebRedact to detect visual PII as a privacy component for computer-use agents.

records.name: AdaZoom-GUI: Adaptive Zoom-based GUI Grounding with Instruction Refinement
records.summary: Combines instruction rewriting with conditional second-stage zooming for small GUI targets. A grounding dataset and GRPO training support joint prediction of click coordinates and element bounding boxes.

records.name: FailureMem: A Failure-Aware Multimodal Framework for Autonomous Software Repair
AndroTMem: From Interaction Trajectories to Anchored Memory in Long-Horizon GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces AndroTMem-Bench for Android tasks whose later actions depend on earlier UI states. Anchored State Memory retains causally linked intermediate states for subgoal-specific retrieval and evaluates them against full-history and summary-based memory.

records.name: ClawTrap: A MITM-Based Red-Teaming Framework for Real-World OpenClaw Security Evaluation
records.summary: Presents a man-in-the-middle network red-teaming framework for evaluating autonomous OpenClaw agents under live traffic manipulation.

records.name: OS-Themis: A Scalable Critic Framework for Generalist GUI Rewards
records.summary: Presents OS-Themis, a multi-agent critic that divides GUI trajectories into verifiable milestones and reviews their evidence before assigning an outcome. OGRBench evaluates GUI rewards across platforms, with AndroidWorld experiments examining training and trajectory filtering.

records.name: A Subgoal-driven Framework for Improving Long-Horizon LLM Agents
records.summary: The framework separates inference-time subgoal planning from MiRA, a reinforcement-learning method that supplies milestone rewards. WebArena-Lite experiments evaluate these mechanisms for long-horizon web navigation.

records.name: Memori: A Persistent Memory Layer for Efficient, Context-Aware LLM Agents
MedSPOT: A Workflow-Aware Sequential Grounding Benchmark for Clinical GUI
records.summary: Benchmarks sequential target localization in clinical software workflows, emphasizing how early mistakes affect subsequent interaction steps.

records.name: OpenResearcher: A Fully Open Pipeline for Long-Horizon Deep Research Trajectory Synthesis
ContractSkill: Repairable Contract-Based Skills for Multimodal Web Agents
records.summary: Turns draft web-agent skills into structured executable artifacts that support deterministic checks, fault localization and local repair. VisualWebArena and MiniWoB experiments examine execution and reuse within the same benchmark family.

records.name: MANA: Towards Efficient Mobile Ad Detection via Multimodal Agentic UI Navigation
records.summary: MANA combines visual, temporal and exploration signals to guide navigation toward mobile advertisements. It evaluates ad detection and interaction cost on commercial smartphones, including obfuscated-ad cases.

records.name: Seeing is Improving: Visual Feedback for Iterative Text Layout Refinement
CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
Ego2Web: A Web Agent Benchmark Grounded in Egocentric Videos
records.summary: Ego2Web pairs first-person videos with online tasks that require agents to connect the user’s physical context to web actions. It also evaluates an automatic task judge against human judgments and analyzes failures in video understanding and web execution.

records.name: The Evolution of Tool Use in LLM Agents: From Single-Tool Call to Multi-Tool Orchestration
records.summary: Surveys multi-tool LLM agents across planning, training, safety, efficiency, and evaluation, including GUI and mobile systems among its application areas.

records.name: IntentWeave: A Progressive Entry Ladder for Multi-Surface Browser Agents in Cloud Portals
records.summary: Introduces IntentWeave, a design space and browser-extension prototype for placing web-agent assistance across browser surfaces, evaluated through a study of three entry strategies.

records.name: AgentRAE: Remote Action Execution through Notification-based Visual Backdoors against Screenshots-based Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: AgentRAE studies notification-based visual backdoors that redirect mobile GUI-agent actions. Its training separates sensitivity to icon differences from trigger/action association, with evaluations of clean behavior and targeted redirection.

records.name: Plato's Cave: A Human-Centered Research Verification System
CAPTCHA Solving for Native GUI Agents: Automated Reasoning-Action Data Generation and Self-Corrective Training
records.summary: Introduces ReCAP, a native GUI agent for interactive CAPTCHA challenges, trained with generated interaction trajectories, reasoning traces and self-correction data.

records.name: The Cognitive Firewall:Securing Browser Based AI Agents Against Indirect Prompt Injection Via Hybrid Edge Cloud Defense
records.summary: Proposes a split-compute browser defense pairing a local visual sentinel, a cloud planner, and deterministic policy enforcement against indirect prompt injection.

records.name: CarePilot: A Multi-Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Computer Task Automation in Healthcare
records.summary: CareFlow benchmarks long healthcare-software workflows, while CarePilot coordinates action proposals, execution checks and corrective feedback using short- and long-term memory. Its actor consumes visual interfaces and system state to select semantic actions.

records.name: Towards Automated Crowdsourced Testing via Personified-LLM
records.summary: Introduces PersonaTester, a framework that gives LLM agents tester personas to vary their exploration and interaction habits during automated crowdsourced GUI testing.

records.name: CUA-Suite: Massive Human-annotated Video Demonstrations for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: CUA-Suite combines continuous expert desktop demonstrations in VideoCUA with the UI-Vision evaluation benchmark and GroundCUA grounding data. Screen recordings, cursor traces and layered annotations support study of temporal behavior and professional software workflows.

records.name: UI-Voyager: A Self-Evolving GUI Agent Learning via Failed Experience
records.summary: Introduces a two-stage mobile GUI learner that first co-evolves trajectories and policies through rejection fine-tuning. Group Relative Self-Distillation then uses successful rollout branches to provide step-level supervision for failed trajectories, evaluated on AndroidWorld.

records.name: WebTestBench: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents towards End-to-End Automated Web Testing
records.summary: Introduces WebTestBench for end-to-end website testing, separating checklist generation from defect detection. Its WebTester baseline evaluates test coverage, detection and sustained interaction across web application categories.

records.name: RealChart2Code: Advancing Chart-to-Code Generation with Real Data and Multi-Task Evaluation
GUIDE: A Benchmark for Understanding and Assisting Users in Open-Ended GUI Tasks
records.summary: GUIDE evaluates whether models can recognize a user’s behavior, infer intent and decide when to offer help during open-ended software tasks. It uses narrated screen recordings of novice users and studies the effect of additional user context on these assistance decisions.

records.name: Where and How to Prune: An Empirical Study of Visual Token Pruning for GUI Agent Navigation
records.summary: Studies visual token pruning for GUI navigation, separating reusable screenshot encoder embeddings from later language-model computation. The analysis examines foreground-background token allocation and spatial coverage when pruning historical screenshots.

records.name: Towards GUI Agents: Vision-Language Diffusion Models for GUI Grounding
records.summary: Adapts a discrete vision-language diffusion model to single-turn GUI action and bounding-box prediction, using a hybrid masking schedule for coordinate geometry. Experiments across web, desktop and mobile datasets examine grounding accuracy and inference tradeoffs.

records.name: GUIDE: Resolving Domain Bias in GUI Agents through Real-Time Web Video Retrieval and Plug-and-Play Annotation
records.summary: GUIDE retrieves relevant software tutorials through subtitle-based video search, then infers planning and grounding knowledge from consecutive annotated keyframes. It inserts that knowledge into existing GUI-agent modules without parameter updates and evaluates the plug-in on OSWorld.

records.name: Vision2Web: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Visual Website Development with Agent Verification
records.summary: Introduces Vision2Web, a benchmark for website development from images, spanning UI-to-code, multi-page frontend and full-stack tasks, with a GUI agent verifier and VLM-based judge.

records.name: AgentSwing: Adaptive Parallel Context Management Routing for Long-Horizon Web Agents
MolmoPoint: Better Pointing for VLMs with Grounding Tokens
records.summary: MolmoPoint replaces textual coordinate generation with pointing tokens that select visual regions and refine them through subpatches. The general image/video method includes GUI-pointing evaluation on ScreenSpotPro alongside other visual grounding tasks.

records.name: MiroEval: Benchmarking Multimodal Deep Research Agents in Process and Outcome
"What Did It Actually Do?": Understanding Risk Awareness and Traceability for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Presents an interview study of computer-use agent risks and AgentTrace, a prototype interface showing agent actions, resource access, permission history, and lasting changes.

records.name: Emergence WebVoyager: Toward Consistent and Transparent Evaluation of (Web) Agents in The Wild
records.summary: Audits sources of ambiguity and operational variation in WebVoyager evaluation and introduces standardized guidance for task setup, failure handling, annotation and reporting. Emergence WebVoyager applies this protocol to a web-agent evaluation.

records.name: SciVisAgentBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Scientific Data Analysis and Visualization Agents
PSPA-Bench: A Personalized Benchmark for Smartphone GUI Agent
records.summary: PSPA-Bench evaluates personalized smartphone GUI behavior using user-specific instructions and a process-aware assessment of interaction traces. Its comparison of GUI agents diagnoses weaknesses in adapting workflows and preferences.

records.name: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
records.summary: Studies enterprise automation by terminal agents that call platform APIs, comparing their task results and cost with other agent approaches, including web agents using graphical interfaces.

records.name: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants
PixelPrune: Pixel-Level Adaptive Visual Token Reduction via Predictive Coding
records.summary: PixelPrune removes pixel-redundant patches before the vision encoder, reducing both encoding and downstream language-model work. The training-free method evaluates lossless and controlled-lossy compression on document and GUI tasks.

records.name: When Users Change Their Mind: Evaluating Interruptible Agents in Long-Horizon Web Navigation
records.summary: Introduces InterruptBench, a WebArena-Lite-derived benchmark that tests how long-horizon web-navigation agents handle mid-task user additions, revisions, and retractions.

records.name: Do Phone-Use Agents Respect Your Privacy?
records.summary: Introduces MyPhoneBench to verify whether phone-use agents minimize personal data disclosure when filling forms during benign mobile tasks.

records.name: AgentWatcher: A Rule-based Prompt Injection Monitor
HippoCamp: Benchmarking Contextual Agents on Personal Computers
Read More, Think More: Revisiting Observation Reduction for Web Agents
records.summary: Studies HTML and accessibility-tree observations for web agents, relating their usefulness to model capability and thinking budget, and proposes diff-based observation history to save tokens.

records.name: MM-ReCoder: Advancing Chart-to-Code Generation with Reinforcement Learning and Self-Correction
GPA: Learning GUI Process Automation from Demonstrations
records.summary: Presents demonstration-based GUI process replay with Sequential Monte Carlo localization and readiness checks. GPA executes the learned workflow locally and can serve as the GUI execution component of an agent using MCP or CLI tools.

records.name: UI-Oceanus: Scaling GUI Agents with Synthetic Environmental Dynamics
records.summary: UI-Oceanus converts autonomous GUI exploration and execution feedback into supervision for predicting future interface states. It compares forward and inverse objectives during continual pretraining and examines downstream offline and online navigation as synthetic data scales.

records.name: LumiVideo: An Intelligent Agentic System for Video Color Grading
Poison Once, Exploit Forever: Environment-Injected Memory Poisoning Attacks on Web Agents
records.summary: Studies persistent web-agent memory contamination introduced through environmental observations. Experiments on WebArena and VisualWebArena examine cross-session effects and how interaction failures alter susceptibility.

records.name: GBQA: A Game Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs as Quality Assurance Engineers
AgentHazard: A Benchmark for Evaluating Harmful Behavior in Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces AgentHazard, a benchmark of harmful multi-step behavior by computer-use agents acting through tools, files, and execution environments.

records.name: The Tool Illusion: Rethinking Tool Use in Web Agents
records.summary: Presents a controlled study of higher-level tool use in web agents across tool sources, backbone models, frameworks, and evaluation benchmarks.

records.name: Graphic-Design-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating AI on Graphic Design Tasks
GUIDE: Interpretable GUI Agent Evaluation via Hierarchical Diagnosis
records.summary: GUIDE evaluates GUI trajectories by segmenting them into subtasks, diagnosing each segment, and aggregating structured findings into a task verdict. It tests diagnostic judgments on e-commerce, web-agent and Android-control traces.

records.name: Your Agent, Their Asset: A Real-World Safety Analysis of OpenClaw
records.summary: Introduces a safety evaluation of OpenClaw and the CIK taxonomy for analyzing how changes to a personal agent's persistent state affect attacks on its local and service access.

records.name: Comparing Human Oversight Strategies for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Compares four human oversight strategies during live web-agent sessions, examining exposure to problematic actions and opportunities to intervene. The analysis identifies timing and attention problems in control handoffs and upfront plan approval.

records.name: IntentScore: Intent-Conditioned Action Evaluation for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Trains IntentScore on offline desktop GUI interactions to assess candidate actions using both their state relevance and planning intent. The reward model is evaluated as an action reranker for Agent S3 on OSWorld.

records.name: Don't Act Blindly: Robust GUI Automation via Action-Effect Verification and Self-Correction
records.summary: Introduces VeriGUI, which checks expected action effects and reasons about recovery before subsequent GUI actions. Training combines synthetic failure trajectories with verification-weighted GRPO, evaluated on an AndroidControl-based robustness benchmark.

records.name: OmniDiagram: Advancing Unified Diagram Code Generation via Visual Interrogation Reward
COSMO-Agent: Tool-Augmented Agent for Closed-loop Optimization,Simulation,and Modeling Orchestration
Vision-Guided Iterative Refinement for Frontend Code Generation
authors: Gerrit J. J. van den Burg

records.name: FrontierFinance: A Long-Horizon Computer-Use Benchmark of Real-World Financial Tasks
Gym-Anything: Turn any Software into an Agent Environment
records.summary: Introduces Gym-Anything, where a setup agent configures software environments and an independent auditor checks the resulting evidence. CUA-World supplies long-horizon tasks across professional applications, with experiments on trajectory distillation and test-time auditing.

records.name: MAESTRO: Adapting GUIs and Guiding Navigation with User Preferences in Conversational Agents with GUIs
records.summary: Introduces MAESTRO, a conversational GUI system that remembers user preferences, adapts interface options, and guides backtracking in multistep booking decisions.

records.name: WebExpert: domain-aware web agents with critic-guided expert experience for high-precision search
VenusBench-Mobile: A Challenging and User-Centric Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents with Capability Diagnostics
records.summary: Introduces VenusBench-Mobile, an online benchmark for mobile GUI agents with user-intent-driven tasks and capability annotations for analyzing agent behavior and failures.

records.name: The Art of Building Verifiers for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Describes a web-trajectory verifier built around structured rubrics, separate process and outcome judgments, and explicit treatment of uncontrollable failures. CUAVerifierBench supplies human labels for evaluating these choices and screenshot-based context management.

records.name: WebSP-Eval: Evaluating Web Agents on Website Security and Privacy Tasks
records.summary: WebSP-Eval evaluates agents carrying out website security and privacy tasks such as preference changes and session management. A browser extension controls account and initial state across runs, enabling analysis of failures on stateful UI controls.

records.name: What's Missing in Screen-to-Action? Towards a UI-in-the-Loop Paradigm for Multimodal GUI Reasoning
records.summary: Introduces UILoop, which inserts explicit UI-element localization, function and usage reasoning between screen observation and action. UI Comprehension-Bench evaluates these element-level capabilities with three metrics.

records.name: Android Coach: Improve Online Agentic Training Efficiency with Single State Multiple Actions
records.summary: Introduces Android Coach, which uses a learned critic to evaluate multiple candidate actions at each observed emulator state. Process rewards and a group-wise advantage estimator support online training, evaluated on AndroidLab and AndroidWorld.

records.name: GameWorld: Towards Standardized and Verifiable Evaluation of Multimodal Game Agents
records.summary: Introduces GameWorld, a browser-game benchmark that evaluates multimodal agents through keyboard and mouse controls or semantic actions using outcome checks.

records.name: Structured Distillation of Web Agent Capabilities Enables Generalization
records.summary: Introduces Agent-as-Annotators, which uses modular LLM roles to synthesize and filter web-agent trajectories for supervised training of a smaller web agent.

records.name: Are GUI Agents Focused Enough? Automated Distraction via Semantic-level UI Element Injection
records.summary: This study tests black-box GUI-grounding failures caused by strategically added, innocuous-looking UI elements. Its iterative overlay search is compared with random injection and repeated independent grounding trials to distinguish persistent misdirection from incidental clutter.

records.name: Same Outcomes, Different Journeys: A Trace-Level Framework for Comparing Human and GUI-Agent Behavior in Production Search Systems
records.summary: Presents a trace-level framework for comparing GUI agents with people on task outcomes, queries, and interface navigation in a production audio-search application.

records.name: Preference Redirection via Attention Concentration: An Attack on Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces PRAC, an adversarial-patch attack that redirects a computer-use agent's visual attention to steer product selection on an online shopping platform.

records.name: KnowU-Bench: Towards Interactive, Proactive, and Personalized Mobile Agent Evaluation
records.summary: Introduces KnowU-Bench, an Android emulator benchmark for mobile agents that evaluates preference elicitation, proactive decisions, consent and GUI task execution.

records.name: MolmoWeb: Open Visual Web Agent and Open Data for the Open Web
records.summary: Presents MolmoWebMix, combining synthetic browser trajectories, human demonstrations and GUI perception data, and MolmoWeb screenshot-to-action policies trained from it. Browser benchmarks also test parallel rollouts with best-of-N selection.

records.name: ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?
records.summary: Introduces ClawBench, 153 everyday tasks on production websites in 15 categories; an interception layer blocks each final submission so bookings, purchases and job applications are scored without side effects.

records.name: CORA: Conformal Risk-Controlled Agents for Safeguarded Mobile GUI Automation
records.summary: Introduces CORA, which calibrates a risk model to choose between executing and abstaining from mobile GUI actions, then diagnoses rejected actions to suggest interventions. Phone-Harm provides step-level safety labels for evaluating this safeguarding process.

records.name: Turing Test on Screen: A Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agent Humanization
records.summary: Introduces the Agent Humanization Benchmark (AHB) and mobile touch-dynamics data to assess whether GUI agents' interactions resemble human touch behavior.

records.name: Avenir-UX: Automated UX Evaluation via Simulated Human Web Interaction with GUI Grounding
records.summary: Avenir-UX combines grounded web interaction with simulated user profiles and structured usability measures to produce evaluations of website journeys. The paper describes its architecture and use of SUS, step-wise ease questions and think-aloud traces for automated UX reporting.

records.name: MobiFlow: Real-World Mobile Agent Benchmarking through Trajectory Fusion
records.summary: Introduces MobiFlow, a mobile-agent evaluation framework that fuses task trajectories into a state graph for dynamic interaction with third-party apps and measures task outcomes.

records.name: Agentic Compilation: Mitigating the LLM Rerun Crisis for Minimized-Inference-Cost Web Automation
records.summary: Proposes Compile-and-Execute, which turns a sanitized DOM into a reusable JSON workflow so repetitive browser tasks can run without further model queries.

records.name: EE-MCP: Self-Evolving MCP-GUI Agents via Automated Environment Generation and Experience Learning
records.summary: EE-MCP studies application-dependent mixtures of GUI actions and MCP calls using generated environments, trajectory collection and filtered training. An experience bank extracts rules from trajectory comparisons for inference-time improvement, distinct from model distillation.

records.name: HealthAdminBench: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents on Healthcare Administration Tasks
records.summary: Introduces HealthAdminBench with GUI environments for an electronic health record, payer portals and fax handling. Expert-defined administrative tasks are decomposed into verifiable subtasks to compare local progress with end-to-end workflow completion.

records.name: The Amazing Agent Race: Strong Tool Users, Weak Navigators
The Blind Spot of Agent Safety: How Benign User Instructions Expose Critical Vulnerabilities in Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces OS-BLIND, a computer-use agent safety benchmark for harmful outcomes arising from benign instructions and threats in task environments.

records.name: AgentWebBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Coordination in Agentic Web
WebForge: Breaking the Realism-Reproducibility-Scalability Trilemma in Browser Agent Benchmark
records.summary: Presents WebForge, a pipeline that plans, generates, refines and validates self-contained interactive websites. WebForge-Bench uses these environments to evaluate browser agents across domains and controlled difficulty levels.

records.name: ArtiCAD: Articulated CAD Assembly Design via Multi-Agent Code Generation
CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild
records.summary: Introduces CocoaBench, a benchmark for unified digital agents on long-horizon tasks combining vision, search, and coding, including capabilities related to GUI automation.

records.name: Mobile GUI Agent Privacy Personalization with Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization
records.summary: Proposes Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization (TIPO) to train mobile GUI agents for differing user privacy preferences across structurally different task trajectories.

records.name: ClawGUI: A Unified Framework for Training, Evaluating, and Deploying GUI Agents
records.summary: Presents ClawGUI, a shared harness for GUI-agent reinforcement learning, benchmark evaluation and deployment on mobile devices. It combines parallel virtual and physical environments, process rewards, and hybrid CLI-GUI execution with persistent memory.

records.name: The Long-Horizon Task Mirage? Diagnosing Where and Why Agentic Systems Break
Towards Robust Real-World Spreadsheet Understanding with Multi-Agent Multi-Format Reasoning
WebAgentGuard: A Reasoning-Driven Guard Model for Detecting Prompt Injection Attacks in Web Agents
records.summary: WebAgentGuard separates prompt-injection detection from the operating web agent through a parallel multimodal guard. The guard is trained on synthetic visual/textual examples using reasoning-focused supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning.

records.name: From Imitation to Discrimination: Progressive Curriculum Learning for Robust Web Navigation
records.summary: Introduces the Triton dataset and a staged training curriculum for text-based web navigation agents, using hard-negative HTML examples to train element discrimination and longer task execution.

records.name: PrecisionCUA: Iterative Visual Refinement for Pixel-Precise Cursor Grounding in Code Editors
records.summary: Studies iterative cursor grounding in dense code-editor interfaces, using visual feedback from earlier attempts to correct displacement. PrecisionCUA evaluates this closed-loop process across multiple model families on coding-interface tasks.

records.name: Can Coding Agents Be General Agents?
WebXSkill: Skill Learning for Autonomous Web Agents
records.summary: WebXSkill pairs parameterized action programs with step-level language guidance, mining reusable skills from synthetic browser-agent traces. A URL-based graph supports retrieval, and deployment alternates between direct program execution and guided native planning.

records.name: Towards Scalable Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-role Orchestration
records.summary: Introduces LAMO, a training framework for a lightweight GUI agent that can execute tasks alone or serve as an action executor alongside planners in multi-agent workflows.

records.name: RiskWebWorld: A Realistic Interactive Benchmark for GUI Agents in E-commerce Risk Management
records.summary: Introduces RiskWebWorld, an interactive benchmark of e-commerce risk-management tasks for GUI agents on websites, with Gymnasium infrastructure for evaluation and agentic RL.

records.name: UI-Copilot: Advancing Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization
records.summary: UI-Copilot separates GUI execution from on-demand memory retrieval and numerical assistance. Its training procedure treats tool selection and multi-turn task execution as distinct optimization targets while keeping persistent observations outside transient context.

records.name: GeoAgentBench: A Dynamic Execution Benchmark for Tool-Augmented Agents in Spatial Analysis
UI-Zoomer: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Zoom-In for GUI Grounding
records.summary: Introduces UI-Zoomer, a training-free grounding method that uses candidate agreement and token confidence to decide when to crop and retry. Prediction variance determines a separate crop radius for each uncertain interface target.

records.name: GUI-Perturbed: Domain Randomization Reveals Systematic Brittleness in GUI Grounding Models
records.summary: Introduces GUI-Perturbed, which varies screenshot appearance and instruction wording independently to diagnose grounding failures. Experiments on three related model architectures examine relational instructions, browser zoom and augmentation-based fine-tuning.

records.name: Beyond Chat and Clicks: GUI Agents for In-Situ Assistance via Live Interface Transformation
records.summary: DOMSteer translates help requests and live page context into reversible DOM changes such as control highlighting, contextual tooltips and layout reorganization. The work evaluates in-place GUI assistance with interface tests, use cases and a comparative user study.

records.name: SkillDroid: Compile Once, Reuse Forever
records.summary: Introduces SkillDroid, which compiles successful mobile GUI trajectories into reusable action templates and replays them without model calls, recompiling when they degrade.

records.name: FedGUI: Benchmarking Federated GUI Agents across Heterogeneous Platforms, Devices, and Operating Systems
records.summary: Introduces FedGUI, a federated GUI-learning benchmark built from six datasets spanning mobile, web and desktop interfaces. Its experiments separate platform, device, operating-system and data-source heterogeneity when evaluating collaborative training.

records.name: OpenMobile: Building Open Mobile Agents with Task and Trajectory Synthesis
records.summary: Presents OpenMobile, which builds exploration-based environment memory to synthesize task instructions and switches between learner and expert policies during trajectory collection. The resulting data includes recovery behavior and is tested through mobile-agent training and benchmark-overlap analysis.

records.name: Agent-Aided Design for Dynamic CAD Models
Zoom Consistency: A Free Confidence Signal in Multi-Step Visual Grounding Pipelines
records.summary: Proposes zoom consistency as a confidence signal for multistep GUI grounding and uses it to route between specialist and generalist visual grounding models.

records.name: GTA-2: Benchmarking General Tool Agents from Atomic Tool-Use to Open-Ended Workflows
StressWeb: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Web Agent Robustness under Realistic Interaction Variability
records.summary: Introduces a web-agent stress-testing benchmark with controlled changes to layouts, interaction semantics, and execution for diagnosing behavior under varied conditions.

records.name: Penny Wise, Pixel Foolish: Bypassing Price Constraints in Multimodal Agents via Visual Adversarial Perturbations
records.summary: Introduces PriceBlind, a visual perturbation method for controlled screenshot-based evaluation of price-constrained multimodal agents. The reported transfer experiments use a simplified single-turn coordinate-selection protocol.

records.name: AgentClick: A Skill-Based Human-in-the-Loop Review Layer for Terminal AI Agents
records.summary: AgentClick gives terminal-based agents a browser review interface for plans, drafts, execution traces and editable memory. A local server and skill plugin let users inspect proposed actions and provide structured feedback.

records.name: A Survey on Long-Term Memory Security in LLM Agents: Attacks, Defenses, and Governance Across the Memory Lifecycle
records.summary: Organizes security risks and defenses for persistent agent memory into six lifecycle phases and proposes five verifiable governance primitives.

records.name: GenericAgent: A Token-Efficient Self-Evolving LLM Agent via Contextual Information Density Maximization (V1.0)
HalluClear: Diagnosing, Evaluating and Mitigating Hallucinations in GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces HalluClear with a GUI hallucination taxonomy, expert-calibrated evaluation workflow and structured-reasoning post-training scheme. It evaluates how these components affect hallucinations, grounding and action fidelity across GUI agents.

records.name: Do LLMs Need to See Everything? A Benchmark and Study of Failures in LLM-driven Smartphone Automation using Screentext vs. Screenshots
records.summary: DailyDroid compares text-only and text-plus-screenshot agents on everyday Android tasks across multiple apps and difficulty levels. Its failure analysis examines accessibility, observation modality and agent/application behavior.

records.name: WebUncertainty: Dual-Level Uncertainty Driven Planning and Reasoning For Autonomous Web Agent
records.summary: WebUncertainty adapts planning mode to task uncertainty and guides action-level tree search with confidence-derived uncertainty estimates. Its evaluations examine autonomous execution of dynamic, long-horizon web tasks on WebArena and WebVoyager.

records.name: On the Reliability of Computer Use Agents
records.summary: This study examines repeated OSWorld executions to separate execution stochasticity, task-specification ambiguity and behavioral variation. Paired task-level tests show why one successful run is insufficient evidence of reliable computer use.

records.name: WebCompass: Towards Multimodal Web Coding Evaluation for Code Language Models
AJ-Bench: Benchmarking Agent-as-a-Judge for Environment-Aware Evaluation
records.summary: AJ-Bench evaluates judge agents that actively gather evidence from search, data systems and graphical interfaces. Its annotated tasks and trajectories test information acquisition, state verification and process verification.

records.name: Training and Agentic Inference Strategies for LLM-based Manim Animation Generation
OpenGame: Open Agentic Coding for Games
Mango: Multi-Agent Web Navigation via Global-View Optimization
records.summary: Proposes Mango, a multi-agent web-navigation method that selects starting URLs using Thompson Sampling and stores navigation history to inform later attempts.

records.name: Human-Guided Harm Recovery for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces a preference-trained reward model for guiding computer-use agents out of harmful states and BackBench, a benchmark of recovery tasks.

records.name: Temporal UI State Inconsistency in Desktop GUI Agents: Formalizing and Defending Against TOCTOU Attacks on Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: This study examines UI changes between a desktop agent’s screenshot observation and action dispatch. Its pre-execution state checks address overlay and focus manipulation, while the reported DOM-injection blind spot limits the defense’s coverage.

records.name: AutomationBench
records.summary: Introduces AutomationBench, a benchmark for agents coordinating business workflows across applications through REST APIs, including endpoint discovery and policy adherence.

records.name: Gated Coordination for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration in Minecraft Game
Rethinking Scale: Deployment Trade-offs of Small Language Models under Agent Paradigms
A Self-Evolving Framework for Efficient Terminal Agents via Observational Context Compression
Chat2Workflow: A Benchmark for Generating Executable Visual Workflows with Natural Language
PlayCoder: Making LLM-Generated GUI Code Playable
records.summary: PlayEval measures whether generated GUI applications remain logically playable, using PlayTester to execute task-oriented GUI playthroughs. PlayCoder closes the loop between repository-aware generation, interactive testing and targeted code repair.

records.name: Coding with Eyes: Visual Feedback Unlocks Reliable GUI Code Generating and Debugging
AgentLens: Adaptive Visual Modalities for Human-Agent Interaction in Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces AgentLens, a mobile GUI agent that shows full, partial, or generated interface views during background task execution to support user interaction.

records.name: Caesar: Deep Agentic Web Exploration for Creative Answer Synthesis
Measure Twice, Click Once: Co-evolving Proposer and Visual Critic via Reinforcement Learning for GUI Grounding
records.summary: Trains a GUI grounding proposer together with a visual critic that evaluates candidate locations rendered on screenshots. An adaptive reinforcement-learning schedule balances their development, using proposal diversity and critic feedback during training.

records.name: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
records.summary: VLAA-GUI combines mandatory checks for visually supported completion, multi-tier loop recovery and on-demand workflow search. Optional coding and grounding agents support execution, with component ablations on Linux and Windows GUI tasks.

records.name: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: SOLAR-RL trains GUI navigation agents by reconstructing rollout candidates from static data and assigning step rewards that reflect trajectory quality.

records.name: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
records.summary: Survey of agentic world models that classifies predictive capabilities and governing laws, including the digital setting of web and GUI agents.

records.name: PageGuide: Browser extension to assist users in navigating a webpage and locating information
records.summary: PageGuide is a browser extension that highlights evidence for answers on a page and guides users through web pages with evidence captured at each step.

records.name: ClawMark: A Living-World Benchmark for Multi-Turn, Multi-Day, Multimodal Coworker Agents
GoClick: Lightweight Element Grounding Model for Autonomous GUI Interaction
records.summary: Studies a compact encoder-decoder grounding model and progressive training-data refinement for resource-constrained GUI interaction.

records.name: OS-SPEAR: A Toolkit for the Safety, Performance,Efficiency, and Robustness Analysis of OS Agents
records.summary: Provides an evaluation toolkit for joint safety, efficiency, and multimodal robustness analysis of operating-system GUI agents.

records.name: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark
records.summary: AutoGUI-v2 evaluates interface functionality, grounding and predicted interaction outcomes using hierarchical regions derived through VLM-human annotation. Its tasks span multiple operating systems and expose differences between functional localization, captioning and transition-logic understanding.

records.name: Odysseys: Benchmarking Web Agents on Realistic Long Horizon Tasks
records.summary: Introduces Odysseys, a live-web benchmark of long, multi-site tasks derived from browsing sessions. Graded task rubrics and a rubric-score-per-step measure evaluate both partial progress and trajectory efficiency.

records.name: Benchmarking and Improving GUI Agents in High-Dynamic Environments
records.summary: Introduces DynamicGUIBench for applications whose interfaces change between actions, together with DynamicUI, an agent that processes screen recordings. The agent selects informative frames, filters inconsistent action reasoning and uses trajectory reflection for subsequent decisions.

records.name: SnapGuard: Lightweight Prompt Injection Detection for Screenshot-Based Web Agents
records.summary: SnapGuard detects screenshot-based prompt injection through complementary visual-stability and recovered textual cues. Its evaluation compares detection quality and inference cost across attack and benign-page settings.

records.name: Training Computer Use Agents to Assess the Usability of Graphical User Interfaces
records.summary: uxCUA learns to assess interface usability by choosing interaction flows, executing them and predicting a numerical usability score. Training uses interactive UIs with usability labels and human preferences, with evaluations on synthetic and real interfaces.

records.name: Beyond Screenshots: Evaluating VLMs' Understanding of UI Animations
records.summary: AniMINT evaluates how VLMs perceive, explain and interpret UI animations using densely annotated videos. The study distinguishes basic motion recognition from higher-level animation meaning and probes motion, context and perceptual cues.

records.name: Step-level Optimization for Efficient Computer-use Agents
records.summary: Proposes a step-level model cascade that runs a smaller computer-use policy until learned monitors flag stalled progress or semantic drift. Separate history-based stuck detection and milestone checks determine when to escalate for recovery or verification without retraining the larger model.

records.name: AutoSurfer -- Teaching Web Agents through Comprehensive Surfing, Learning, and Modeling
records.summary: AutoSurfer explores website actions breadth-first, retaining page and trajectory knowledge to guide task synthesis and trajectory refinement. It evaluates the resulting training data by fine-tuning a web agent on WebArena and examining synthesized-task diversity.

records.name: InteractWeb-Bench: Can Multimodal Agent Escape Blind Execution in Interactive Website Generation?
WindowsWorld: A Process-Centric Benchmark of Autonomous GUI Agents in Professional Cross-Application Environments
records.summary: Introduces WindowsWorld for professional workflows spanning multiple desktop applications, with generated tasks refined through human review. Intermediate subgoals support process-oriented evaluation of cross-application reasoning and execution efficiency.

records.name: GUI Agents with Reinforcement Learning: Toward Digital Inhabitants
FineState-Bench: Benchmarking State-Conditioned Grounding for Fine-grained GUI State Setting
records.summary: FineState-Bench tests whether GUI agents locate the intended control and set its exact state across desktop, web, and mobile interfaces, with stage-wise diagnostic metrics.

records.name: Exploring LLM Agent Designs and Interaction Modalities for Scientific Visualization
records.summary: This study compares specialized, computer-use and coding agents on scientific visualization workflows. It examines GUI, CLI, code and tool-call interaction modes, including how persistent memory changes performance across repeated trials.

records.name: What Makes a Good Terminal-Agent Benchmark Task: A Guideline for Adversarial, Difficult, and Legible Evaluation Design
Crab: A Semantics-Aware Checkpoint/Restore Runtime for Agent Sandboxes
Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows
Synthetic Computers at Scale for Long-Horizon Productivity Simulation
AEM: Adaptive Entropy Modulation for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
"What Are You Really Trying to Do?": Co-Creating Life Goals from Everyday Computer Use
A11y-Compressor: A Framework for Enhancing the Efficiency of GUI Agent Observations through Visual Context Reconstruction and Redundancy Reduction
records.summary: A11y-Compressor transforms linearized accessibility trees through modal detection, redundancy reduction and semantic structuring. Its OSWorld evaluation measures both observation-token reduction and task success.

records.name: Learn where to Click from Yourself: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
records.summary: Introduces GUI-SD, an on-policy self-distillation method for locating GUI elements from instructions, using a visually enriched teacher context and entropy-guided token weighting.

records.name: Faithful Mobile GUI Agents with Guided Advantage Estimator
records.summary: Introduces Faithful-Agent, which first teaches abstention under perturbed evidence and then refines GUI policies with an anchor-based, variance-adaptive advantage estimator. A thought-action consistency reward encourages decisions grounded in displayed evidence and instructions.

records.name: Planner Matters! An Efficient and Unbalanced Multi-agent Collaboration Framework for Long-horizon Planning
records.summary: A planner-centric RL framework divides agent automation among a planner, actor, and memory manager, with evaluations that include web navigation and OS control.

records.name: PhysicianBench: Evaluating LLM Agents in Real-World EHR Environments
AutoFocus: Uncertainty-Aware Active Visual Search for GUI Grounding
records.summary: Presents AutoFocus, a training-free grounding method that turns sampled coordinates and token uncertainty into spatial region proposals. Shape-aware crops and visual comparison select a target while retaining surrounding interface context.

records.name: AcademiClaw: When Students Set Challenges for AI Agents
records.summary: AcademiClaw benchmarks OpenClaw agents on long academic workflows, scoring task completion in isolated Docker sandboxes with rubrics and a safety audit.

records.name: Augmenting Interface Usability Heuristics for Reliable Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: A study adapts interface usability heuristics for computer-use agents and evaluates augmented designs in UI-Verse, a suite of controlled interface environments.

records.name: cotomi Act: Learning to Automate Work by Watching You
records.summary: cotomi Act is a browser agent that executes multi-step tasks and turns observed user browsing into persistent knowledge shared with users.

records.name: Enhancing Agent Safety Judgment: Controlled Benchmark Rewriting and Analogical Reasoning for Deceptive Out-of-Distribution Scenarios
Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 in the Era of Coding Agents
LongSeeker: Elastic Context Orchestration for Long-Horizon Search Agents
WAAA! Web Adversaries Against Agentic Browsers
records.summary: Evaluates agentic browsers against classical web attacks and visual social-engineering lures beyond indirect prompt injection.

records.name: X-OmniClaw Technical Report: A Unified Mobile Agent for Multimodal Understanding and Interaction
records.summary: Describes an Android agent architecture combining multimodal perception, working and personal memory, hybrid XML/visual grounding, and reusable skills captured from user interactions.

records.name: Constraining Host-Level Abuse in Self-Hosted Computer-Use Agents via TEE-Backed Isolation
records.summary: A TEE-backed design confines host operations by self-hosted computer-use agents, classifying and authorizing actions before constrained local execution.

records.name: BAMI: Training-Free Bias Mitigation in GUI Grounding
records.summary: BAMI uses coarse-to-fine focus and candidate selection at inference time to address precision and ambiguity errors in GUI grounding.

records.name: Weblica: Scalable and Reproducible Training Environments for Visual Web Agents
