records.summary: Introduces Weblica, which combines HTTP-level capture and replay with website-grounded environment synthesis. The resulting interactive web environments support reinforcement learning and tests of navigation transfer and inference-time scaling.

records.name: Securing Computer-Use Agents: A Unified Architecture-Lifecycle Framework for Deployment-Grounded Reliability
records.summary: Survey of computer-use agent reliability and security across browsers, desktops, and mobile apps, using architecture and lifecycle views to map failures and controls.

records.name: Region4Web: Rethinking Observation Space Granularity for Web Agents
records.summary: Reorganizes webpage accessibility trees into functional regions through hierarchical decomposition and semantic abstraction. PageDigest supplies a persistent region-level observation to web agents, evaluated on WebArena.

records.name: A Comprehensive Survey on Agent Skills: Taxonomy, Techniques, and Applications
LiteGUI: Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-Solution Guided Distillation and Dual-Level Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: LiteGUI trains lightweight GUI agents on logged states with guided on-policy distillation and dual-level RL, supported by its multi-solution Lite-Dataset.

records.name: Ask Early, Ask Late, Ask Right: When Does Clarification Timing Matter for Long-Horizon Agents?
Computer Use at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
records.summary: DigiWorld is a sandboxed mobile-app benchmark for computer-use agents, paired with PRISM environment principles and a confidence-interval aggregation method.

records.name: WebTrap: Stealthy Mid-Task Hijacking of Browser Agents During Navigation
records.summary: WebTrap injects mid-task instructions into browser-agent navigation to steer an agent toward an attacker goal before it resumes the user's task.

records.name: OTora: A Unified Red Teaming Framework for Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service in LLM Agents
records.summary: OTora generates attacks that increase reasoning and tool use in multi-step LLM agents while preserving task outcomes; evaluations include WebShop agents.

records.name: Mem-W: Latent Memory-Native GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces Mem-W, which compresses previous trajectories and current-session segments into latent memory tokens used directly by the GUI policy. Self-distillation and outcome supervision train this memory representation for web and mobile navigation.

records.name: Don't Click That: Teaching Web Agents to Resist Deceptive Interfaces
records.summary: DUDE combines asymmetric hybrid-reward learning with summaries of deceptive-interface failures to guide safer web actions. Its RUC benchmark evaluates deception susceptibility alongside ordinary task performance across interface scenarios.

records.name: How Mobile World Model Guides GUI Agents?
records.summary: Compares mobile world models that predict state changes as delta text, full text, images or renderable code. Downstream Android benchmarks examine synthetic training trajectories and test-time guidance, including limits of post-action reflection.

records.name: WildClawBench: A Benchmark for Real-World, Long-Horizon Agent Evaluation
records.summary: WildClawBench evaluates CLI agents on long, multimodal tasks in Docker containers with real tools, using task checks, side-effect audits, and a semantic judge.

records.name: MMTB: Evaluating Terminal Agents on Multimedia-File Tasks
records.summary: MultiMedia-TerminalBench evaluates agents that use terminal tools to work with audio and video files. The Terminus-MM harness adds multimedia perception to study how accessible evidence changes executable workflows and task outcomes.

records.name: ReVision: Scaling Computer-Use Agents via Temporal Visual Redundancy Reduction
records.summary: Trains GUI agents with a learned selector that removes repeated visual patches across consecutive screenshots while preserving spatial structure. ReVision evaluates this history representation on OSWorld, WebTailBench and AgentNetBench.

records.name: PresentAgent-2: Towards Generalist Multimodal Presentation Agents
AgentDisCo: Towards Disentanglement and Collaboration in Open-ended Deep Research Agents
No More, No Less: Task Alignment in Terminal Agents
Executable Agentic Memory for GUI Agent
records.summary: Executable Agentic Memory stores GUI routines in a knowledge graph built through state-aware exploration and action-group mining. A learned value model guides tree search over this executable memory for retrieval-based planning, with AndroidWorld and efficiency evaluation.

records.name: ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: ToolCUA synthesizes interleaved GUI/tool trajectories and trains agents to choose between graphical actions and higher-level tools. Staged supervised and reinforcement learning culminate in online hybrid-environment training with a reward for efficient execution paths.

records.name: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
records.summary: LongMemEval-V2 asks memory systems to recover environment knowledge from long web-agent histories for question answering. Its AgentRunbook variants contrast indexed knowledge pools with coding-agent retrieval from stored trajectory files.

records.name: Covering Human Action Space for Computer Use: Data Synthesis and Benchmark
records.summary: Introduces CUActSpot to evaluate clicks, drags, drawing and other screen interactions across GUI, text, tables, canvases and natural images. A renderer-based pipeline records geometry and screenshots, then generates matching instructions and action traces for training a grounding model.

records.name: What Happens Before Decoding? Prefill Determines GUI Grounding in VLMs
records.summary: Re-Prefill adds an attention-guided second prefill pass that revisits candidate screen regions before coordinate generation. The study evaluates this training-free intervention across GUI-grounding models and benchmarks.

records.name: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs
ProjGuard: Safety Monitoring for Computer-Use Agents via Low-Dimensional Projections
EvolveMem:Self-Evolving Memory Architecture via AutoResearch for LLM Agents
ClawForge: Generating Executable Interactive Benchmarks for Command-Line Agents
SimPersona: Learning Discrete Buyer Personas from Raw Clickstreams for Grounded E-Commerce Agents
records.summary: SimPersona learns buyer types from clickstreams and uses persona tokens to condition web agents trained on browsing traces for live storefront tasks.

records.name: Web Agents Should Adopt the Plan-Then-Execute Paradigm
records.summary: Argues for compiling web tasks into predefined execution graphs before exposing an agent to untrusted runtime content. Its WebArena task analysis identifies typed, semantically complete website tools as a prerequisite and distinguishes this interface proposal from reactive click-level control.

records.name: Beyond Binary: Reframing GUI Critique as Continuous Semantic Alignment
records.summary: BBCritic ranks candidate GUI-agent actions through instruction–action alignment, while BBBench evaluates fine-grained ranking with a hierarchical action taxonomy.

records.name: ChronoAgentic: A Code-based Multi-Agent World Simulator for Physically Grounded Simulation Construction
$π$-Bench: Evaluating Proactive Personal Assistant Agents in Long-Horizon Workflows
Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining
records.summary: Video2GUI extracts GUI interaction trajectories from tutorial videos to build WildGUI, a pretraining dataset spanning applications and websites.
records.publication_search_text: Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning PMLR Proceedings of Machine Learning Research https://proceedings.mlr.press/v306/xiong26c.html https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v306/main/assets/xiong26c/xiong26c.pdf Weimin Xiong Shuhao Gu Bowen Ye Zihao Yue Lei Li Feifan Song Sujian Li Hao Tian

records.name: Known By Their Actions: Fingerprinting LLM Browser Agents via UI Traces
records.summary: A study shows that websites can infer the model behind a browser agent from passively recorded UI actions and timing traces across web tasks.

records.name: WARD: Adversarially Robust Defense of Web Agents Against Prompt Injections
records.summary: WARD guards web agents against prompt injections in HTML and visual interfaces, using web data and adaptive attacker–guard training.

records.name: Orchard: An Open-Source Agentic Modeling Framework
records.summary: Orchard provides an environment service and training recipes for several agent domains, including Orchard-GUI, a vision-language computer-use agent.

records.name: DRS-GUI: Dynamic Region Search for Training-Free GUI Grounding
records.summary: DRS-GUI searches screenshot regions through focus, shift and scatter operations selected by a tree-search planner. A region-quality reward guides this training-free perceptual search before final GUI grounding.

records.name: See Before You Code: Learning Visual Priors for Spatially Aware Educational Animation Generation
SaaS-Bench: Can Computer-Use Agents Leverage Real-World SaaS to Solve Professional Workflows?
records.summary: SaaS-Bench evaluates browser agents on professional workflows across self-hosted applications. Weighted checkpoints measure task completion and partial progress, with application-state checks and configured content judges documented in the official harness.

records.name: PersonaFingerprint: Measuring Persona Inference on Modern Websites with LLM-Driven Browsing
records.summary: PersonaFingerprint studies persona inference from encrypted web traffic, using a persona-constrained computer-use agent to browse real websites and collect traces.

records.name: PAGER: Bridging the Semantic-Execution Gap in Point-Precise Geometric GUI Control
records.summary: Introduces PAGE Bench for point-precise geometric GUI construction and PAGER, an agent that plans around primitive dependencies and executes pixel-level actions.

records.name: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration
records.summary: ScreenSearch explores desktop GUI states by indexing and deduplicating UIA-tree screens, then using outcome ambiguity and frontier rewards to guide graph search.

records.name: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents
records.summary: ShopGym builds sandbox e-commerce storefronts from live shops and generates catalog-grounded tasks for evaluating web shopping agents in resettable environments.

records.name: AgentWall: A Runtime Safety Layer for Local AI Agents
WinDeskGround: A Benchmark for Robust GUI Grounding in Complex Multi-Window Desktop Environments
records.summary: WinDeskGround synthesizes multi-window desktop layouts with controlled occlusion, density and semantic similarity to test GUI grounding robustness. Its instruction-target benchmark measures how localization changes when interfaces depart from simple single-layer scenes.

records.name: Skim: Speculative Execution for Fast and Efficient Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces Skim, a speculative execution framework for web agents that learns site URL and answer patterns offline, then uses them to answer matching queries with a small model.

records.name: SE-GA: Memory-Augmented Self-Evolution for GUI Agents
records.summary: SE-GA retrieves hierarchical memories during inference and uses the collected experience in a separate policy-improvement pipeline. Its evaluation includes offline grounding/action tasks and online Android interaction, which measure different capabilities.

records.name: TOBench: A Task-Oriented Omni-Modal Benchmark for Real-World Tool-Using Agents
TriAxialKV: Toward Extreme Low-Precision KV-Cache Quantization for Agentic Inference Tasks
records.summary: TriAxialKV assigns KV-cache precision by token recency, modality, and role for agentic inference, with a computer-use agent on OSWorld among its evaluations.

records.name: TClone: Low-Latency Forking of Live GUI Environments for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: TClone versions live GUI workspaces through snapshots, isolated forks, rollback and selective commit or merge. It separates fast branch creation from durable checkpoints using copy-on-write sharing, filesystem versioning and asynchronous checkpointing, with end-to-end agent-loop latency measurements.

records.name: DiagEval: Trajectory-Conditioned Diagnosis for Reliable Software Evaluation with GUI Agents
records.summary: DiagEval diagnoses failed GUI-agent evaluations of interactive software by reusing failed trajectories for targeted probes that distinguish execution errors from defects.

records.name: MUIAnno: An Expert-Annotated Dataset and Evaluation Benchmark for Mobile UI Understanding
records.summary: MUIAnno provides expert labels for elements in manually explored mobile-app screens, with a web annotation tool that emits structured JSON. It also supplies UI-element detection baselines for the dataset.

records.name: DocOS: Towards Proactive Document-Guided Actions in GUI Agents
records.summary: DocOS benchmarks agents that search online documentation and translate procedural instructions into GUI actions in interactive web environments. It separates failures to retrieve useful procedures from failures to ground retrieved instructions into executable actions.

records.name: MementoGUI: Learning Agentic Multimodal Memory Control for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
records.summary: MementoGUI learns a controller for selecting, compressing and retrieving textual and region-level visual memories while leaving the GUI-agent backbone fixed. It also converts computer-use traces into controller training data and evaluates semantic actions, progress and memory consistency on long-horizon tasks.

records.name: OmniGUI: Benchmarking GUI Agents in Omni-Modal Smartphone Environments
records.summary: OmniGUI evaluates step-level action prediction from interleaved smartphone screenshots, synchronous audio and video. Expert demonstrations carry multimodal-dependency annotations, and initial baselines use native multimodal models as agent proxies to study temporal and audio-related failures.

records.name: TwinRouterBench: Fast Static and Live Dynamic Evaluation for Realistic Agentic LLM Routing
AQuaUI: Visual Token Reduction for GUI Agents with Adaptive Quadtrees
records.summary: AQuaUI reduces screenshot tokens for GUI agents at inference time with adaptive quadtrees that retain spatial positions and reuse prior tree structure across steps.

records.name: What and When to Distill: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
records.summary: SERL trains multi-turn agents by using task rewards and selective step feedback to weight updates, with WebShop among its evaluation settings.

records.name: CutVerse: A Compositional GUI Agents Benchmark for Media Post-Production Editing
records.summary: Cutverse benchmarks GUI agents on long editing workflows across professional media applications and parses recordings and input logs into grounded action trajectories.

records.name: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces OpenComputer, which builds desktop tasks around application-state verifiers and refines those verifiers using execution feedback. An evaluation harness records trajectories and assigns auditable partial credit across professional software workflows.

records.name: Weasel: Out-of-Domain Generalization for Web Agents via Importance-Diversity Data Selection
records.summary: Weasel selects web-agent training steps by balancing importance and diversity across states, sites and interaction patterns. It also prunes training accessibility trees around known action targets and regenerates rationales to match the model’s reasoning style.

records.name: MemGym: a Long-Horizon Memory Environment for LLM Agents
records.summary: MemGym benchmarks agent memory across several task regimes, including computer use on WebArena-Infinity, with scores designed to isolate memory performance.

records.name: Agent JIT Compilation for Latency-Optimizing Web Agent Planning and Scheduling
records.summary: Agent JIT compilation turns browser task descriptions into validated executable plans containing model calls, tools and parallel work. A cost-based scheduler and pre/postcondition protocol target latency and incorrect tool use in web-agent execution.

records.name: Toward AI VIS Co-Scientists: A General and End-to-End Agent Harness for Solving Complex Data Visualization Tasks
Spreadsheet-RL: Advancing Large Language Model Agents on Realistic Spreadsheet Tasks via Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Spreadsheet-RL trains spreadsheet agents with RL in a Microsoft Excel environment exposed through a Python sandbox and supplies the Domain-Spreadsheet benchmark.

records.name: DeltaBox: Scaling Stateful AI Agents with Millisecond-Level Sandbox Checkpoint/Rollback
LiveFigure: Generating Editable Scientific Illustration with VLM Agents
SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
DRIVE: Modeling Skills at the Reasoning and Interaction Levels for Web Agents under Continual Learning
records.summary: DRIVE separates reusable reasoning skills from page-specific interaction skills for web agents, retrieving both to plan tasks and execute actions on websites.

records.name: PANDO: Efficient Multimodal AI Agents via Online Skill Distillation
records.summary: Analyzes inefficiency in VisualWebArena trajectories and distills reusable online skills to reduce repeated actions and token overhead in multimodal web agents.

records.name: ScaleWoB: Guiding GUI Agents with Coding Agents via Large-Scale Environmental Synthesis
records.summary: Introduces ScaleWoB, which synthesizes interactive GUI environments as backend-free webpages with verifiable rewards. Its mobile-oriented benchmark evaluates agent execution and compares selected synthetic tasks with real-app behavior.

records.name: CUA-Gym: Scaling Verifiable Training Environments and Tasks for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Presents CUA-Gym, which co-generates instructions, initial and target states, and executable reward checks through generator-discriminator iterations. Mock web applications expand training environments, with learned agents evaluated on OSWorld-Verified and WebArena.

records.name: AgentHijack: Benchmarking Computer Use Agent Robustness to Common Environment Corruptions
records.summary: Introduces AgentHijack, a benchmark for desktop computer-use agents facing pop-ups, resolution changes and other common corruptions, alongside an agent that checks its environment.

records.name: Automated Benchmark Auditing for AI Agents and Large Language Models
Claw-Anything: Benchmarking Always-On Personal Assistants with Broader Access to User's Digital World
records.summary: Claw-Anything benchmarks persistent personal assistance across activity histories, backend services and integrated GUI/CLI interaction. Its simulated event histories introduce irrelevant or conflicting context, and a separate generation pipeline supplies training environments.

records.name: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
records.summary: Introduces MobileGym, a browser-hosted simulation of mobile app interactions whose configurable JSON state supports deterministic judging and parallel rollouts. MobileGym-Bench adds parameterized tasks, with experiments examining online training and transfer to real devices.

records.name: VISTA: An End-to-End Benchmark for Visual Spec-to-Web-App Coding Agents
records.summary: VISTA evaluates coding agents that turn design handoffs into working web and Android applications. Its evaluator locates annotated interactive components and probes their behavior, keeping visual localization distinct from functional correctness.

records.name: Anchor: Preventing Artifact Drift for Reliable Agent Verification
records.summary: Anchor builds ERP-Bench by generating procurement and manufacturing tasks with shared state verifiers for evaluating browser and computer-use agents.

records.name: MobileExplorer: Accelerating On-Device Inference for Mobile GUI Agents via Online Exploration
records.summary: MobileExplorer probes relevant UI elements while an on-device model is reasoning, then supplies the exploration trace as compact context. A two-level rollback mechanism restores the working state when simple backtracking fails.

records.name: ChartAct: A Benchmark for Dynamic Chart Understanding
records.summary: ChartAct benchmarks multimodal models and GUI agents on interactive charts from websites, requiring actions such as hovering or zooming to answer questions.

records.name: Scaling, Benchmarking, and Reasoning of Vision-Language Agents for Mobile GUI Navigation
records.summary: HyperTrack provides mobile GUI navigation tasks across Chinese apps, while GUIEvalKit benchmarks VLM agents offline and supports analysis of training scale and history.

records.name: AgenticVBench: Can AI Agents Complete Real-World Post-Production Tasks?
AndroidDaily: A Verifiable Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents on Real-World Closed-Source Applications
records.summary: AndroidDaily evaluates mobile GUI agents on daily workflows in closed-source Android apps. Its GRADE evaluator follows visual trajectories against operational obligations, output-quality requirements and negative constraints, producing process-level diagnostics without hidden app state.

records.name: VibeSearchBench: Benchmarking Long-horizon Proactive Search in the Wild
UniACE: A Unified Framework for Evaluating LLM Agentic Capabilities
MIRAGE: Context-Aware Prompt Injection against Mobile GUI Agents via User-Generated Content
records.summary: MIRAGE constructs mobile screenshot injections in ordinary user-content regions through localization, contextual payload generation and realism curation. Its evaluation separates visual realism from attack effectiveness against pixel-observing GUI agents.

records.name: GUI Agents for Continual Game Generation
records.summary: PlaytestArena evaluates generated browser games using expected in-play behaviors adjudicated by GUI agents. Play2Code pairs a coding agent with a rubric-blind GUI playtester whose interaction traces and feedback guide iterative refinement, with a separate final judge.

records.name: GUI-CIDER: Mid-training GUI Agents via Causal Internalization and Density-aware Exemplar Reselection
records.summary: GUI-CIDER turns GUI trajectories into textual planning and causal interface knowledge, reselects exemplars for causal structure and low redundancy, then mid-trains GUI agents on that corpus.

records.name: Mobile-Aptus: Confidence-Driven Proactive and Robust Interaction in MLLM-based Mobile-Using Agents
records.summary: Mobile-Aptus trains mobile agents to output actions and confidence scores, then corrects confidence bias to guide when they request human help.

records.name: MaskClaw: Edge-Side Personalized Privacy Arbitration for GUI Agents with Behavior-Driven Skill Evolution
records.summary: MaskClaw makes local Allow, Mask or Ask decisions before GUI screenshots leave a trusted environment, using visual evidence and personalized policy memory. Its benchmark and designed evolution scenarios test how corrections and edits can become privacy skills checked by a sandbox gate.

records.name: Learn from Weaknesses: Automated Domain Specialization for Small Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: LearnWeak specializes small computer-use agents by finding domain-specific weaknesses, generating targeted tasks, and training separately for planning and execution errors.

records.name: PRO-CUA: Process-Reward Optimization for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: PRO-CUA trains computer-use agents with step-level RL, scoring candidate actions from live rollouts with a process reward model and evaluating on live web benchmarks.

records.name: GTA: Generating Long-Horizon Tasks for Web Agents at Scale
records.summary: GTA generates multi-hop web-agent tasks and executable trajectories through crawling, retrieval, and validation, releasing a benchmark built from over 50 websites.

records.name: STAMP: Training Explicit Memory for Mobile GUI Agents in Controllable and Scalable Virtual Environments
records.summary: STAMP trains explicit memory for mobile GUI agents in virtual environments by injecting facts into generated tasks and using supervised data and online RL.

records.name: WorldMemArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agent Memory Through Action-World Interaction
Revisiting Observation Reduction for Web Agents: Comprehensive Evaluation with a Lightweight Framework
records.summary: Introduces a lightweight framework for evaluating HTML reduction in web agents, using Minimal Failure Set coverage to assess pruning and optimize latency.

records.name: Recovering Policy-Induced Errors: Benchmarking and Trajectory Synthesis for Robust GUI Agents
records.summary: GUI-RobustEval measures how GUI agents recover from their own errors, while RoTS synthesizes recovery trajectories for training on varied failure modes.

records.name: PhoneWorld: From Real-App Trajectories to Dynamic and Verifiable Environments for Phone-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces PhoneWorld, which converts observed app pages, transitions and state changes into executable Android environments through a build-inspect-repair process. Generated tasks and programmatic verifiers support benchmarking, trajectory collection and online training.

records.name: UI-KOBE: Knowledge-Oriented Behavior Exploration for Lightweight Graph-Guided GUI Agents
records.summary: UI-KOBE explores mobile applications to build graphs of UI states and executable transitions. A lightweight agent then matches its current screenshot to the graph and chooses a transition, local action, completion signal or fallback action.

records.name: DiffSpot: Can VLMs Spot Fine-Grained Visual Differences in Web Interfaces?
records.summary: DiffSpot benchmarks detection of fine visual changes in rendered web interfaces using image pairs created by single-property CSS mutations.

records.name: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
Does The Way You Plan Matter? An Empirical Study of Planning Representations for LLM Web Agents
GUI-C$^2$: Coarse-to-Fine GUI Grounding via Difficulty-Aware Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: Introduces GUI-D to score training samples by difficulty and GUI-C² to refine screen-element locations through area-gated cropping and reinforcement learning.

records.name: BlueFin: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Financial Spreadsheets
records.summary: Introduces BlueFin, a benchmark and evaluation framework for agents handling professional finance spreadsheet workbooks through synthesis, manipulation, and comprehension tasks.

records.name: Learning to Adapt: Self-Improving Web Agent via Cognitive-Aware Exploration
records.summary: Introduces SCALE, which uses exploration roles and graph planning to train web agents, and SCALE-20k, a dataset of tasks and demonstrations from real websites.

records.name: ROGUE: Evaluating Corrigibility Failures in Frontier Computer-Use Agents
Masking Stale Observations Helps Search Agents -- Until It Doesn't: A Regime Map and Its Mechanism
records.summary: Studies when masking older retrieved pages helps long-horizon search agents manage context, using offline and live-web search benchmarks and analysis of reopened pages.

records.name: "I Strongly Suspect This Website Is a Scam": Benchmarking PII Leakage and Detection without Defense in Autonomous Web Agents
CoMIC: Collaborative Memory and Insights Circulation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Web Cloud-Edge Systems
3DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agentic Procedural 3D Modeling Via Code
BraveGuard: From Open-World Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces BraveGuard, a framework that turns emerging threats and computer-use agent trajectories into training supervision for guards that monitor multi-step safety risks.

records.name: Multi-Agent Computer Use
records.summary: MACU represents computer-use objectives as a dependency graph whose manager dispatches parallel subagents and revises tasks as new information arrives. Desktop and web experiments examine coordination, information handoff and task-completion time.

records.name: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
records.summary: STaR-KV compresses GUI-agent KV caches by calibrating visual-token importance across attention subspaces and interaction time. Its training-free scoring combines spatial specialization, temporal redundancy and an adaptive temperature, evaluated at matched cache budgets.

records.name: OpenWebRL: Demystifying Online Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning for Visual Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces OpenWebRL, a framework for training visual web agents with online multi-turn reinforcement learning on live websites, including browser infrastructure and success judging.

records.name: Context-Aware Workflow Decomposition for Automated Mobile UI Annotation Using Multimodal Large Language Models
records.summary: Studies staged prompting for automated mobile UI element annotation, comparing workflow depths and element groupings on expert-annotated MUIAnno screens.

records.name: SkillHarm: Lifecycle-Aware Skill-Based Attacks via Automated Construction
Thinking in Blender: Staged Executable Inverse Graphics with Vision-Language Models
Any2Poster: Any-Source Poster Generation Across Modalities and Domains
DeskCraft: Benchmarking Desktop Agents on Professional Workflows and Human-in-the-Loop Collaboration
records.summary: DeskCraft evaluates professional desktop workflows and human-agent collaboration through mid-execution clarification, interruption and post-completion feedback. Its tasks cover creative applications and expose difficulties in long-horizon execution and proactive clarification.

records.name: MedCUA-Bench: A Screenshot-Only Benchmark for Clinical Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: MedCUA-Bench evaluates screenshot-only clinical interface workflows using paired intent- and step-level goals. It combines reconstructed medical interfaces with completion and clinical-safety checks, and separately reports results on a real OpenEMR system.

records.name: Perceive Before Reasoning: A Pre-Reasoning Perception Framework for Efficient and Reliable Proactive Mobile Agents
records.summary: Introduces PRPF, a two-stage framework for proactive mobile agents that gates intervention with MPP and invokes PAR only when assistance is warranted.

records.name: CLI-Anything: Towards Agent-Native Computer Use
records.summary: CLI-Anything argues for application interfaces built around structured commands, explicit state and execution feedback. It describes transforming existing software into command-line harnesses and organizing that approach through CLI-Hub.

records.name: RealClawBench: Live OpenClaw Benchmarks from Real Developer-Agent Sessions
Agent libOS: A Runtime Substrate for Capability-Controlled Self-Evolving LLM Agents
Demo2Tutorial: From Human Experience to Multimodal Software Tutorials
records.summary: Introduces Demo2Tutorial, which turns recorded software interactions into multimodal tutorials with task graphs and reports benefits for GUI-agent planning.

records.name: Online Skill Learning for Web Agents via State-Grounded Dynamic Retrieval
records.summary: State-Grounded Dynamic Retrieval extracts reusable sub-procedures from completed web trajectories and represents them as paired text and code. Skills are retrieved against both the current webpage state and the task goal at intermediate execution steps.

records.name: MIRAGE: Mobile Agents with Implicit Reasoning and Generative World Models
records.summary: Introduces MIRAGE, which trains mobile app agents to reason in compact latent states and anticipate future screenshots, reducing generated tokens during action selection.

records.name: Benchmarking Living-Screen-Native GUI Agents on Short-Video Platforms
records.summary: LivingScreen evaluates agents in a browser-based short-video environment where observing content consumes time and affects subsequent actions. Its task suite scores accuracy together with information efficiency to diagnose over- and under-observation on continuously changing screens.

records.name: AppAgent-Claw: CLI Is All You Need for GUI Automation
records.summary: Introduces AppAgent-Claw, which records demonstrated GUI workflows as reusable OpenClaw skills, locates visual targets during replay and checks intended on-screen effects.

records.name: Domain-Conditioned Safety in Frontier Computer-Using Agents: A 793-Episode Browser Benchmark, a Coding-Domain Cross-Reference, and a Reproducibility Audit of Recent Red-Teaming
records.summary: Introduces CUA-HandCrafted, a browser-agent red-teaming benchmark that varies attack templates, tasks and system prompts. Its domain comparison and reproducibility audit caution against transferring browser-surface safety conclusions to coding agents or unreleased optimized injections.

records.name: DeployBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Research Artifact Deployment
SciVisAgentSkills: Design and Evaluation of Agent Skills for Scientific Data Analysis and Visualization
AsyncWebRL: Efficient Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Step Visual Web Agents
records.summary: AsyncWebRL overlaps web-agent rollouts, updates and policy refresh while managing screenshot handling and a persistent rollout pool. It also replaces trajectory-length normalization in multi-step GRPO to reduce verbose failed trajectories, with throughput and out-of-distribution evaluation.

records.name: Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization
PerceptUI: LLM Agents as Human-Aligned Synthetic Users for UI/UX Evaluation
records.summary: Introduces PerceptUI, a persona-conditioned model for predicting how particular users answer questions about interfaces, supporting synthetic UI/UX evaluation.

records.name: DragOn: A Benchmark and Dataset for Drag-Based GUI Interactions
records.summary: DragOn supplies drag-grounding training data and a held-out benchmark for highlighting text, selecting cells, resizing elements and moving sliders. It evaluates existing vision-language models and a model fine-tuned on the drag tasks.

records.name: MacArena: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on an Online macOS Environment
records.summary: MacArena runs computer-use tasks through Apple’s virtualization framework on Apple Silicon, combining task ports with macOS-native workloads. It distinguishes the ported and native subsets when examining agent performance and cross-platform transfer.

records.name: Signal-Driven Observation for Long-Horizon Web Agents
records.summary: Proposes Signal-Driven Observation: a separate call selects relevant DOM elements and selectors, and a detector requests new observations only after meaningful browser events or failures. The paper frames observation timing and compression as an architectural research problem for long-horizon web agents.

records.name: StainFlow: Entity-Stain Tracking and Evidence Linking for Process Rewards in GUI Agents
records.summary: StainFlow tracks visually verifiable task entities through GUI trajectories to identify phases and retrieve focused evidence windows. Its process-reward model is tested for both online policy learning and trajectory-completion judgments.

records.name: SlimSearcher: Training Efficiency-Aware Web Agents via Adaptive Reward Gating
Self-evolving LLM agents with in-distribution Optimization
records.summary: Introduces Q-Evolve, which derives step-wise rewards from an in-distribution critic for LLM agent learning; WebShop is one of its interactive evaluation settings.

records.name: Syll: Open-Source Personal Automation with Cross-Surface Execution
records.summary: Syll combines tool calls, shell execution and visual GUI control in a personal-automation runtime. It turns user demonstrations into reusable skills and exposes execution logs, keyframes and approval checkpoints for inspection.

records.name: Oversight Has a Capacity: Calibrating Agent Guards to a Subjective, Fatiguing Human
RunAgent SuperBrowser: A Theory of Autonomous Web Navigation Grounded in Human Browsing Behaviour
records.summary: SUPERBROWSER combines screenshot-based target proposals with separate orchestration, planning and action roles. A bounded ledger and context-eviction process retain recent actions, task facts and checkpoints during browser execution.

records.name: WeaveBench: A Long-Horizon, Real-World Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents with Hybrid Interfaces
records.summary: WeaveBench requires agents to combine GUI, command-line and code operations within long tasks on an Ubuntu desktop. A trajectory-aware judge checks deliverables and interaction evidence, including shortcut behavior that outcome-only grading can miss.

records.name: AliyunConsoleAgent: Training Web Agents in Real-World Cloud Environments via Distillation and Reinforcement Learning
records.summary: AliyunConsoleAgent trains browser agents to verify documented procedures against changing cloud-console UIs through trajectory distillation and online GRPO. Provisioned rollout environments and backend audit-log checks support training and outcome evaluation.

records.name: iOSWorld: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Phone Agents
records.summary: Introduces a native iOS simulator benchmark with persistent user data, multi-app tasks, and personalization-dependent phone workflows.

records.name: From Confident Closing to Silent Failure: Characterizing False Success in LLM Agents
STAGE-Claw: Automated State-based Agent Benchmarking for Realistic Scenarios
WebChallenger: A Reliable and Efficient Generalist Web Agent
records.summary: WebChallenger builds a hierarchical DOM-derived page representation for selective observation, reusable site maps and compound actions. The framework combines these mechanisms without model fine-tuning and evaluates generalization across multiple web-agent benchmarks.

records.name: GUI-AC: Enhancing Continual Learning in GUI Agents
records.summary: GUI-AC uses grounding certainty to adjust advantage weighting and policy-clipping bounds during continual reinforcement fine-tuning. Its mechanisms aim to suppress noisy confidence updates while retaining exploration under shifting GUI domains and resolutions.

records.name: MemVenom: Triggered Poisoning of Multimodal Memories in Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces MemVenom, a black-box attack that plants coordinated text and image content in web-agent memory to trigger retrieval and redirect later actions.

records.name: Workflow-GYM: Towards Long-Horizon Evaluation of Computer-use Agentic tasks in Real-World Professional Fields
records.summary: Workflow-GYM evaluates long GUI workflows in professional software. Its analysis examines failures such as omitted stages, accumulated errors and goal drift during specialized end-to-end work.

records.name: A History-Aware Visually Grounded Critic for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: HiViG combines a compact history of completed actions with a visually grounded critic that checks proposed coordinates before execution. Its evaluations separate history-related planning failures from errors caused by targeting the wrong screen element.

records.name: Data Journalist Agent: Transforming Data into Verifiable Multimodal Stories
ISE: An Execution-Grounded Recipe for Multi-Turn OS-Agent Trajectories
Speculative Rollback Correction for Quality-Diverse Web Agent Imitation
records.summary: Speculative Rollback Correction lets a student web agent execute short branches before teacher review localizes harmful deviations. Verified continuations and localized corrections feed supervised training while an archive retains diverse successful solutions.

records.name: CAPED: Context-Aware Privacy Exposure Defense for Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: CAPED filters mobile screenshots before upload by combining task requirements, screen context and parsed UI elements to mask incidental private content. AndroidWorld and a controlled seeded privacy evaluation examine leakage reduction alongside task utility and prototype costs.

records.name: Reasoning for Mobile User Experience with Multimodal LLMs: Task, Benchmark, and Approach
records.summary: Introduces UXBench for diagnosing usability issues from UI screenshots and UI-UX, a reinforcement-trained model for reasoning about those interface problems.

records.name: ComAct: Reframing Professional Software Manipulation via COM-as-Action Paradigm
records.summary: ComAct proposes COM program synthesis as an alternative interface for manipulating professional software and introduces ComCADBench with GUI-based comparison agents. ComActor adds a staged training and correction approach, supported by a Windows-container training platform.

records.name: Who Pays the Price? Stakeholder-Centric Prompt Injection Benchmarking for Real-world Web Agents
records.summary: StakeBench evaluates prompt-injection harm to different stakeholders in shopping web-agent workflows. Its executable cases separate attack objectives and assess both outcomes and execution processes to reveal how the same attack pattern can affect different parties.

records.name: Benchmarking Web Agent Safety under E-commerce Deceptive Interfaces
records.summary: Introduces WebDecept, a plugin for injecting deceptive e-commerce interface patterns during web-agent tasks and evaluating how multimodal agents respond.

records.name: A Benchmark and Framework for Evaluating Next Action Predictions in Spreadsheets
records.summary: Introduces a benchmark and online evaluation method for predicting the next spreadsheet action from a user's action history, using curated action sequences.

records.name: Naive Visual Memory is Not Enough: A Failure-Mode Study of GUI Agents
records.summary: This study finds that full-image visual memory can reduce some state errors while worsening action-level failures. Its AGMem alternative stores local crops associated with successful actions or recovery and evaluates their use in desktop GUI tasks.

records.name: Running the Gauntlet: Hard Agentic Tasks
records.summary: Introduces GauntletBench, a web-based benchmark of vision-intensive tasks in five professional applications for assessing agent perception, 3D reasoning, and generalisation.

records.name: VISTA: View-Consistent Self-Verified Training for GUI Grounding
records.summary: VISTA forms GRPO comparison groups from target-preserving crops of the same GUI instance with exactly remapped target boxes. A conditional, advantage-weighted cross-view anchor supplies additional supervision without entering the group baseline, and evaluation includes view-consistency robustness.

records.name: PhoneHarness: Harnessing Phone-Use Agents through Mixed GUI, CLI, and Tool Actions
records.summary: PhoneHarness routes phone workflows across GUI actions, device-side commands and host tools while retaining auditable execution traces. Its accompanying benchmark checks observable task side effects, separating mixed-action execution from plausible final-answer generation.

records.name: Are Online Skill and Memory Modules Always Worth Their Tokens? A Budget-Constrained Study of Web Agents
records.summary: Compares online skill and memory augmentations with a vanilla web agent given the same total inference-token budget. Across WebArena and WorkArena settings, it studies when module overhead removes aggregate gains and how rerun variability changes conclusions.

records.name: OSGuard: A Benchmark for Safety in Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Evaluates action-level guardrails and full computer tasks with environment-dependent safety constraints, separating safe completion from nominal success.

records.name: CODA-BENCH: Can Code Agents Handle Data-Intensive Tasks?
Where Did It Go Wrong? Process-Level Evaluation of Web Agents with Semantic State Tracking
records.summary: Introduces WebStep, a web-agent benchmark that records semantic states behind GUI interactions to analyze exploration, execution accuracy, and decisive errors across task steps.

records.name: Multi-agent Framework for Time-Sensitive Complementary Collaboration in Minecraft
Imperfect Visual Verification for Code Edition : A Case Study on TikZ
LLM-as-Code: Agentic Programming for Agent Harness
records.summary: Proposes Agentic Programming, where code controls agent loops and invokes LLM-as-Code for reasoning; a computer-use case study examines long visual action sequences.

records.name: Beyond NL2Code: A Structured Survey of Multimodal Code Intelligence
VisualClaw: A Real-Time, Personalized Agent for the Physical World
FraudSMSWalker: Benchmarking Agentic Large Language Models for SMS-to-Webpage Fraud Detection
records.summary: FraudSMSWalker tests browser agents on bilingual SMS-to-webpage fraud judgments while hiding URL and reputation shortcuts. Its controlled chains include difficult benign login/payment cases and evaluate whether classifications remain supported by the visible message and page evidence.

records.name: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: MyPCBench tests personal-assistant tasks on a Linux desktop with simulated web applications and data for a single fictional persona. A shared computer-and-shell interface enables evaluation of cross-application workflows that depend on personal context and account-like state.

records.name: LabOSBench: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents for Scientific Instrument Control
records.summary: LabOSBench evaluates GUI agents on browser-based scientific instrument simulators with configurable tasks and execution-based checks. Its subtask and end-to-end tests examine feedback-driven adjustment and long workflows without controlling physical instruments.

records.name: MemSlides: A Hierarchical Memory Driven Agent Framework for Personalized Slide Generation with Multi-turn Local Revision
ProCUA-SFT Technical Report
records.summary: ProCUA-SFT generates tasks and synthetic trajectories on live desktops seeded with document content, checking task preconditions before rollout. The resulting step-prefix examples are formatted to match inference context and used for supervised GUI-agent fine-tuning.

records.name: SEAGym: An Evaluation Environment for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
Beyond Domains: Reusing Web Skills via Transferable Interaction Patterns
records.summary: Introduces SkillMigrator, a web agent that turns successful interactions into reusable skills and transfers them between sites by matching page layouts and live element references.

records.name: PreAct: Computer-Using Agents that Get Faster on Repeated Tasks
records.summary: PreAct compiles successful screen-interaction runs into guarded state-machine programs for repeated tasks. It validates programs from clean states before storage and returns control to the agent when replayed screen expectations fail, with tests across mobile, desktop and web.

records.name: Trust the Right Teacher: Quality-Aware Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
records.summary: Proposes quality-aware self-distillation for GUI coordinate generation under student-produced prefixes. A correctness-aware gate suppresses coordinate-token supervision outside the target box, while teacher-probability scaling adjusts the remaining signal strength.

records.name: Complexity and Scale in AI-Assisted Workflow Management: A Federated Learning Case Study
VISUALSKILL: Multimodal Skills for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: VISUALSKILL organizes application-specific text and figures into hierarchical skills retrieved on demand through an MCP tool. Skills combine authored documentation with live UI exploration, and matched multimodal/text-only comparisons test their utility for interface identification and workflow-state verification.

records.name: HANSEL: Extracting Breadcrumbs from Web Agent Trajectories for Interactive Verification
records.summary: HANSEL extracts evidence pages and snippets from browser-agent traces and preserves relevant page state in interactive verification views. It flags untraceable answers and evaluates evidence selection and human verification effort separately.

records.name: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation for GUI Agents
records.summary: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation first lets a policy reach its own off-trajectory states, then uses skill guidance to collect successful continuations. Mixing those continuations with expert traces supplies supervision for recovery states absent from demonstrations.

records.name: RODS: Reward-Driven Online Data Synthesis for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
Beyond the GUI Paradigm: Do Mobile Agents Need the Phone Screen?
records.summary: This study compares general coding agents using mobile command-line access with reproducible GUI agents on AndroidWorld and MobileWorld. It also supplies oracle CLI analyses and a separate task suite for operations such as bulk changes, filtering and hidden device state.

records.name: MemGUI-Agent: An End-to-End Long-Horizon Mobile GUI Agent with Proactive Context Management
records.summary: MemGUI-Agent makes context management an action chosen by the same policy that controls the mobile UI. Structured history, UI-state and recent-step fields are trained from annotated trajectories to retain cross-app facts while limiting context growth.

records.name: MobileForge: Annotation-Free Adaptation for Mobile GUI Agents with Hierarchical Feedback-Guided Policy Optimization
records.summary: MobileForge couples real-app exploration and generated tasks with hierarchical feedback for mobile-agent adaptation. Its optimizer turns trajectory outcomes, step feedback and corrective hints into contextualized GRPO updates, with evaluation on AndroidWorld and a GUI-only MobileWorld split.

records.name: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
BIM-Edit: Benchmarking Large Language Models for IFC-Based Building Information Modeling
Automating SKILL.md Generation for Computer-Using Agents via Interaction Trajectory Mining
records.summary: Segments and clusters GUI trajectories into inspectable skills, then trains a skill-aware policy from those annotations. Its diagnostic results distinguish readable source-domain clusters from reliable transfer and report limited or absent downstream gains.

records.name: OctoNest: Adaptive Cross-Device Execution through Stateful Control
records.summary: Introduces OctoNest, which coordinates device agents, revises task assignments from execution feedback, and switches local interaction modalities; CAPEBench evaluates cross-device tasks.

records.name: Darwin Mobile Agent: A Roadmap for Self-Evolution
records.summary: Describes asynchronous reinforcement-learning infrastructure using parallel cloud-hosted Android instances, explicit task lifecycles, and persistent-state management for mobile GUI interaction.

records.name: SkillHarness: Harnessing Safe Skills for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces SkillHarness, a framework for computer-use agents to learn and reuse skills under safety constraints when interactions include prompt injections or pop-ups.

records.name: MIRAGE: Stealthy Visual Prompt Injection for Vulnerability Detection in Web Agents
records.summary: MIRAGE evaluates targeted next-action hijacking from adversarial images restricted to legitimate third-party webpage regions. It combines diffusion-based image generation with execution-aware optimization and tests the constrained visual-injection setting on web-agent frameworks.

records.name: When Web Agents Finish but Still Fail: Reproducible Triggers and Trace Diagnostics for Parallel Web Exploration
records.summary: Introduces Parallel WebBench for parallel web exploration and uses verified URL trajectories to diagnose search loops, incomplete answers, and failures after evidence retrieval.

records.name: Fara-1.5: Scalable Learning Environments for Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Builds browser-agent training trajectories with live and synthetic environments, solvers, user simulation, and complementary correctness and efficiency verifiers.

records.name: Whose Agent Are You? Multi-Layer Fingerprinting and Attribution of Autonomous Web Agents
records.summary: Builds a logging framework that combines network/protocol fingerprints with browser interaction behavior to attribute web-agent traffic. A decision-tree classifier is evaluated across six agent implementations, human browsing and conventional crawlers.

records.name: ChainWorld: Composing Long-Horizon Desktop Workloads from Atomic OSWorld Tasks
records.summary: ChainWorld composes compatible atomic OSWorld tasks into multi-objective desktop chains while preserving their evaluators. It compares giving the full sequence at once with revealing goals turn by turn, exposing different state and session-management failures.

records.name: MacAgentBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Real-World macOS Desktop
records.summary: Introduces macOS tasks spanning GUI and command-line interaction, with deterministic checks and intermediate-progress scoring for application workflows.

records.name: Agent MechSuits: Mechanistic Subspace Safety Steering for Multi-Turn CLI Agents
records.summary: Introduces Agent MechSuits, a framework that detects unsafe states and steers multi-turn CLI agents through hidden-representation interventions, alongside the MAS trajectory benchmark.

records.name: When AUC 0.998 Is Not Enough: A Candidate Evaluation Protocol for Hidden-State Probes of Indirect Prompt Injection in Multimodal Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Proposes diagnostic controls for hidden-state probes of indirect prompt injection in multimodal computer-use agents, using a teacher-forced Mind2Web case study.

records.name: ENVS: Environment-Native Verified Search for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
records.summary: ENVS branches over GUI actions in live desktop VMs, verifies successful leaves, and converts them into balanced step-level training supervision. It also introduces OSWorld-Noisy to test recovery from dynamic interruptions while retaining the underlying tasks.

records.name: Capable but Careless: Do Computer-Use Agents Follow Contextual Integrity?
records.summary: AgentCIBench evaluates whether computer-use agents disclose information in ways that violate its original context. Deterministically scored scenarios test nearby sensitive UI content, ambiguous requests and recipient mismatches, including end-to-end agent execution.

records.name: AOHP: An Open-Source OS-Level Agent Harness for Personalized, Efficient and Secure Interaction
records.summary: Introduces AOHP, an Android OS-level harness that treats agents as system actors and provides adaptive interfaces, agent interfaces, and information-flow controls.

records.name: EnterpriseClawBench: Benchmarking Agents from Real Workplace Sessions
Reinforcement Learning for Computer-Use Agents with Autonomous Evaluation
records.summary: The framework uses a vision-language judge’s final-screen assessment as a terminal reward for GUI reinforcement learning. It models evaluator noise and corrects the reward estimator used by PPO across desktop benchmarks.

records.name: VisCritic: Visual State Comparison as Process Reward for GUI Agents
records.summary: VisCritic compares before/after screenshots through change-aware visual features and an action-conditioned critic. Weakly supervised samples from existing traces train judgments of action success, progress and error type for GUI-agent verification.

records.name: GUI vs. CLI: Execution Bottlenecks in Screen-Only and Skill-Mediated Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: This benchmark matches desktop goals, initial states and final-state verifiers across screen-only GUI and skill-mediated CLI agents. Its experiments separate graphical execution failures from missing CLI skill coverage, including a verifier-guided skill-augmentation condition.

records.name: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
GUI agent: Guided Exploration of User-Sensitive Screens
records.summary: This short paper develops an explorer agent that expands from a demonstrated GUI task to discover requests likely to reach user-sensitive screens. The proposed exploration supports identifying situations where task execution should be handed back to the user.

records.name: Uncertainty Quantification for Computer-Use Agents: A Benchmark across Vision-Language Models and GUI Grounding Datasets
records.summary: Argus benchmarks post-hoc uncertainty methods for single-step GUI grounding across open-weight and closed-source observation regimes. It tests calibration, rejection, error severity and conformal click regions, finding that uncertainty rankings transfer less reliably across model/interface regimes than across datasets for one model.

records.name: WinDOM: Self-Family Distillation for Small-Model GUI Grounding
records.summary: WinDOM obtains bounding-box supervision from a Windows 11 web reimplementation driven through Playwright, and studies rejection-sampling distillation for small GUI grounders. It treats the depth of the supervised cold start as a GRPO choice, comparing same-size EMA and larger same-family teachers.

records.name: Neglected Free Lunch from Post-training: Progress Advantage for LLM Agents
Empowering GUI Agents via Autonomous Experience Exploration and Hindsight Experience Utilization for Task Planning
records.summary: PEEU explores web environments and turns hindsight experience into aligned high-level planning supervision. A hierarchical task-decomposition analysis examines why atomic-skill competence alone falls short of planning generalization across websites.

records.name: Ko-WideSearch: A Korean Breadth-Search Benchmark for Exhaustive Set Enumeration by Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces Ko-WideSearch, a Korean web-agent benchmark that asks agents to find every member of a set and fill a table of attributes for each member.

records.name: TUA-Bench: A Benchmark for General-Purpose Terminal-Use Agents
records.summary: TUA-Bench evaluates terminal-use agents on general digital tasks, including document editing, email, web information seeking and specialist software workflows. Tasks run in real terminals with deterministic setup and execution-based scoring.

records.name: Animation2Code: Evaluating Temporal Visual Reasoning in Video-to-Code Generation
Bridging VideoQA and Video-Guided Agentic Tasks via Generalized Keyframe Extraction
records.summary: Introduces VG-GUIBench to evaluate GUI agents following video tutorials, and TASKER to select task-relevant keyframes for video-guided tasks and VideoQA.

records.name: Agent-Computer Observation Interfaces Enable Dynamic Computer Use
records.summary: The Agent-Computer Observation Interface separates continuous perception from discrete computer actions using captured frames, audio transcription and persistent visual narration. DynaCU-Bench tests these components on dynamic browser tasks and static controls, with model-specific ablations showing that additional observations can also hurt.

records.name: OSWorld 2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
records.summary: Introduces extended computer-use workflows with realistic artifacts, changing information, hidden state, and partial-progress and safety assessments.

records.name: GUICrafter: Weakly-Supervised GUI Agent Leveraging Massive Unannotated Screenshots
records.summary: GUICrafter first learns grounding from large collections of unannotated screenshots and webpages, then uses a smaller high-quality dataset for reinforcement-learning calibration. The curriculum targets reduced dependence on manually annotated GUI training data.

records.name: SpreadsheetBench 2: Evaluating Agents on End-to-End Business Spreadsheet Workflows
records.summary: Introduces SpreadsheetBench 2, a benchmark of multi-sheet business spreadsheet workflows for agents, covering generation, debugging, and visualization tasks.

records.name: One Forward Beats Two: InnerZoom for Accurate and Efficient GUI Grounding
records.summary: InnerZoom preserves target-region cues from intermediate decoder layers and reinjects a compact evidence state during coordinate decoding. Its single-forward GUI grounder is compared with crop-and-rerun zooming and matched supervised/RL baselines for accuracy and inference cost.

records.name: On the Internet, Nobody Knows You're an LLM Bot: Unmasking Web Agents with Multi-Layer Fingerprinting
records.summary: Evaluates web agents against anti-bot mechanisms on instrumented honeysites and analyzes network, HTTP and browser fingerprints. The study compares resistance to blocking with the ability to distinguish agents, humans and agent implementations.

records.name: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
LUMOS: A Semantic Operating-System Layer for Accessibility-Grounded AI Agents
records.summary: LUMOS converts native accessibility metadata and browser UI structure into semantic interface blueprints with stable element identifiers and available actions. It combines live pointer-to-element grounding with an observe-act loop constrained to visible-UI primitives.

records.name: PPT-Eval: A Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents on PowerPoint Tasks
records.summary: Introduces PPT-Eval, a benchmark of PowerPoint creation and editing tasks for computer-use agents, with rubrics that score partial progress and presentation quality.

records.name: Embodied CAD: Solver-Grounded LLM Agents for Parametric B-Rep Assembly Modeling
Learning from Failure: Inference-Time Self-Improvement for Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Uses failed computer-use trajectories to diagnose failure modes and generate inference-time agent code patches, with light human verification. An OSWorld study evaluates this failure-driven improvement loop without additional model training.

records.name: Xiaomi-GUI-0 Technical Report
records.summary: Describes a mobile GUI agent trained through real-device interaction, corrected failure trajectories, supervised learning, and reinforcement learning.

records.name: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
records.summary: Proposes ATMem, an updated execution-state memory for long mobile GUI tasks, and STR-GRPO to train selective memory use; also introduces a mobile task benchmark.

records.name: DigitalCoach: Communication and Grounding Gaps in Human and Agentic Computer Use Coaching
records.summary: DigitalCoach records expert–novice software coaching conversations aligned with screen and input events. Automated and interactive evaluations examine how model coaches differ from humans in explanation, error diagnosis and visual grounding when helping a learner operate software.

records.name: BaRA: Budget-constrained and Reliable Web Data Collection Agent
records.summary: Introduces BaRA, a web data-collection agent that discovers live site links, checks extracted text, images, and videos, and uses history to recover from failures.

records.name: (A)I Sees What You Don't: Exploiting New Attack Surfaces in Third-Party Mobile Agents
records.summary: Analyzes cross-app privilege escalation and visual attack surfaces introduced by third-party VLM-powered mobile agents.

records.name: A Task-State Representation for Long-Horizon Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces TSR, a training-free wrapper for long-horizon mobile GUI agents that tracks instructions, subgoal progress, and action outcomes separately from screen observations.

records.name: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
PACE: A Proxy for Agentic Capability Evaluation
Do GUI Agents Believe Their Eyes? Diagnosing State-Belief Reliance on Pixels versus Structure
records.summary: Defines visual state reliance and probes whether GUI agents resolve screenshot/structure conflicts using pixels, serialized interface structure or prior beliefs. Paired interventions and live multi-step tests connect misattributed state beliefs to failures and compare consistency-based mitigations.

records.name: UI-MOPD: Multi-Platform On-Policy Distillation for Unified GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces Uni-GUI, a collection of executable desktop and mobile trajectories, and UI-MOPD, which trains a shared policy from its own rollouts using platform-specific teachers. The distillation procedure routes each visited state to the appropriate teacher to preserve distinct interaction conventions.

records.name: Agent Data Injection Attacks are Realistic Threats to AI Agents
records.summary: This study examines agent data injection, where untrusted content impersonates trusted metadata or tool-context data. It reports arbitrary-click vulnerabilities in web agents alongside separate coding-agent attacks, highlighting trust-boundary failures beyond instruction injection.

records.name: Untrusted Content Masking for Web Agents with Security Guarantees
records.summary: Untrusted Content Masking uses DOM structure to redact untrusted webpage regions before agent observation. A sandboxed interaction interface separates privileges so browser actions can proceed under the proposed trust-boundary model without exposing protected content to the planner.

records.name: The Balkanization of Execution-Security Research for AI Coding Agents: Isolation, Access Control, and Time-of-Check-to-Time-of-Use Vulnerabilities
TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training
records.summary: Proposes TurnOPD, a rollout-depth and loss-budgeting method for training long-horizon language agents; WebShop is one of its evaluation settings.

records.name: PCBWorld: A Benchmark Environment for Engine-Grounded PCB Design Automation
PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Cross-Lingual Long-Horizon Workflows
WebRetriever: A Large-Scale Comprehensive Benchmark for Efficient Web Agent Evaluation
records.summary: WebRetriever evaluates navigation, knowledge-assisted interaction and end-to-end information-extraction workflows under separate protocols. Its NavEval judge uses richer interaction context to diagnose cases where navigation success and useful task completion diverge.

records.name: UI2App: Benchmarking Visual Interaction Inference in Executable Web Application Generation
When Agents Remember Too Much: Memory Poisoning Attacks on Large Language Model Agents
DeepSearch-World: Self-Distillation for Deep Search Agents in a Verifiable Environment
Prismata: Confining Cross-Site Prompt Injection in Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces Prismata, a defense for web agents that assigns trust labels to page content and enforces them by redacting content and restricting agent actions.

records.name: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
records.summary: Introduces UniClawBench, a benchmark of proactive agents on bilingual real-world tasks, evaluated in live Docker containers with stepwise checkpoints and simulated user feedback.

records.name: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading
EvoCUA-1.5: Online Reinforcement Learning for Multi-turn Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: EvoCUA-1.5 trains multi-turn desktop agents through online reinforcement learning in executable sandboxes. It combines step-level policy optimization, task filtering and calibration, an adaptive curriculum, and asynchronous rollout handling with staleness control.

records.name: Exploring Agentic Workflows for Generating High Quality Math Visual Aids
MAG: A Web-Agent Benchmark and Harness for Multimodal Action and Guide Generation
records.summary: MAG jointly evaluates browser task actions and user-facing guides grounded in screenshots through element marks or pixel coordinates. Its harness covers annotation, live evaluation and joint metrics, with an expert-trajectory-augmented GRPO training study.

records.name: ChartSync: A Benchmark for Visuo-Logical Cascading Chart Editing
ANCHOR: Automated Alignment Auditing for CLI Agents on Real-World Harm
The Compliance Trap: Diagnosing How AI Agents Consume Conflicting Memory
records.summary: The Entry–Propagation–Recovery framework traces where conflicting memory first changes an agent action, how the effect propagates and whether recovery occurs. WebArena and the controlled MemTrapBench separate memory-consumption failures across these stages.

records.name: VIA: Visual Interface Agent for Robot Control
SCALECUA: Scaling Computer Use Agents with Verifiable Task Synthesis and Efficient Online RL
records.summary: Scales computer-agent reinforcement learning through verifiable task generation, capability-aware rollout allocation, and segmented visual context.

records.name: StructAgent: Harness Long-horizon Digital Agents with Unified Causal Structure
records.summary: StructAgent maintains compact task state and regulates long-horizon execution through verified transitions and progress checkpoints. Its workflow supports evidence-based completion and targeted recovery, with desktop computer-use evaluation and a separate Minecraft extension.

records.name: Designing Agent-Ready Websites for AI Web Agents: A Framework for Machine Readability, Actionability, and Decision Reliability
records.summary: Proposes an agent-ready website design framework for e-commerce browser agents and compares it with a human-oriented site on shopping tasks, outcomes, steps, and token use.

records.name: Isolation as a First-Class Principle for LLM-Agent System Safety: Concepts, Taxonomy, Challenges and Future Directions
KnowAct-GUIClaw: Know Deeply, Act Perfectly, Personal GUI Assistant with Self-Evolving Memory and Skill
records.summary: KnowAct-GUIClaw combines a host planner with pluggable GUI subagents, attributable experience memory and an evolving skill library. It uses user profiles and feedback for task decomposition and evaluates transfer across Android, iOS, HarmonyOS and Windows.

records.name: A Learning-Rate-Gated Failure of GRPO in a Small Language and Vision-Language Model Web Agent: A Controlled Null and Its Mechanism
records.summary: Studies a controlled setting where GRPO fails to improve a strong small web agent and can reduce text-track performance. Matched reachable-reward tasks and component grafting distinguish limited optimization headroom from learning-rate-dependent failure mechanisms.

records.name: PalmClaw: A Native On-Device Agent Framework for Mobile Phones
records.summary: Introduces PalmClaw, an on-device phone agent framework that manages sessions, memory, and tools, exposing mobile capabilities through structured device-tool calls.

records.name: Baselines Before Architecture: Evaluating Coding Agents for Autonomous Penetration Testing
How Agents Ask for Permission: User Permissions for AI Agents, from Interfaces to Enforcement
Experience Memory Graph: One-Shot Error Correction for Agents
TRACE: Turn-level Reward Assignment via Credit Estimation for Long-Horizon Agents
VisualRepair: Dynamic Tool Calling and Region Focusing for Visual Software Issue Repair
Multi-Head Latent Control: A Unified Interface for LLM Agent Decision Making
records.summary: Introduces Multi-Head Latent Control, a layer that reads frozen LLM or VLM hidden-state trajectories to signal when an agent should defer, seek clarification, use tools, abstain, or answer.

records.name: Tactile: Giving Computer-Using Agents Hands and Feet
records.summary: Tactile turns accessibility, OCR and visual evidence into explicit desktop targets with executable actions and verification cues. Its execution loop chooses semantic actions or coordinate fallbacks while retaining provenance for replay and diagnosis.

records.name: HyMobileAgent: Data-Environment Co-Scaling for Efficient GUI Agents
records.summary: Combines GUI perception data, instructional videos, real and simulated devices, and planning with reflection to develop a mobile agent.

records.name: Plover: Steering GUI Agents through Plan-Centric Interaction
records.summary: Plover exposes GUI-agent plans and replanning as persistent artifacts that users can inspect and edit during execution. Its planner–executor design supports localized correction through plan edits, language guidance and screenshot-grounded interventions, studied through failure repair and workflow scenarios.

records.name: SeerGuard: A Safety Framework for Mobile GUI Agents via World Model Prediction
records.summary: Uses instruction screening and a safety-augmented world model to assess likely consequences of mobile GUI actions before execution.

records.name: PhysAgent: Reflective Agentic Physics Control for Physically Plausible Video Generation
Just A Rather Very Intelligent Spoken Agent
records.summary: Introduces JarvisBench, a benchmark for spoken mediation during long-horizon agent workflows, measuring task collaboration and how users follow ongoing execution.

records.name: Simulate to Generalize: Scaling Stateful Supervision for API-calling Agents using LLM World Models
Where Does Agent Reliability Come From? A Cross-Benchmark Decomposition of Verification Loops, Specialist Models, and Scaffolding in a Production Enterprise Agent
EvoGUI: An Evolution-Aware Benchmark for GUI State-Transition Understanding
records.summary: Introduces EvoGUI, which derives temporal ordering, inverse action/value prediction, and successor-discrimination probes from recorded GUI trajectories. Its web-derived benchmark isolates transition understanding from the other abilities involved in end-to-end task success.

records.name: Teach it to stop, not just to click
records.summary: Studies verifier-guided repair of a 35B computer-use agent across five environments, examining variation across runs and data draws in done detection, GUI clicks, and field entry.

records.name: Sidekick: Designing Communication for Effective Multitasking with Computer Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces Sidekick, a communication interface that uses ambient status cues, multimodal action summaries, and visual and verbal explanations of reasoning to help people monitor computer-use agents. A user study examines progress awareness, error traceability, and multitasking across background and foreground interaction.

records.name: RT-SHCUA: Real-Time Self-Hosted Computer-Use Agent for UAV Control
SEE: Structure-aware Exploring & Exploiting for Long-horizon GUI Agent Trajectory Synthesis
records.summary: Introduces SEE, which first explores mobile interfaces to build a screen-and-element transition graph, then composes task trajectories through graph planning and controlled sampling. It studies coverage, loop avoidance, and transfer after training agents on the generated sequences.

records.name: Broken Gates: Re-evaluating Web Bot Defenses in the Age of LLM Agents
records.summary: Measures how autonomous LLM browser agents interact with commercial bot-management and anti-automation defenses on the web.

records.name: DocOps: A Verifiable Benchmark for Autonomous Agents in Complex Document Operations
records.summary: Introduces DocOps, a verifiable benchmark for agents handling complex digital-document workflows, with analysis of state tracking, semantic checks, and structural edits.

records.name: OpenSkillRisk: Benchmarking Agent Safety When Using Real-World Risky Third-Party Skills
Verifier-First Evaluation of Agentic LLMs for Infrastructure-as-Code Generation
PersonaTrail: Benchmarking Personalized Web Agents through Browsing Trails
records.summary: Introduces PersonaTrail, a benchmark for personalized web agents using browsing histories, and PACMem, a structured memory method for guiding navigation.

records.name: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
records.summary: OpenForgeRL connects stateful agent harnesses to reinforcement-learning infrastructure through a model-call recording proxy and isolated rollout containers. Its validation includes browser and computer-use agents, alongside tool-oriented agents, and examines how harness choice affects learned reliability.

records.name: Toward User-Conditioned Evaluation of Personal LLM Agents under Temporal Interventions
Beyond Sequential Interaction: Benchmarking Parallel Execution and Coordination for GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces ParaGUIBench, with tasks and efficiency measurements for coordinated GUI agents operating separate desktop instances over a shared file system. Its ParaGUI planner-worker system decomposes tasks and dispatches concurrent subtasks for comparison with serial execution.

records.name: StepX-Edge: An On-Device UI Vision-Language Model via Architecture-Training-Deployment Co-Design
records.summary: Introduces StepX-Edge, an on-device UI vision-language model for screen understanding, OCR, question answering, and element grounding on mobile chips.

records.name: StateAct: Program State, before Pixels, for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces StateAct, a code-first computer-use harness that manipulates program state directly and delegates screenshot-and-click subgoals to a GUI agent. An independent completion gate checks saved outputs, while fresh subagents handle subgoals to limit accumulated context.

records.name: SeekJudge: A Practical Reward Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Introduces SeekJudge, which iteratively searches and analyzes GUI trajectories to assess instruction fulfillment. The work combines dense judgment-data synthesis, a step-label benchmark, and reward-server scheduling to study accurate and practical reward feedback for agent training.

records.name: E-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-Step Tool-Use Agents in Real-World Product Scenarios
Scaling GUI Agents with Visual State Transitions
records.summary: Introduces State Transition Pretraining, which jointly learns to infer actions from GUI changes and predict future states from current screens and actions. Subsequent instruction-trajectory fine-tuning tests whether these representations transfer to desktop and mobile agent tasks.

records.name: Falsifiable Commitment Planning for Self-Correcting Web Agents
records.summary: Introduces FCPAgent, which attaches confirming and falsifying evidence to each skill-grounded plan step. A plan–test–repair loop checks actions and observations, then localizes contradictions so execution, skills, or plans can be revised at the appropriate level.

records.name: SafeFlow: Semantic Information-Flow Control for Blocking Malicious Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems
records.summary: Introduces SafeFlow, a semantic information-flow defense for multi-agent delegation, evaluated on safety tasks that include harmful web-agent behavior.

records.name: Interactive Reward Agent: GUI Task Evaluation via Environment-State Verification
records.summary: Introduces an Interactive Reward Agent that proposes completion conditions and verifies them using system, application, and GUI tools after execution. GUI-RewardBench provides annotated desktop trajectories for evaluating these evidence-based judgments and their use in reinforcement learning.

records.name: Desktop-Delta Bench: Do Computer-Use Models Understand Desktop GUI Transitions?
