records.name: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
records.summary: Introduces TeleTune, which edits a textual skill library using held-out action prediction on offline software-use logs with missing goals or interleaved tasks. The learned workflows also guide retrieval of demonstrations for subsequent web-agent execution.

records.name: Imagine to Act: High-Fidelity Data Synthesis via Image Editing World Model for Scalable GUI Agent Training
records.summary: Introduces Infinite-Dreamer, which learns action-conditioned screenshot editing from structured descriptions of GUI changes and uses it to synthesize robustness examples and multi-step trajectories. The synthetic data trains a mobile GUI agent evaluated on AndroidWorld, MobileWorld, and AndroidControl-Curated.

records.name: ANT: A Multi-Granularity Network Traffic Dataset and Benchmark for Agents Behavior Auditing
CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
records.summary: Introduces CLIFT, which certifies agent-generated verification signals against training-time judges and reuses them for per-step rewards and trajectory selection. At inference, a frozen question bank helps compare candidate web rollouts without querying an external judge.

records.name: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
DIBench: Benchmarking Decision Integrity of GUI-based Mobile Agents Under Deceptive Injections
records.summary: Evaluates whether deceptive UI content steers mobile agents away from instruction-consistent choices, using paired benign and injected decision states and decision-integrity metrics.

records.name: GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets
ROMA: LLM System for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception
AMBER: Training Long-Horizon Web Agents through Append-Only Memory
records.summary: Introduces AMBER, an append-only memory framework in which a web agent learns to reason, act, and retain evidence using outcome-reward reinforcement learning. It studies whether preserving entries avoids the loss of facts and corrective feedback seen with rewritten memory.

records.name: PlaySuite: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Interactive Visual Intelligence
records.summary: Introduces PlaySuite, a closed-loop video-game benchmark that evaluates interactive visual agents, including computer-use agents, over extended play.

records.name: Internalizing Agent Experience into Diffusion Model Weights via On-Policy Context Distillation
Decoupling What from Where: How Should a Small GUI Grounding Model Receive the Action Type?
records.summary: Compares ways to condition a small GUI grounding model on action type under matched training conditions on Android in the Wild. The study traces apparent gains to a coordinate-serialization choice and reports limited evidence that the gains persist with predicted action types.

records.name: Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces
records.summary: Introduces PAIR for controlled evaluation of mobile GUI agents across user-conditioned application states and RePAIR for training from cross-user subgoal outcomes. The study examines failures when personalized interfaces change which items an agent must identify.

records.name: ChartBmkAgent: Harness-Governed Multi-Agent Construction of Chart QA Benchmarks from Sparse Error-Taxonomy Specifications
Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness
nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
records.summary: Presents nanoMuse, an open-source personal agent designed to act on phone and computer screens, with a shared conversation, action-checking Sentinel, and readable file memory.

records.name: WorldSolver: Can LLM Agents Simulate the Physical Dynamics via Solver Generation?
AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
records.summary: Presents AdvSim2Real, which jointly adapts web-task curricula, prompt-injection adversaries, and agent policies inside a frozen web world model. It evaluates robustness against an unseen adversary and transfer from simulated interaction to a real browser.

records.name: PhysEvo: Astra Can Act, Let It
SPLATIFY: Reproduce, Discover, Innovate! From Papers and Ideas to Trainable 3DGS Code
Adversarial Images Hijack Web Agents from Visual Grounding to Browser Execution
records.summary: Introduces WebMirage, a visual red-teaming framework that models webpage element competition and action post-processing to test whether manipulated grounding decisions lead to executed browser actions.

records.name: Secure-CUA: Controlling Untrusted Influence in Computer-Use Agents
records.summary: Proposes Secure-CUA, which commits to per-action transactions before reading untrusted page content and separates content queries from GUI target selection. The paper formalizes its protection assumptions and evaluates benign task utility on WebArena.

records.name: Adaptive Code Generation for Controlling Robots
AgentTime: Can Agents Estimate and Control Their Own Runtime?
records.summary: Evaluates duration following, runtime forecasts and elapsed-time estimates in native agent harnesses, including OSWorld desktop tasks, with external timers, native graders and work-versus-wait analysis.

records.name: TaoD2C-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Industrial UI Code Generation Beyond Visual Fidelity
RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
AgentHorizon: Evaluating Agentic Judges for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Tasks
records.summary: Introduces AgentHorizon, a benchmark for judging long computer-use trajectories using closely related instructions paired with recorded actions and screenshots. It tests whether judges can detect constraint violations and distinguish successful tasks from similar but incompatible requests.

records.name: GATOR: Generative and Agentic 3D Object Reconstruction From Casual Images
V-CoLA: Vision Token Compression with Linear Attention
USDCraft: Geometrically Grounded Programmatic Modeling of Articulated 3D Assets for Simulation
Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
records.summary: Studies when to improve an LLM agent's runtime harness or train its weights by classifying failed trajectories; WebArena-Lite supplies a web-task transfer test.

records.name: DeltaReplay: Task-Relative Memory Reuse for Mobile GUI Agents
records.summary: Introduces DeltaReplay, which stores mobile GUI trajectories as transition graphs and decides at each step whether to reuse an action, substitute task-specific parameters, or defer to the base agent. This supports reuse of partially matching experiences without rewriting stored memory.

records.name: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
records.summary: Presents LGWM, a decoder-free GUI world model that predicts the next screen representation from an action and compares it with the observed state to verify transitions. Its paired diagnostic separates legitimate and hijacked transitions that lead to the same credential screen.

records.name: Can LLMs Fix It Without Code? Toward Automated Verification of No-Code Bug Fixes
records.summary: Tests natural-language no-code fixes through GUI execution in Linux Brave. Scripted fixed/buggy-state gates and issue-specific checkers distinguish fix outcomes from the executor's completion claims.

records.name: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
records.summary: Introduces SoftwareGym, a pipeline that synthesizes runnable GUI applications and iteratively repairs them using execution checks. It also provides a task benchmark and studies whether training on synthesized application trajectories transfers to other computer-use environments.

records.name: When Charts Deceive Web Agents: A Paired Benchmark for Misleading Visualization-Grounded Tasks
records.summary: Introduces MisVisAgentBench, a paired executable benchmark that changes chart evidence while holding web tasks fixed, to trace how misleading visualizations affect agent decisions and downstream actions.

records.name: CaptchaAgent: Verifiable Visual Reasoning for CAPTCHA Solving
records.summary: Presents CaptchaAgent, which builds an explicit visual representation of objects and relations, refines ambiguous regions, and checks counterfactual consistency before acting on interactive CAPTCHAs.

records.name: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
records.summary: Aligns human screen recordings, input events, and accessibility information to derive reusable workflow skills from desktop demonstrations.

records.name: When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows
records.summary: Evaluates Jev as a bounded action selector inside three AndroidWorld agents and two text-based ALFWorld agents, separating decision savings from task success, recovery and resources per delivered outcome.

records.name: VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning
Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
ConClick: Element-Wise Contrastive Learning Improves GUI Grounding
records.summary: Analyzes recurring distractor clicks in GUI grounding and introduces ConClick, a contrastive training method built from target–distractor pairs. Its ReClick inference procedure revisits candidate regions and compares competing predictions.

records.name: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
records.summary: Introduces Web$hell, an interface that compiles live pages into persistent information and action objects so agents can gather evidence, navigate websites, and reuse acquired content through shared operations.

records.name: Stride: Scale-Aware Multi-Agent Evolutionary Refinement for Infographic Generation
APEX-Harm: Evaluating Agent Safety in Shared Professional Workspaces
A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
records.summary: Presents MASTIF, a framework for comparing combinations of agent models, protocols, and implementation frameworks on web tasks, with an initial assessment using 300 Mind2Web tasks.

records.name: BT-Agent: Deploying Onboard Robot Agents with Behavior Trees and Multi-Fidelity Evaluation
Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
SWEeper-Bench: Can Agents Discover Bugs in Interactive Software?
OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
records.summary: Introduces OpenMobile-2, combining simulated mobile apps, emulator tasks, released training data, and policies that can alternate GUI interaction with app-native tools.

records.name: Latent World Action Model for GUI Agents
records.summary: Replaces future-screenshot generation with a shared latent representation for GUI action selection and action-conditioned transition prediction. An action-aware contrastive objective encourages the transition representation to retain discriminative action-induced changes.

records.name: Plottery: A Code-Integrated GUI for Matplotlib
Names Are Not Objects: Object-Bound Confinement for Compromised AI Coding Agents
BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
PEAM: On-device Communication Agent for Personalized, Efficient and Autonomous Mobile Network Configuration

records.name: Holotron 3 Nano
records.summary: Computer-use policy checkpoint that H Company post-trained from NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, a hybrid Mamba-MoE model with 3B of 30B parameters active per token, aimed at lower-latency agent workloads.

records.name: Holo4-35B-A3B-FP8
records.summary: An FP8 vision-language checkpoint for computer use. With an agent harness, it processes screenshots and tool results to request clicks, typing, code and tool calls.

records.name: GUI-Libra 7B
records.summary: GUI-Libra checkpoint fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (about 8.29B BF16 parameters) that turns a screenshot, task and action history into a <think> reasoning block and a JSON action with point_2d coordinates.

records.name: GUI-Xplore
records.summary: Per-app Android exploration videos with screenshot and action sequences, view hierarchies and question-answer pairs for five tasks, from app overview and page analysis to action recall and sequence verification.

records.name: LLM Agents: A Survey
records.summary: A survey organizes LLM agents by planning, memory, tool use, coordination, evaluation, and safety, covering computer-use agents among more than two hundred works.
records.publication_search_text: LLM Agents: A Survey 10.20944/preprints202608.0265.v1 Preprints.org MDPI AG https://www.preprints.org/manuscript/202608.0265/v1 https://doi.org/10.20944/preprints202608.0265.v1 Jungseob Lee

records.name: ScaleCUA (THUDM) GLM-4.6V-Flash OSWorld SFT
records.summary: Supervised GLM-4.6V-Flash checkpoint from THUDM's ScaleCUA, released as the start point that online RL initializes from for its OSWorld desktop computer-use agent.

records.name: GroundCUA dataset
records.summary: Desktop GUI-grounding data from the GroundCUA project: PNG screenshots of 87 applications paired by hash with JSON lists of element boxes, visible text and optional coarse categories.

records.name: GUI-Libra-81K-SFT
records.summary: SFT release of GUI-Libra-81K: per-step reasoning traces and coordinate-grounded actions over web and Android screenshots, in JSON annotation files with full, no-reasoning and 1,000-sample variants.

records.name: ShowUI-π checkpoint
records.summary: A compact visual-action checkpoint that predicts continuous GUI drag trajectories from a screenshot and a natural-language instruction.

records.name: ZeroGUI-AndroidLab-7B
records.summary: ZeroGUI-AndroidLab-7B is a GUI-agent checkpoint associated with training that generates interface tasks, estimates rewards from screenshots, and adapts through online reinforcement learning.

records.name: agent-qa
records.summary: QA agent for browser and mobile apps that executes actions through Playwright and Appium, verifies steps, and records runs. Its publisher reports completing all AndroidWorld tasks.

records.name: Aria-UI Data
records.summary: GUI element descriptions and grounding instructions spanning web, mobile, and Ubuntu desktop interfaces.

records.name: ACT-1
records.summary: Adept's 2022 action transformer, previewed in demo videos of a Chrome extension that reads a custom rendering of the page and clicks, types and scrolls on its UI elements to carry out typed requests.

records.name: Achieving 91.4% on Android World: A New Approach to Mobile UI Automation
records.summary: Technical article describing an Android UI agent that alternates planning with single actions, checks screen changes and uses a dedicated text editing path. It reports AndroidWorld results.

records.name: ShowUI Desktop
records.summary: 7,496 desktop grounding examples built from OmniAct screenshots, with annotations rewritten by GPT-4o to describe element appearance, spatial relations and function.

records.name: WebRL-GLM-4-9B
records.summary: A GLM-based WebRL model released for browser tasks across five WebArena websites. Its card reports evaluation results on WebArena-Lite.

records.name: GTA1-7B
records.summary: Released GUI grounding checkpoint trained with reinforcement learning to predict click coordinates from screenshots and instructions, with inference examples and reported benchmark results.

records.name: Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506
records.summary: A multimodal reasoning model with released weights and high-resolution image input. Its authors report GUI grounding evaluations on ScreenSpot-Pro, ScreenSpot-V2 and OSWorld-G.

records.name: WebPRM checklist-generation data
records.summary: Web-task context, starting observations and action history paired with structured checklists and subgoal analyses for checklist generation.

records.name: UGround-V1-2B
records.summary: UGround-V1-2B is a Qwen2-VL-based checkpoint for locating targets in GUI screenshots, with reported evaluations on mobile, desktop, and web screens.

records.name: GUI-Dense-Descriptions
records.summary: A dataset of GUI screenshots paired with dense text descriptions, released as a train split containing 1,263 image-text examples.

records.name: Narada Code and OperatorMini
records.summary: Narada Code develops and tests computer-use workflows, then revises them after failures. OperatorMini executes the instructions for repeatable web and enterprise tasks.

records.name: E2B
records.summary: Sandbox infrastructure for executing agent workloads.

records.name: UI-TARS 72B SFT
records.summary: SFT-labelled 72B UI-TARS checkpoint: a native GUI agent model in the Qwen2-VL architecture, stored in FP32, for screen perception, element grounding and multi-step actions on web, mobile and desktop.

records.name: ScreenDrag
records.summary: GUI dragging data with screen observations, prior state, and continuous pointer actions, provided as trajectory files and Parquet representations.

records.name: Seg2Click Qwen3.5 2B
records.summary: Seg2Click checkpoint using a 2B Qwen3.5 backbone to predict a mask and select an interface click.

records.name: ScaleCUA 7B
records.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-based computer-use checkpoint with direct grounding and agent action modes across desktop, mobile and web interfaces.

records.name: GUI-Based Software Testing: An Automated Approach Using GPT-4 and Selenium WebDriver
records.summary: A web GUI testing method combines GPT-4 with Selenium WebDriver and compares its branch coverage with random monkey testing on a web calculator.
records.publication_search_text: GUI-Based Software Testing: An Automated Approach Using GPT-4 and Selenium WebDriver 10.1109/asew60602.2023.00028 2023 38th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering Workshops (ASEW) IEEE https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10298721 https://doi.org/10.1109/asew60602.2023.00028 Daniel Zimmermann Anne Koziolek

records.name: Magma-AITW-SoM
records.summary: Magma-AITW-SoM supplies AITW data used to fine-tune the Magma multimodal agent model for downstream tasks.
